izzyondroid:org.privacyguides.verifiedap.name: Privacy Guides Verified Apps
izzyondroid:org.privacyguides.verifiedap.summary: An app signing certificate hash verifier based on a crowdsourced dataset.
izzyondroid:org.privacyguides.verifiedap.description:
Verified Apps is an app signing certificate hash viewer and verifier. It checks your installed apps (or any APK file) against a built-in database of known-good app signing fingerprints.
 IMPORTANT: We maintain and release this app and our dataset in good faith and on a best-effort basis. We are not committing to perfect security, immediate bug fixes, or comprehensive app coverage in our dataset. As always with security tools like this, you must consider your own threat model and plan accordingly. We cannot advise you personally on the appropriate security measures for your specific situation. Your use of this app is at your own risk, and you may not hold any contributors liable for any adverse events which may occur.
 README: https://github.com/privacyguides/verified-apps-android/blob/main/README.md
 MAINTAINER: https://www.privacyguides.org/
 You can share or copy verification info for use outside the app. If an app is not in the database, you'll have the option to open a pre-filled GitHub submission issue in your browser.
 What is this? 
 This is a fork of AppVerifier (https://github.com/soupslurpr/AppVerifier), but many components have been removed, so it no longer serves the same purpose. Notably, it no longer includes peer-to-peer verification via clipboard sharing. This app only checks apps against our crowdsourced database.
 App verifications & reliability 
 Please note that mismatch results may not always indicate an illegitimate app. For example, if we only have the F-Droid version of an app in our database, and you downloaded the app from Google Play where Google signed it with their own certificate, then your app would not match our database and will be flagged.
 When you find a mismatch, we always recommend submitting that app information to our issue tracker, you will be prompted to do so within the app. We will work to verify the legitimacy of your submission. If the app you have is indeed legitimate, we will include it in the next app release. If the app you have is illegitimate, we will inform you in the submitted issue.
 What this app is good for 
 Contributing to Privacy Guides' crowdsourced database (https://github.com/privacyguides/verified-apps/) of developer signing certificates. 
 If an app on your device is listed as unknown or a mismatch in this app, you will be shown a button to make a submission to our issue tracker, and it will automatically fill out the submission form to make the process as easy as possible for you. You will still need an account with our issue tracker to make a submission.
 Comparing your installed apps to Privacy Guides' database without needing to trust any additional parties/developers. 
 We include our entire database locally in this app, which is built and signed by us. We therefore control the entire pipeline end-to-end, and once downloaded your local data can never be modified without updating the app to a new build.
 What this app is not good for 
 Comparing your apps to anyone's hashes besides our crowdsourced database. 
 We've removed all clipboard/user-based verification tools, as many other apps already provide this functionality well, and we do not want to maintain parallel features unnecessarily.

izzyondroid:page.ooooo.geoshare.summary: Open map links in other map apps and copy coordinates
izzyondroid:page.ooooo.geoshare.description:
Share a map link with GeoShare and the app will open it in another installed map app.
 Supported map links 
 Google Maps
 Apple Maps
 2GIS
 Amap (AutoNavi)
 Baidu Map (beta)
 Cartes IGN
 CoMaps
 HERE WeGo
 Kagi Maps
 Magic Earth
 MapQuest
 Maps.me
 Mapy.com
 OpenStreetMap
 Organic Maps
 OsmAnd
 Plus Codes (global only)
 Urbi
 Waze
 Yahoo! Maps
 Yandex Maps
 coordinates
 GeoShare is not affiliated with or endorsed by any of the services mentioned.
 Example use cases 
 When someone sends you a Google Maps link, but you prefer using OpenStreetMap, you can quickly open the same location in OsmAnd or Organic Maps.
 When you like Google Maps for finding places, but you prefer a different app for navigation, you can easily switch from Google Maps to your favorite navigation app .
 Other features 
 Shows the geographic coordinates of a map link and allows copying them to clipboard in various formats, for example as a geo: link.
 Shows all points of a place list link.
 Allows performing an action automatically when a map link is processed. (Pro feature)
 Allows launching navigation in all apps that support it, including TomTom.
 Allows opening a location in web maps , pre-installed ones or your own. (Pro feature)
 Allows saving a location as a GPX file .
 Allows sending a location via a messaging app .
 Allows saving a location to a contact .
 Retries on patchy internet connection .
 Allows pasting map links directly into the app, instead of sharing them with it.
 Interface adapts to tablets .
 How it works and privacy considerations 
 GeoShare converts map links (e.g. https://maps.app.goo.gl/...) into geo: links that can be opened by other map apps. To create a geo: link, geographic coordinates are required. GeoShare reads them from the map URL.
 However, not all map URLs include coordinates. In such cases, GeoShare will prompt you for permission to connect to the map service (Google Maps, Apple Maps, etc.) and read the coordinates from HTTP headers, HTML document, or an API. For more detailed information, check the app’s FAQ screen.

fdroid:com.anywherelan.awl.name: Anywherelan
fdroid:com.anywherelan.awl.summary: Peer-to-peer mesh VPN to connect your devices directly, no central servers
fdroid:com.anywherelan.awl.description:
Anywherelan (awl) is a mesh VPN that lets you connect to any of your devices at the IP level, wherever they are. It works similarly to tinc, direct WireGuard or Tailscale, but fully peer-to-peer: there are no central coordination servers to trust or set up. Your traffic goes directly between your devices.
You can also route traffic through a remote device, either per-app as a SOCKS5 proxy, or all of your device's traffic at once as a full-tunnel VPN gateway (exit node).
 Some use cases 
 Connect to your home or work laptop over RDP/VNC/SSH even when it sits behind NAT, without configuring port forwarding.
 Reach self-hosted services like Nextcloud, Home Assistant or Bitwarden without exposing them to the internet.
 Access websites from another country by using a remote device as a SOCKS5 proxy.
 Route all of your traffic through a remote device as a full-tunnel VPN gateway (exit node), like a classic VPN.
 Gaming: local multiplayer as if everyone were on the same LAN.
 Share a development server with a colleague on another device, as an alternative to ngrok.
 Use an old Android phone remotely with scrcpy to run Android-only apps without an emulator.
 Features 
 Fully peer-to-peer. No third-party coordination servers: your traffic stays between your devices.
 Route traffic through a remote device like a SOCKS5 proxy.
 Full-tunnel VPN gateway: route all of your device's traffic through a remote exit node.
 Easy to use: install the app, scan the QR code of another device, and you are connected.
 Invite links: share a link or a QR code, and the other device joins without a manual accept.
 Built-in DNS: reach your devices by name, like laptop.awl, instead of typing IP addresses.
 Built-in NAT traversal.
 If both devices are behind NAT and direct P2P is not possible, encrypted traffic is relayed through community relays.
 TLS 1.3 encryption for all transports (QUIC and TCP).
 ed25519 peer authentication: a peer id is the device's public key.
 Cross-platform: Android, Windows, Linux, macOS.
 How it works 
Awl is built on top of libp2p for peer-to-peer networking and a TUN virtual interface for IP routing. QUIC or TCP with TLS is used as a transport, and a DHT is used to discover peers. On first launch, the app connects to community bootstrap nodes, registers itself, and then looks up the addresses of the peers you want to reach.
Source code, desktop builds and more documentation: https://github.com/anywherelan/awl

fdroid:com.clavierhaus.gnubg.name: CBG -- Clavierhaus BackGammon
fdroid:com.clavierhaus.gnubg.summary: The complete GNU Backgammon engine: play, coach, rollouts, career. Offline.
fdroid:com.clavierhaus.gnubg.description:
CBG Pro is the complete GNU Backgammon engine on Android -- and 1.0 is a major update that turns a strong backgammon app into the most capable analysis and training tool on the platform. It is not "based on" GNU Backgammon: it IS GNU Backgammon 1.08.003, vendored verbatim, with neural-net weights byte-identical to the desktop release. Every number on screen is the engine's own. Entirely offline -- the app does not even request the network permission. Free software, GPL-3.0, with reproducible builds verified by F-Droid's own pipeline against the developer's published binary.
New in the 1.0 major update:
* Regulation rollouts on your phone: 1296-trial, cubeful, variance-reduced, quasi-random -- the discipline desktop analysts use -- seed-reproducible, with the desktop-comparison harness published in the source repository.
* The Coach: every move judged against the engine -- best, fine-but-not-best (with what beat it), or flagged with the equity it cost. Tap any better alternative and watch it play out on the board against your own move. Cube actions judged too.
* Position set-up editor: build any position by hand, or paste a GNU BG ID, Match ID, or XGID from a forum or a book. Chequer rankings with dice on; double/take/drop equities with dice off.
* Your Personal Stats: match statistics computed by gnubg's own analysis -- error rates, luck, cube handling -- with every number labeled by what it is. No invented metrics.
* Your career, signed: finished matches enter a tamper-evident, cryptographically chained record. Your results, provable, in plain files you own.
* A tournament match clock (delay clock), offered upstream to the GNU Backgammon project itself.
The foundation, as always:
* Full matches at any length, seven strength levels from Beginner to Grandmaster.
* Complete cube play, Crawford, Jacoby, beavers, automatic doubles, and the canonical match-equity tables: Kazaross-XG2, Woolsey, Jacobs & Trice, Snowie, and the rest of gnubg's set.
* Save and review matches as standard SGF -- step through what you played, what the engine preferred, and what it cost. Files open unchanged in desktop GNU Backgammon and Backgammon Studio.
* Your matches and your career live in a folder you choose -- plain files, readable by anything, in twenty years too. Nothing is ever sent anywhere; there is no "anywhere" in this app.
Requires Android 12 or newer and a 64-bit ARM device.

You can share with others even across different Nextcloud servers and work together on documents. Nextcloud is fully open source, giving you the option to extend them for your own use, participate in their development or simply verify they do what we promise.
Millions of users use Nextcloud daily at businesses and homes around the world. Business users rely on the professional support of Nextcloud GmbH, making sure they have a fully supported, enterprise-ready platform for productivity and collaboration, fully under control of their IT department.

fdroid:xyz.crucitti.friendalert.description:
FriendAlert: Keep Your Friendships Thriving, No Matter How Far Apart
 Life's adventures lead us to friendships that cross cities, countries, and even continents. While
these connections add immeasurable value to our lives, keeping them vibrant across distances can be
a challenge. Born from this universal struggle, FriendAlert is your go-to solution for keeping those
important friendships alive and well.
 Functions
 The application offers a simple reminder to remember to contact your friends: you can set how often you
want to keep in touch and every time you call a friend you can record that inside the app. If you
do not call one of your friends for a time longer than the limit you set, you'll be sent a notification.
 🌍 Your Central Hub for Global Friendships 
Whether your friendships were formed on the playground or during an international journey,
FriendAlert functions as your unified platform for sustaining these invaluable bonds. With
FriendAlert, neither miles nor time zones can weaken your connections.
 🗣️ Foster Authentic Connections: More than Just Check-ins 
Social media may offer cursory updates about people's lives, but it's no substitute for genuine
conversation. FriendAlert encourages you to engage in meaningful dialogues that go beyond the
superficial.
 A Personal Perspective
 I created FriendAlert with the aim of maintaining contact with the people who matter most to me.
While the app's utility can vary, here are some personal guidelines I follow:
 Use FriendAlert to track those you find you're losing touch with, not the friends you see
regularly.
 Although in-person meetings are irreplaceable, phone or video calls serve as excellent
alternatives when that's not feasible.
 Texting, though convenient, falls short in conveying emotional nuance and should not be your
primary mode of communication.
 Engaging via social media—such as liking photos or commenting—simply doesn’t cut it when it comes
to nurturing real friendships.
 Elevate Your Social Ecosystem
 FriendAlert emerged from a personal need for an accessible, budget-friendly way to sustain my social
circle. While platforms like nouri.ai have their merits, FriendAlert offers a free and user-friendly
alternative.
 Sharing good moments is nice. Let's enrich not just our conversations, but our lives and communities
through stronger, more meaningful connections.

- Turn boss sigils into combat sets, or let the Set Crafter build a whole set for you
- Fill the Crafting Codex with everything you've made

- Hands-on fights: tap your talents, dodge wind-ups and stun them before they land
- Tap to Damage when a monster reels, land BONUS hits, and hold to Unleash a flurry
- Five hunting grounds, 25 monsters and six bosses with phases, minions and heroic versions
- Every 10 kills, push on or bank your haul. In trouble? Flee
- Monsters evolve the more you beat them: tougher, with more gold and better finds
- Pack food from the Tavern, crack open boss chests, and hang trophies on your shop wall

- Pets grow through three forms as their tier rises; a rare few are Starborn

- Level your guild all the way to 100, with a new perk at every level
SOMETHING NEW EVERY DAY

- Hire an Apprentice to gather or process alongside you
- A short story to start, a guided first job and tips as you go
PLAY YOUR WAY

- No ads, no energy timers, no subscriptions

flathub:com.ktechpit.hungrysnake.name: Hungry Snake
flathub:com.ktechpit.hungrysnake.description:
Hungry Snake is a classic snake game for Linux with a bright, cartoon arcade look. Guide a cute
 snake around a wooden board, eat apples, grow longer and don't bite your own tail or hit a wall.
 It is the retro worm game you remember, rebuilt with smooth movement, jungle scenery and plenty
 to unlock. Free, open source and ad-free.
 Gameplay:
 Smooth snake movement that glides between cells, with buffered turns so quick key presses
 are never lost
 A run starts only when you steer, and the speed climbs gently and announces each step, so
 even a long snake stays in control
 Bonus food: a golden star for extra points and a mint leaf that trims your tail when you
 are boxed in
 A cute, expressive snake that blinks, flicks its tongue and watches the apple
 Unlock and customize:
 Earn Coins just by playing and spend them in the Store on snake skins, board themes, apple
 styles and bonus food looks
 Six animated background scenes: jungle, sunset, twilight, ember, snowfall and aurora
 Scene-matched snakes, boards and apples that combine into one coordinated look
 Every standard cosmetic unlocks by playing; an optional Supporter Pack adds a few exclusive
 extras
 Challenges and leaderboard:
 A new Daily Challenge every day with a streak to keep alive
 Achievements that pay out Coins for lifetime and single-run milestones
 An opt-in online leaderboard: pick a nickname, post your high score and see your global rank
 Made for the desktop:
 Play with the arrow keys or WASD, use the mouse in menus, and toggle fullscreen with F11
 Six relaxing music tracks, crunchy sound effects and a performance mode for older PCs and
 laptops
 Offline gameplay with no account needed; the leaderboard is the only online part
 A modern take on Snake, Nibbles and other worm games for anyone who likes casual, retro and
 offline arcade games. Works on Ubuntu, Fedora, Debian, Arch, openSUSE and other Linux distributions,
 on Wayland and X11.

flathub:com.rocksandpaper.syndic.name: Syndic
flathub:com.rocksandpaper.syndic.description:
Syndic is a simple, touch-friendly feed reader for KDE Plasma Desktop. Subscribe to any site that provides an RSS or Atom feed. Get automatically-generated 
 highlights from your collection, search for articles by keyword, or page through a list of every new article.
 Features include:
 Adaptive design - Displays in one, two or three column mode depending on available space
 Touchscreen support - quickly swipe between articles on touchscreen devices
 Cut through the clutter - automatically-generated highlights prevent lower-volume feeds from getting drowned out by higher-volume ones
 Download web content - fetch full article text from the web, even if the feed only provides a summary
 Save your favorites - mark your favorite articles to keep track of them and prevent them from expiring

flathub:dev.ibrahimcetin.reins.name: Reins: Chat for Ollama
flathub:dev.ibrahimcetin.reins.description:
Reins is a powerful chat client for your self-hosted Ollama AI models. Connect remotely, customize prompts, adjust parameters, and manage multiple conversations with ease.
 Key Features:
 Connect to remote Ollama servers
 Custom system prompts per chat
 Edit and regenerate responses
 Send images
 Fine-tune model parameters (temperature, context size, etc.) for each chat
 Switch models mid-conversation
 Create custom models from chats
 Real-time message streaming
 Requires a self-hosted Ollama Server.

flathub:eu.alyshmahell.ServeMedia.name: ServeMedia
flathub:eu.alyshmahell.ServeMedia.description:
ServeMedia is The Self-Hosted Media-Center for Linux. It is built around a core module called
 MatchMedia which acts as a statistical engine responsible for directory hierarchy discovery of
 media libraries, title extraction and grouping, metadata search-and-fetch from providers like TVMaze,
 statistically scoring and ranking candidates and mapping them to the appropriate files and folder
 hierarchies. ServeMedia is built to be lightweight, minimal and concise, yet feature-complete for
 a self hosted media center. ServeMedia can be both: a standalone desktop application with a desktop
 entry and a webkit wrapped gui on a single device, and a media server which can serve a server-side-rendered
 frontend over the local network. Compatible files play directly. Other files are transcoded to
 HLS, on the GPU when the driver check succeeds.

flathub:io.github.lincity_ng.lincity-ng.name: LinCity-NG
flathub:io.github.lincity_ng.lincity-ng.description:
LinCity-NG is a city simulation game where you are required to build and maintain a city.
 You can win the game either by building a sustainable economy or by evacuating all citizens with spaceships.
 Bring up in-game help with [F1] for details on how to play.

flathub:io.github.mlm_games.asteroids_re.name: Asteroids Revenge
flathub:io.github.mlm_games.asteroids_re.summary: Evade lasers as an enigmatic entity
flathub:io.github.mlm_games.asteroids_re.description:
Asteroids Revenge is an exciting arcade-style game where you must navigate through an asteroid field while battling against a crooked spaceship. Dodge its lasers and fight back to emerge victorious!
 Features:
 Fast-paced gameplay
 Challenging lasers
 minimal graphics
 Engaging sound effects

flathub:io.github.nest_desktop.nest-desk.name: NEST Desktop
flathub:io.github.nest_desktop.nest-desk.description:
NEST Desktop is a web-based application which provides a graphical user interface for NEST Simulator. With this
 easy-to-use tool, users can interactively construct neuronal networks and explore network dynamics.
 Advanced users often choose NEST Simulator: a prominent tool for spiking neuronal networks to measure network
 dynamics.However, programming knowledge is required to write code for this tool. NEST Desktop bypasses this
 requirement, but still teaches users how to construct and explore neuronal networks. A textual script is generated
 from the constructed networks and sent to NEST Simulator; the network activity is then visualized in a graph or
 table. It is a useful teaching tool, since the network graphs and network activity visualizations can be exported
 to files that users can implement for their course protocol.

flathub:org.gnome.Calendar.name: Calendar
flathub:org.gnome.Calendar.description:
GNOME Calendar is an elegant tool to help you plan and stay on top of your schedule for
 upcoming days and weeks, whether your months are filled with meetings and appointments,
 public events, travel logistics, or other commitments in your life.
 Easily create and manage unlimited calendars and events with GNOME Calendar's infinite
 scrolling month view, week timetable, and scheduling list view.
 Integrating the latest GNOME technologies and design best practices, GNOME Calendar builds on
 top of the mature Evolution data server to manage large quantities of events and to provide
 integration with other applications. You can add calendars from various online calendaring
 services (like NextCloud, Google Calendar, and CalDAV / WebDAV servers), enabling you to
 synchronize your events across multiple devices and platforms. GNOME Calendar also supports
 local and offline calendaring, so you can use it anywhere and anytime while travelling
 (or after civilization's collapse.)

flathub:page.codeberg.gwync.glerm.name: Glerm
flathub:page.codeberg.gwync.glerm.description: Glerm is a puzzle game. You're under attack by encroaching shapes. Zap shapes of the same color to make them vanish, and shapes of another color to swap colors. If the shape you zap has consecutive shapes of the same color, those will vanish as well, with score bonuses.

fedora-packages:ergo/ergo.name: ergo
fedora-packages:ergo/ergo.summary: A program for large-scale self-consistent field calculations
fedora-packages:ergo/ergo.description: Ergo is a quantum chemistry program for large-scale self-consistent field calculations. Key features of the Ergo program: * Performs electronic structure calculations using Hartree-Fock and Kohn-Sham density functional theory. * Uses Gaussian basis sets. * Both core and valence electrons are included in the calculations. * Both restricted and unrestricted models are implemented for energy calculations. * Implements a broad range of both pure and hybrid Kohn-Sham density functionals. * Employs modern linear scaling techniques like fast multipole methods, hierarchic sparse matrix algebra, density matrix purification, and efficient integral screening. * Linear scaling is achieved not only in terms of CPU usage but also memory utilization. * The time consuming parts of the code are currently parallelized using the shared-memory paradigm. Linear response calculations of polarizabilities and excitation energies are possible for the restricted reference density, although complete linear scaling is in the current implementation not achieved since full dense matrices are still used in parts of the linear response implementation.

fedora-packages:gap-pkg-json/gap-pkg-jso.description: This package defines a mapping between the JSON markup language and GAP. The built-in datatypes of GAP provide an easy mapping to and from JSON. This package uses the following mapping between GAP and JSON. - JSON lists are mapped to GAP lists - JSON dictionaries are mapped to GAP records - JSON strings are mapped to GAP strings - Integers are mapped to GAP integers, non-integer numbers are mapped to Floats - true, false and null are mapped to true, false and fail respectively Note that this library will not map any other GAP types, such as groups, permutations, to or from JSON. If you wish to map between more complex types, look at the gap-pkg-openmath package, or IO_Pickle in the gap-pkg-io package.

firefox-addons:3053553.name: SR Privacy Monitor
firefox-addons:3053553.summary: Observes what a site tries to store, contact, load, or track about you. Reports cookies, third-party requests, storage, and fingerprinting APIs. Never blocks. Nothing is sent off this device.
firefox-addons:3053553.description:
Privacy Monitor is a privacy auditor for Firefox. It answers one question: what did this site attempt to store, contact, load, or track about me?
It only observes and reports. It does not block cookies, cancel requests, change web pages, or replace your search, homepage, or new tab page.
 Reports only. Never blocks. Data stays on this device. 
 What it records on each site 
 First-party and third-party cookies, including whether third-party cookies are partitioned
 Third-party requests (scripts, images, iframes, beacons, pixels)
 localStorage, sessionStorage, and IndexedDB keys
 Fingerprinting-related APIs (canvas, WebGL, audio, WebRTC, and similar), with a low / medium / high confidence label
 Advertising click IDs in the page URL
 Trackers hidden behind a first-party CNAME
Known advertising, analytics, and social-tracking hosts come from the Disconnect Tracking Protection list, plus a short extras list. Same-company hosts (for example LinkedIn loading licdn.com ) are labeled as that company's infrastructure, not as trackers. Consent tools and bot-defense services are labeled but not counted as trackers.
 How it works 
By default it auto-monitors every website you open. You can turn that off in Settings and use Scan this site instead. A toolbar popup, a Firefox sidebar, and a full report page show the live results.
To see storage writes and fingerprinting API calls, the add-on injects an observation script into web pages. That script wraps a few built-in APIs so those calls can be listed. It does not change what the page stores or whom it contacts.
 What is stored on this device 
Visit reports stay in your browser only. Nothing is uploaded. History is kept for up to 80 visits or 30 days, whichever comes first. You can delete it in Settings. Private window visits can be watched live if you allow the add-on in private windows; those visits are not saved.
 Permissions 
The add-on asks for access to all websites, cookies, tabs, network requests, navigation, local storage, and DNS. It uses these to watch what the current site stores and contacts. It does not modify requests or cookies.
Tracker names include data from Disconnect Tracking Protection (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0).
Made by Simon Ringwelski .

firefox-addons:3112410.name: Clean Links Privacy
firefox-addons:3112410.summary: Strips tracking parameters and share IDs from links, in the address bar and when you copy or share.
firefox-addons:3112410.description:
Sites like X, Amazon and YouTube add IDs to links, which can be used to see who shared what, and from which device. Clean Links removes them.
• Cleans the address bar: tracking parameters are removed as soon as a page opens, so they don't end up in your history, bookmarks or shared links.
• Cleans Copy link and Share: what goes to your clipboard or the share sheet is cleaned first.
• Cleans links on the page when you hover, focus or right-click them.
• Covers utm_*, fbclid, gclid, msclkid and similar everywhere, plus site-specific tracking on X, Amazon, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, Reddit, LinkedIn, TikTok and Google search. Parameters that change what you see, such as search terms and YouTube timestamps, are left alone.
• One click in the toolbar pauses it everywhere, or for a single site.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no analytics and no network requests of its own. Everything happens on your device, and the only thing saved is your on/off switch and paused-site list, stored locally. Free and open source (MIT): https://github.com/arrhen/clean-links-safari 
Not covered: short links a site makes itself (such as t.co or amzn.to ), because the ID lives on their server. Clean Links is independent and not affiliated with the sites or browsers it names. It is provided as is, and can't remove every tracker.

Recommendations

firefox-addons:3060759.description:
Qurexo Shopify Theme Detector is a fast, privacy-first browser extension that instantly identifies the theme, technology stack, and storefront signals behind any Shopify store.
 Key features: 
 Shopify theme detection — Identify the exact theme running on any Shopify storefront, including custom and official themes.
 Theme metadata — See the theme developer, version, architecture (Online Store 2.0), and theme type at a glance.
 Confidence scores — Every detection includes a transparent confidence rating so you know how reliable the result is.
 Technology stack — View all detected technologies (analytics, CDN, tag managers, ecommerce platforms) with per-technology confidence.
 Detection signals — Platform, CDN, analytics, and tracking signals displayed in a clean grid.
 Evidence-first results — Optional "Why this result?" section shows exactly what signals support each detection.
 Scan history — Last 10 scans saved locally for quick re-access. No remote tracking.
 Copy & export — Copy a clean text report or export the full API response as JSON.
 Light & dark themes — Light mode by default, dark mode on demand.
 Privacy-first — Only the storefront URL is sent to Qurexo for analysis. No cookies, browsing history, or personal data collected.
Ideal for ecommerce developers, dropshippers, theme researchers, and competitive intelligence professionals who need to quickly understand what powers a Shopify store.

bluejetty:00153598:ios.description:
Trophy Hunter – Your Ultimate Destination for Social Competitive Hunting Games!
Step into the wild with Trophy Hunter, a premier free-to-play shooting experience designed for fans of hunting games, shooting games, sniper games, and exciting casual games. Get ready for intense 1v1 PvP sniper hunting battle duels that test your hunter skills, precision, and strategy – join Hunting Clubs, chat in real time, and compete with friends for rewards and bragging rights. Are you ready to become the ultimate trophy hunter in this top free shooting game?
Heart-Pounding PvP Hunting Duels Battle
Challenge players in thrilling head-to-head sniper hunting battle matchups. Every duel battle pushes your sniper skills to the limit. As you progress through locations, the challenge grows – faster animals, longer distances, and smaller targets. Precision shooting and quick hunter reflexes are your keys to victory in these hunting game battles. Become the top sniper hunter!
Explore Realistic Worlds. Hunt Day & Night
Explore breathtaking hunting locations across the globe, including Yukon, Montana, Kamchatka, Botswana, Egypt, and many more. Track and hunt a variety of animals including deer, ostriches, hippos, alligators, and macaques. Stunning visuals bring every hunting ground to life for every hunter in this free hunting experience battle.
Night Hunt mode will test your skills after dark – limited visibility, maximum reward.
Master Your Arsenal: Weapons & Ammo
Weapons: Collect cards from rewards to unlock and upgrade 20+ firearms for any sniper hunter battle. Every weapon has unique stats like Damage, Bullet Speed, Score Bonus, Zoom, Slow Motion, and Zoom Time. Customize your shooting loadout and dominate the battle games.
Ammo: Strategy extends to your bullets! Choose from multiple bullet types, each with its own design and stats like Damage Bonus, Score Bonus, and Bullet Speed. Equip powerful options and make every sniper shot count in these dynamic sniper battle games!
Daily Precision Challenge: Golden Shot
Test your sniper precision daily in Golden Shot challenges! Get one FREE hunt each day with a special sniper bullet. The better your shooting accuracy, the bigger the reward. Prove your mastery in skill-based free hunting game battle!
Show Off Your Success: Hunter’s Lodge
Showcase your trophy animals, achievements, and prestige in your personal Hunter’s Lodge. Build your hunter profile and display your hunting success as a top trophy hunter!
Clubs, Social Play & Competitive Events
Rise through global leaderboards and earn seasonal rewards. Join or create Hunting Clubs to team up with fellow hunter players, share sniper strategies, and compete together in casual game battles.
Take on Beast Hunt: a cooperative Club hunt vs. a giant beast with an internal leaderboard, team rewards for the kill, and better loot for top damage dealers. Prove your strength in the Club Ranking with global club standings based on the fastest kill of the highest-tier Club Boss. Join the Club Race, a time-limited competition with shared tasks, milestones, and prizes. Coordinate in real time using the Club chat.
Stay rewarded with the Login Calendar featuring daily login rewards, streak bonuses, and free drops. Progress faster with Daily and Weekly Tasks offering rotating missions, clear objectives, bonus currency, and gear.
Build your network with Friends: add people, compare progress, and challenge them in friendly PvP duels for rewards and bragging rights. Invite new hunters with Referrals and earn rewards for bringing friends into the hunt.
Trophy Hunter blends the thrill of shooting games and the precision of sniper games with strategic hunting gameplay. Whether you’re a veteran hunter or new to free hunting games, Trophy Hunter delivers a rich free shooting experience for every sniper hunter.
Ready your rifle, steady your sniper aim, and claim your title. Download Trophy Hunter now – it’s free! Become a legendary hunter in the world of shooting games!

bluejetty:00060673:ios.description:
The Life Application Study Bible: Trusted by Millions, Refreshed for Today
Discover how to put God’s Word into practice in your everyday life.
For over 30 years, the Life Application Study Bible has been the #1-selling study Bible, treasured by millions of readers. Now thoroughly updated and expanded, this new edition offers even more relevant insights and spiritual guidance for navigating God’s Word in today’s world.
Why It’s the #1 Choice
The Life Application Study Bible doesn’t just explain the original meaning of the text; it brings it off the page and into your life. Using the accurate and easy-to-understand New Living Translation (NLT), this Bible helps you understand Scripture in its original context and provides practical, powerful ways to apply those truths to your daily walk.
What’s New in This Edition
• Refreshed Design: A brand new app design to help make your Bible study easier and powerful.
• Updated Content: Meaningfully revised study notes and features ensure the application is as relevant as ever.
Key Features for Deeper Study
• 10,000+ Life Application Notes: Verse-by-verse commentary that transforms understanding into lived truth.
• 100+ Personality Profiles: Learn from the accomplishments and mistakes of key biblical figures.
• 500+ Maps & Charts: Conveniently placed for quick reference, plus 16 pages of full-color maps.
• Comprehensive Overviews: Introductions, vital statistics, outlines, and timelines for every book.
• Specialized Resources: Includes a Harmony of the Gospels, a dictionary/concordance, and an extensive cross-reference system.
• Christian Worker’s Resource: A unique supplement designed to enhance your ministry effectiveness.
• Default Translation: New Living Translation (NLT) 2015 edition with Jesus’s words in red letter.
More Features
• Morning Inspiration: Start every day with a Verse of the Day, a Daily Devotional, or a Daily TouchPoint—addressing life’s most pressing questions.
• Massive Devotional Library: Choose from over 36,000 devotionals and 600+ topics including faith, anxiety, marriage, and spiritual growth.
• TouchPoints Series: Access the best-selling TouchPoints series for free, featuring over 350 topics with engaging questions and answers straight from Scripture.
• One-Tap Insights: Instantly find the meaning behind any verse with the "Explain" feature or see how it reads across different versions with "Compare."
• Split-Screen Study: View your Bible text alongside study notes, maps, or personal notes simultaneously.
• Audio Bibles: Study on the go by listening to your favorite translations.
• Personalization: Highlight in custom colors, create rich-text study notes, and sync everything across all your devices so you’re never without your insights.
• Top Translations: Stream or download NLT, NIV, ESV, KJV, NKJV, and more for offline access.
• Premium Study Library: Explore 100+ Study Bibles and Commentaries, including the LASB, MacArthur, and Cornerstone Bible Commentary.
• Group Plans: Read and discuss a reading plan together with family and friends.
• Flexible Reading Plans: Choose from the One-Year Bible, The Bible Recap, or create your own custom 3 to 30-day plan.
"TYNDALE", "New Living Translation", "NLT", the New Living Translation logo, and "Life Application" are registered trademarks of Tyndale House Publishers, Inc. "Life App" and the Life App logo are trademarks of Tyndale House Publishers, Inc.
Are we missing any features you would like to see? Have any suggestions? Feel free to email us at biblesupport@tecarta.com

bluejetty:00064292:ios.description:
Travel to the countryside and enjoy a relaxing game in Tsuki Adventure. Harvest carrots from the farm, meet new animal friends and enjoy a simple life with Tsuki.
Tsuki was lonely. A stressful job. A thankless boss. A busy, chaotic life in a noisy city. But one day, with the arrival of a plain letter, everything changed for Tsuki.
Tsuki inherited the family carrot farm in rustic Mushroom Village. Now, here in the countryside, away from all the noise and stress of city life, Tsuki quickly comes to appreciate the simple things.
Enjoy a relaxing, story-based game filled with cute animals. You can check in on Tsuki throughout the day, collect new items and visit locations around the country, while finding hidden surprises.
Whether it's fishing with Yori the fox, reading books with Chi the giraffe, or sampling the delicious ramen made by Bobo the panda... every moment is precious.
Join Tsuki in an awe-inspiring adventure and discover all the beauty that country life has to offer.
Tsuki Adventure Features:
Animal Story Game
- Tsuki’s new life in the countryside is filled with new animal friends
- Enjoy a story-driven tale
- Explore the Mushroom Village
- Unlock new, adorable diary entries
Relaxing, Passive Game
- Check in on Tsuki and see how things are doing
- Buy and collect items for Tsuki to use
- Visit Tsuki any time and watch the story unfold
Country Game
- Grow carrots at the family farm
- Go fishing, clean up the village & more for nifty upgrades
- Get to know Tsuki’s neighbors
Collect Items
- Buy new items from Yori the fox
- Collect toys from the gachapon machine with gacha tickets
- Decorate Tsuki’s house with your personal touch
Hidden Surprises
- Find new mini-games to enjoy
- Enjoy special events
- Explore and find new activities
Meet Tsuki and the animals of Mushroom Village, gather carrots and enjoy the peace of country life in Tsuki Adventure.
CLUB MOON
Membership is offered on a monthly subscription. You will have a 3-days FREE trial period. After this period you will be charged $1.99 per month. After buying this subscription, you will gain access to all Club Moon areas plus the amazing Blimp. As a member of Club Moon you'll meet meet new characters, unlock exclusive activities and unique experiences, get bonus items, and all while traveling in style!

• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable

bluejetty:00160875:ios.description:
Are you ready to start the rescue operation? Welcome to Girl Rescue: Dragon Out!, a brain-challenging puzzle game that combines leisure and challenge! You need to have good strategies to stop the invasion of the dragon and protect our girls! 
Your goal in Girl Rescue is to use cannons to stop the dragon invasion and keep our girls unharmed. It is very easy to play and will also test your reflexes and matching skills!
Game play:
 - Click on the correct color cannon
 - The cannon will destroy the corresponding color parts of the dragon and slow down the invasion.
 - The dragon is repelled and the girl is safe.
Game features:
* Nervous and exciting rhythm: Your hesitation may eventually lead to the girl being attacked by the dragon. You need to find the correct color cannon to attack the dragon within the limited time.
* Simple operation and smooth animation: new players can easily get started and can pass the level with a simple click
* Interesting and highly fulfilling: When the dragon is defeated and the girl is rescued, you will have an unprecedented sense of accomplishment
* Various random events occur: During the game, you may encounter problems such as frozen dragons, cannon jams, etc., which will make the game more fun!
* Levels with different difficulties: Different levels have different scenes and different difficulties, which constantly brings freshness!
If you like casual puzzle games and want some challenge while relaxing, then this game is definitely for you! Download and enjoy Girl Rescue: Dragon Out!!

bluejetty:00019528:ios.name: Too Good To Go: End Food Waste
bluejetty:00019528:ios.summary: Too Good To Go makes it easy to make a positive impact on the planet while saving money on your favourite foods. That's why it's been named as Winner in the '2023 Cultural Impact' category at the prestigious annual Apple App Store Awards. W
bluejetty:00019528:ios.description:
Too Good To Go makes it easy to make a positive impact on the planet while saving money on your favourite foods. That's why it's been named as Winner in the '2023 Cultural Impact' category at the prestigious annual Apple App Store Awards. With the #1 app for reducing food waste, you can save tasty unsold snacks, takeaway meals and ingredients straight from shops, cafes, grocery stores and restaurants in your area - all at an unbeatable price. 
Reducing food waste is one of the solutions to slow down climate change: together we have the power to make a difference. In a world where 40% of food produced goes to waste annually, the Too Good To Go app is your ticket to unlocking affordable eats while helping the planet. 
How Too Good To Go Works:
Explore and Discover: Download the app to explore the map, finding nearby restaurants, cafes, grocery stores, and shops with unsold food.
Choose Your Surprise Bag: Browse a variety of Surprise Bags, each filled with tasty, unsold food. From sushi delights and fast-food favourites like pizzas and burgers to grocery staples and healthy fruits and veggies, the options are endless.
Affordable Rescues: Select a Surprise Bag that suits your cravings and budget. Prices start from as low as $3, providing an affordable and sustainable way to enjoy quality meals.
Secure Your Spot: Confirm your purchase through the app to secure your spot and rescue these tasty treats. Your contribution not only saves you money but also actively reduces food waste.
Collect and Enjoy: Head to the selected business at the pre-set time to collect your Surprise Bag. Indulge in your rescued food guilt-free, knowing you've made a positive impact on the environment.
Why Too Good To Go?
Wallet-Friendly Indulgence: Access quality food at affordable prices, satisfying both your taste buds and wallet.
Variety and Choice: Too Good To Go is partnered with a huge selection of both local favourites and renowned takeaway brands with surplus food. We offer a diverse range of options for every palate, including takeout sushi, pizza, burgers, baked goods, whole foods, and more.
Environmental Impact: Every Surprise Bag equates to 2.7kg of CO2e avoided, meaning enjoying your favourite foods and reducing waste is a step closer towards a cleaner, greener planet.
Easy Purchase Process: The app's user-friendly interface makes it easy to browse, choose, and purchase Surprise Bags.
Convenient Rescues: Collect your rescued meals at the pre-set time, ensuring a hassle-free experience.
Join the Too Good To Go Community:
Become a part of a community that believes in enjoying good food while making a positive impact on the planet. Don't miss out on the opportunity to eat well and do good. Download the app now and start reducing food waste—one tasty Surprise Bag at a time.
Reducing food waste is the #1 action you can take to help tackle climate change.
For more information, visit tgtg.to/claims

bluejetty:00129353:ios.description:
Packed with a variety of useful features, the App lets you easily register your Tech-Air® 5 Airbag System and monitor its status and battery life, as well as tracking the details of your ride. The App uses Bluetooth Connectivity to access the System’s data.  Using the MyRide feature, riders can record location and speed continuously during a ride.  Relive your ride and visualize your average and top speeds at any point along the route by zooming in on the map.  MyRide gives motorcyclists the ability to record unlimited motorcycle rides and build up a complete library of individual trips, so you can easily retrace your trips and remember the great riding moments. 
How it Works
• See top stats for the ride – including the exact location where these results were achieved, average speed, trip time and distance covered.
• Retrace each trip on an enhanced Google Map that shows your speed at any point you select along the trip.
• Build up an awesome library of each ride you take on your bike.
• Disable the Tech-Air® System when you’re going to start doing heavy off-road riding.
• Verify the deployment of the Tech-Air® System after an accident.
• Send feedback to the Alpinestars Tech-Air® development team.
• Update the System’s firmware whenever available.
• Download the online manual and useful documentation for air travel, shipments, and servicing.
• Register your products.

bluejetty:00017431:ios.name: Whisperings
bluejetty:00017431:ios.summary:
!!! Over 14 years in the app store! !!!
Now you can access "Whisperings: Solo Piano Radio" from any WiFi or cell phone network with your iPhone & iPad or from any WiFi network with your iPod Touch! The app gives you access to the Whisperi
bluejetty:00017431:ios.description:
!!! Over 14 years in the app store! !!!
Now you can access "Whisperings: Solo Piano Radio" from any WiFi or cell phone network with your iPhone & iPad or from any WiFi network with your iPod Touch! The app gives you access to the Whisperings free stream (included) or, if you have an active paid subscription to Whisperings PureStream, log in to your commercial-free "PureStream" account direct from the app. (Note that paid subscriptions are sold separately and are *not* included with the app purchase).
Whisperings is a solo piano music broadcast featuring over 375 talented pianists from around the world. It's piano music 24/7, with an emphasis on music that is melodic, peaceful and relaxing. It's wonderful listening as background music for school or office, stress relief, yoga, prayer, massage, dinner music or even a late-night romance!
FEATURE RICH:
- iWatch app included allowing listeners to control the app from their Apple Watch.
- Incredible, fast, one-on-one customer support for the app... direct from the app developer.
- Interface that displays the album art, song and artist info.
- Configurable sleep timer that will gradually fade the music volume and then stop the stream.
- Customizable player for PureStream members (requires a paid subscription to access) that allows you to tune in ad-free, skip songs, and mark favorite songs and artist you want to hear more often.
- Support for Bluetooth and AirPlay.
- Visit iTunes to purchase and download the current song or wish list songs while you continue listening.
- One-click login for PureStream subscribers (requires a separate paid subscription).
- Play music in background while running other apps.
- Redirect music to any device that supports Apple's Airplay or Bluetooth.
- "Auto-restart" feature for on-the-go listening. Music restarts if network connectivity is lost and regained.
- Responds to many popular docking station remote controls as well as controls on headphones.
- A "wish list" that lets you save info about the songs you love in case you want to purchase later.
- Settings to control stream quality and buffering.
- Stops music when you receive a call and then restarts when the call is complete.
- Free upgrades to all future versions!
Download the Whisperings app for music that will quiet your busy, noisy world.

bluejetty:00015580:ios.description:
PictureThis® identifies millions of plants daily with over 98% accuracy, making plant care simple and accessible. Whether you're a seasoned gardener or a new plant parent, PictureThis is your essential tool for plant identification and care.
Key Features:
Accurate Plant Identifier
Renowned as the best plant identification app, PictureThis can identify over 400,000 plant species with unparalleled accuracy. Simply take a picture, and our engine will instantly provide the plant's name and detailed information. Curious about a beautiful plant you saw on a walk? Snap a photo, and let PictureThis do the rest!
Plant Disease Auto Diagnose & Cure
Take a photo of a sick plant, and PictureThis will diagnose the disease and offer treatment advice. It’s like having a plant doctor on call! If your favorite houseplant develops brown spots, use PictureThis to receive a diagnosis and a step-by-step treatment plan to restore its health.
Plant Care Tips & Reminders
Get detailed care instructions, including watering schedules, fertilization times, and optimal light conditions, ensuring your plants thrive.
Toxic Plant Warning
Identify toxic plants and receive warnings to keep your pets, children, and family safe. Unsure if a new plant is safe for your pets? PictureThis will alert you if the plant is toxic and provide safety guidelines to protect your loved ones.
Weed Identification
Easily identify weeds in your garden and get tips on how to control or remove them. Notice a new plant growing in your garden beds? Snap a photo with PictureThis to confirm if it’s a weed and receive guidance on how to manage it effectively.
Water Tracker & Reminder
Never forget to water your plants again with timely notifications. Have a busy schedule? PictureThis sends reminders to keep your plants hydrated and healthy without the guesswork.
Light Exposure Monitoring
Track how much sunlight your plant is getting with our light meter to ensure it’s receiving the right amount of light. Concerned your indoor plant isn’t getting enough light? Use the PictureThis light meter to check its exposure and adjust its position for optimal growth.
Manage Your Plant Collection
Track all the plants you identify and build your own plant wishlist. Create your personal fingertip garden with PictureThis.
Expert Consultation
Have plant-related questions? Chat with our experts 24/7 to get personalized advice and tips tailored to your specific gardening needs.
Join PictureThis today and elevate your gardening experience! Identify, learn, and care for your plants with us. Let’s make the world greener, one plant at a time.

bluejetty:00060685:ios.description:
'Nitnem Audio ' app let you read and listen to 'Nitnem Audio' on your mobile. You can read Nitnem 'in Hindi' or 'in Punjabi' and can read meaning of path while reading or listening to 'Nitnem Audio'. Purpose of this app is to let busy and mobile young generation reconnect with Sikhism and "Gurubani" by reading path on mobile. We hope that you will find this app useful and will use it daily.
'Nitnem Gutka' app - 
 # Complete 'Nitnem' - 7 paths 
 # Select language of your preference:- 'Nitnem in Hindi', or 'Nitnem in Punjabi' (Gurmukhi) or 'Nitnem in English'
Ads: -
 # Please note that this app is ad supported
 # We show ad in non-intrusive manner.
 # Listen to 'Nitnem Gurbani': -
 - Seek bar to control audio.
 - Pause button will stop audio and let you play path from where you left
 - You can go to page of your choice using GO button.
 # Select from 5 themes - Sepia, Classic, White, Black, Silver
 # Select text sizes of your choice
 # 'Read meaning' of each page using Translate option
 # 'Nitnem Audio with Lyrics'
About 'Nitnem': -
Nit-Nem (literally Daily Naam) is a collaboration of different banis that were designated to be read by Sikhs every day at different times of the day. Sikhs read nitnems at Gurdwaras. The Nit-Nem bani's usually include the Panj bania (5 bani'below) which are read daily by baptized Sikhs in the morning between 3:00 am and 6:00 am (this period is considered as Amrit Vela or the Ambrosial Hours) and 'Rehras Sahib' in the evening 6pm and 'Kirtan Sohila' at night 9pm.
1. 'Japji Sahib' (amritvela)
2. 'Jaap Sahib' (amritvela)
3. 'Tav-Prasad' Savaiye(morning)
4. 'Chaupai Sahib' (morning)
5. 'Anand Sahib' (All 40 Shabads) (morning)
6. 'Rehras Sahib' (evening)
7. 'Kirtan Sohila' (night)
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Subscription options include weekly and yearly plans and will be charged to your Apple ID account. 
 Pro Features: 
 • Verse-by-verse highlighting 
 • Tap any verse to play from that point 
 • Automatic page turning with audio
 • Adjustable playback speed 
 • Ad-free experience 
 • Payment will be charged at confirmation of purchase. 
 • Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. 
 • You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.
 • Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited upon purchase.

bluejetty:00187246:ios.name: Scanner – Scan PDF, ID & Docs
bluejetty:00187246:ios.summary: Stacks of receipts piling up? Contracts you need signed today, not next week? Handwritten notes you can never find again? Scanner turns your phone into a professional-grade scanner, converting any paper document into a searchable, shareable
bluejetty:00187246:ios.description:
Stacks of receipts piling up? Contracts you need signed today, not next week? Handwritten notes you can never find again? Scanner turns your phone into a professional-grade scanner, converting any paper document into a searchable, shareable, secure digital file in seconds.
Trusted by 30M+ users, Scanner combines high-precision image processing with a top-tier OCR engine to handle contracts, invoices, IDs, receipts, passports, whiteboards, and multi-page reports, all from your camera.
Scanner app will maximize your document management efficiency: a mobile scanner for your smartphone, to change paper into PDF, while saving both time and storage. Scanner supports image processing and can transform, rotate, sharpen your images, for best document quality, combined with a top edge OCR engine, recognizing text in English, Spanish, French, German, Arabic, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese, and more.
WHY SCANNER
Most built-in phone scanning tools stop at a basic PDF. Scanner goes further: sign documents on the spot instead of printing and re-scanning them, add text anywhere on a page, blur out confidential details, lock sensitive files with password protection, export to the format you need, and scan IDs and passports with a mode built specifically for that shape and size.
FEATURES
— High resolution scans that preserve most of the original paper document details
— Built with OCR technology
— Multiple page PDF support: combine, reorder, merge, or split pages into one organized file
— Modify, delete pages, have them recoverable for 30 days 
— Image processing engine that allows you to change contrast, enhance, sharpen for the perfect document quality
— E-signature: sign documents directly in the app with custom ink color & stroke width, no printing or workarounds
— Password protection for sensitive PDFs like contracts, IDs, and financial records
— Dedicated ID and passport scan mode
— Export to PDF, JPG, PNG, or Word
— Share data with friends or colleagues, with just a few taps
BUILT FOR REAL SITUATIONS
Freelancers and small business owners use Scanner to digitize invoices, receipts, and contracts for accounting and tax season. Students and researchers convert handwritten notes and textbook pages into searchable files. Remote workers sign and send documents the same day, without leaving their desk. Anyone with a drawer full of insurance policies, or legal paperwork uses it to build a secure, searchable digital archive instead.
WHEN TO USE SCANNER
Use Scanner anytime you need a document digitized, signed, converted, or organized faster than your phone's built-in tools allow, especially when you need OCR in a language your device doesn't reliably support, a password-protected file, a dedicated ID scan mode, or a signature on the spot.
GETTING YOUR FIRST SCAN
1. Open the app, place your document on a flat, well-lit surface, and tap the camera button. Scanner automatically detects the edges and frames the page for you.
2. Review, crop, and enhance the scan, then choose PDF or JPG, sign if needed, and save or share.
For best results, scan in bright, even lighting on a flat, uncluttered surface.
SUBSCRIPTION
This app contains subscription:
— You can subscribe for premium account with unlimited scans, premium features and no ads
— Subscription is from $9.99 USD monthly*
— Subscription automatically renews for the same price and duration period as the original "one week"/"one month"/"one year" package unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
— Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
— Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
— Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable

https://www.iubenda.com/terms-and-conditions/44220384

bluejetty:00062966:ios.description:
Ignite your competitive spirit with Asphalt Legends and immerse yourself in this heart-pounding car racing world. Collaborate with fellow drivers to blaze through thrilling online multiplayer races, execute jaw-dropping drifts and stunts, and charge towards victory in the most exquisite cars! 
Engage with the Global Racing Community 
Gear up and race into Asphalt Legends' international car racing arena. Challenge up to 7 opponents from every corner of the world in electrifying cross-platform, online multiplayer car-racing battles, mastering your drift skills along the way and perfecting every drift to gain an edge.
Join Racing Legends! 
Embrace the camaraderie of the worldwide competitive car-racing scene, where every victory fuels the pursuit of greatness. Connect with friends through the friend list, create private lobbies for personalized races and rally with Asphalt titans, perfect your drifts, and leave your lasting legacy on the racing track with your incredible drift maneuvers! Join or establish racing Clubs, unlocking exclusive rewards as you climb the leaderboards. Experience a new cooperative multiplayer mode where you can be a Security agent chasing down Syndicate members or one of the outlaws evading capture. 
Select Your Ultimate Racing Car and Dominate 
Harness the power of over 250 cars from elite manufacturers like Ferrari, Porsche, and Lamborghini, each meticulously crafted to push the boundaries of speed and performance. Conquer tracks inspired by iconic global locations, cherished by car racing enthusiasts worldwide, and showcase your drifting prowess on every curve, turning each corner into a perfect drift opportunity. 
Experience the Thrill of Absolute Racing Control
Feel the adrenaline rush as you and your team dive into electrifying online multiplayer car races, perform gravity-defying drifts and stunts, and power to victory with adrenaline-fueled boosts. Whether with precise manual control or the streamlined TouchDrive™, Asphalt Legends puts you in the driver's seat, ready to steal the spotlight in online races with your perfect drifts and unparalleled drift control! 
Arcade Racing at Its Finest
Dive into the adrenaline-fueled high-speed car racing world, featuring meticulously detailed vehicles, stunning effects, and vibrant dynamic lighting. Become one with the asphalt, perfect your drift techniques, and challenge the world like a true racing champion with your unmatched drifts and extraordinary drifting precision! 
Kick-Start Your Racing Legacy
Take the wheel and embark on your journey to greatness in Career mode. Navigate through endless seasons, conquering diverse challenges at every turn. Feel the rush of pulse-pounding events, complemented by a constant stream of limited-time challenges and activities to keep you on the edge of your seat. This is your chance to carve out a legacy that echoes throughout the world, marked by your signature drifts and legendary drifting achievements! 
Customize Your Ride, Dominate the Race
Personalize your car, then play online to showcase your style to your rivals with unique body paint, rims, wheels, and body kits! Show off your drift mastery, dominate the race with your exceptional drifting skills, and leave your competitors in awe of your flawless drift performance!
Please note that this game contains in-app purchases, including paid random items.

bluejetty:00017428:ios.description:
Enter a remote Alpine monastery and uncover the truth in a story-rich hidden object adventure. You are about to investigate the disappearance of a monk as well as the curious case of a weeping statue. 
Something strange lurks within the monastery walls—voices in empty corridors, tears from stone eyes. As the only one who can decode this mystery, you'll use your secret identity and keen perception to reveal a story of loss, betrayal, and dark devotion in this mysterious hidden object adventure game!
WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT
• Puzzle & mystery adventure — dozens of unique riddles and mini-games. 
• Intriguing narrative — a dramatic plot with twists and memorable characters.
• Challenge your mind with a variety of brain teasers, hidden object scenes, and mini-games
• Smart Hint – always know where to go next.
• Full voiceovers & HD visuals – immerse yourself in the story.
• Difficulty levels – from relaxed exploration to true challenge.
PERFECT FOR PLAYERS WHO WANT:
• Fully optimized for your iPad and iPad Pro — play on a big screen with stunning HD graphics and details!
• Play completely offline - Desktop, Phone & Tablet support — anytime, anywhere
• No data collection — your privacy is safe
• A hidden object puzzle adventure with a rich story.
• Try free, unlock full game once – no ads, no micro-transactions.
Gameplay
Tap to search scenes, collect clues, combine items from your inventory, and complete mini-games to progress the story. Use hints if you get stuck — but the reward is uncovering more of the mystery.
Play your way
Explore, investigate, find hidden objects and items, and solve puzzles and mini-games and reveal the mystery in your own way: adjustable challenge: Casual, Adventure, and Challenging difficulty modes. Win Achievements & Collectibles.
Atmospheric adventure
A gripping mystery adventure: narrative-driven game-play with a strong detective lead. Immersive locations waiting to be explored; seek, search and solve puzzles.
Why players love it
The combination of art and atmosphere and blend of story-driven adventure and classic puzzles and minigames. Whether you love relaxing hunts or challenge-driven puzzles, this game offers both.
Free to try
Try for free, then unlock the full game for the entire mystery — no distractions, just mystery to solve.

• INVESTIGATE the scene
• EXPLORE the mysterious monastery and its surroundings
• SEARCH for clues and FIND HIDDEN OBJECTS
• INTERROGATE the inhabitants
• FIND items and use them to progress
• SOLVE perplexing puzzles and dozens of mini-games
• EARN many different achievements

bluejetty:00062702:ios.name: SpaceStationAR LITE
bluejetty:00062702:ios.summary: SpaceStationAR is an augmented reality (AR) application that simulates the visibility of satellites in the night sky. With SpaceStationAR, you can easily spot the brilliant International Space Station, spectacular Starlink Trains, and vario
bluejetty:00062702:ios.description:
SpaceStationAR is an augmented reality (AR) application that simulates the visibility of satellites in the night sky. With SpaceStationAR, you can easily spot the brilliant International Space Station, spectacular Starlink Trains, and various satellites at the forefront of space exploration with your own eyes.
As your iPhone or iPad camera captures the scenery around you, SpaceStationAR overlays passes of the International Space Station, the Starlink Train (a group of Starlink satellites), and the Chinese Space Station onto the actual scenery. You can also use the app to find bright stars, galaxies, spacecrafts like Voyager 1 and Voyager 2, and even see the direction of major cities beyond the ground. SpaceStationAR also indicates the positions of geostationary satellites, making it a valuable tool for antenna installation. 
You can easily access satellite orbits on maps in addition to the AR views.
The "Calendar" tab displays events like upcoming satellite passes and rocket launches within the next two weeks. You can choose a pass from the list and simulate it in AR.
Apple Watch app and "Today" widget are also available. They show simple lists of satellites' passes.
LITE version has some restrictions. AR prediction stops 30 minutes before the passes. Full version without Ads and with the sky chat view is available on the store.
http://itunes.apple.com/app/torisat/id361194118?mt=8
List of Features
* AR simulation of satellite passes overlaid on real landscapes
* Display of stars, galaxies, black holes, planetary probes, satellites, and world cities in AR (Visibility can be customized by type)
* Visualization of satellite passes on maps
* Presentation of satellite orbits and current locations on a global map
* Calendar listing satellite passes within the next two weeks
* Support for newly launched satellites
* Offline app usage
* Satellite pass notifications: Set notification times from 15 minutes to 6 hours before the event for accurate alerts. (Please allow background location updates for precise notifications. Disabling this feature may lead to inaccurate notifications when traveling long distances with the app closed.)

bluejetty:00027054:ios.summary:
A remodeled 2D take on the first game in the world-renowned FINAL FANTASY series! Enjoy the timeless story told through charming retro graphics. All the magic of the original, with improved ease of play.
Earth, fire, water, wind... The lig
bluejetty:00027054:ios.description:
A remodeled 2D take on the first game in the world-renowned FINAL FANTASY series! Enjoy the timeless story told through charming retro graphics. All the magic of the original, with improved ease of play.
Earth, fire, water, wind... The light that once shone within the four Crystals was lost. Darkness covered the land, until the only hope for humanity rested in legends past. Become the Warriors of Light and embark on your own journey to restore power to the Crystals and save the world.
Switch between classes to improve your characters. Traverse the wide world with your airship and other vessels. Return to the game that started it all.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
■ Beautifully revived with new graphics and sound!
・Universally updated 2D pixel graphics, including the iconic FINAL FANTASY character pixel designs created by Kazuko Shibuya, the original artist and current collaborator.
・Beautifully rearranged soundtrack in a faithful FINAL FANTASY style, overseen by original composer Nobuo Uematsu.
■Improved gameplay!
・Including modernized UI, auto-battle options, and more.
・Also supports game pad controls, making it possible to play using a dedicated gamepad UI when connecting a gamepad to your device.
・Switch the soundtrack between the rearranged version, created for the pixel remaster, or the original version, capturing the sound of the original game.
・Now possible to switch between different fonts, including the default font and a pixel-based font based on the atmosphere of the original game.
・Additional boost features to expand gameplay options, including switching off random encounters and adjusting experience gained multipliers between 0 and 4.
・Dive into the world of the game with supplemental extras like the bestiary, illustration gallery, and music player.
*One-time purchase. The app will not require any additional payments to play through the game after the initial purchase and subsequent download.
*This remaster is based on the original "FINAL FANTASY" game released in 1987. Features and/or content may differ from previously rereleased versions of the game.
[OS Compatibility]
iOS 13.0 or higher
[Applicable Devices]
iPhone 6s, iPod touch (7th generation), iPad (5th generation), iPad Air 2, iPad mini 4 and higher

bluejetty:00027488:ios.description:
Awaken your brain and stay sharp with an endless selection of fun, exciting puzzles from the expert editors at PuzzleNation and Penny Dell Puzzles. This free app download offers unlimited new puzzles for every skill level. Puzzle types include favorites from top puzzle categories – word puzzles, number puzzles, logic puzzles, jigsaw puzzles and more! 
NEW PUZZLES DAILY
Enjoying puzzle solving with fresh daily content, keeping your mind engaged. Embrace the challenge and get a mental workout with new puzzles awaiting you every day. Solve and play at your own pace with each day’s exciting new puzzles.
CROSSWORDS
Explore the world of words with a variety of exhilarating crossword puzzles! There’s something for everyone. Choose from three different crosswords:
Daily POP Crosswords offers pop-culture themed puzzles including books, movies, TV and other fun themes.
Penny Dell Crosswords is perfect for lovers of classic crossword puzzles, as seen in newspapers and magazines.
Mini Crosswords is a fun, new, bite-sized crossword experience for fast-paced solving.
WORD SEARCH
Discover a world of hidden words in these captivating word search puzzles. Scan the grid, spot the words, and enjoy the satisfying thrill of solving each puzzle. Sharpen your visual observation skills, expand your vocabulary, and have fun forming words with letters in the puzzle grid. Choose from two different word search puzzle types:
Daily POP Word Search presents pop-culture themed puzzles including music, books, movies, sports and other fun themes.
Themed Word Search is a great choice for fans of the word search puzzles found in newspapers and magazines.
SUDOKU
Enter the world of Sudoku, where numbers rule – math skills not required! This addictive puzzle adventure will put your problem-solving talents to the test. Unleash your mental prowess as you strategically place numbers from one to nine. Every move counts as you strive to fill each row, column, and box correctly. Don’t worry, there are hints available to help you solve these challenging puzzles. Unlock the secrets of this timeless brain teaser!
FILL IN
Dive into the fantastic fun of Fill-Ins, a delightful twist on crossword puzzles. Instead of clues, you'll be given words to strategically place in the grid. Whether you're a puzzle aficionado or a newcomer, Fill-Ins offer an engaging challenge. No specific knowledge is required–everyone can solve them using clever solving strategies or by simple trial-and-error.
JIGSAW
Experience the thrill of jigsaw puzzles as scattered pieces unite to reveal breathtaking images of beautiful landscapes, adorable animals and more. bluejetty:00148987:ios.name: Vultisig: Seedless MPC Wallet
bluejetty:00148987:ios.summary: Vultisig is a seedless crypto wallet. No seed phrase to write down, phish, or lose. Your key exists as multiple shares across your own devices, and a threshold of them signs together. Multisig-style MPC security, open source, for Bitcoin, E
bluejetty:00148987:ios.description:
Vultisig is a seedless crypto wallet. No seed phrase to write down, phish, or lose. Your key exists as multiple shares across your own devices, and a threshold of them signs together. Multisig-style MPC security, open source, for Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana and 30+ chains.
Risk Warning: Cryptoassets are high-risk and largely unregulated. You are unlikely to be protected if something goes wrong. Don't invest unless you're prepared to lose all the money you invest. Cryptoassets are high-risk investments and you are unlikely to be protected if something goes wrong. Take 2 mins to learn more. 
Start in under a minute with a Fast Vault on one device. When the stakes grow, add devices: your phone, tablet and computer become co-signers, and moving money takes agreement between them.
WHY SEEDLESS
Think of a bank vault that needs 2 of 3 keys to open. One stolen key opens nothing. Vultisig works the same way: your private key never exists in one place, so malware, phishing and lost devices stop being catastrophic. A seed phrase is a single point of failure. We removed it.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
Send, receive, swap and stake. Native cross-chain swaps. Connect to web3 and DeFi apps. Your whole portfolio in one vault.
ONE VAULT, 30+ CHAINS
Bitcoin, Ethereum and EVM networks, Solana and the Cosmos ecosystem live side by side in one vault, with one signing flow for all of them. Adding a chain never means adding another wallet.
OPEN SOURCE
Everything is public at github.com/vultisig under the Apache 2.0 license. Never trust, verify.
FAQ
What is Vultisig?
A self-custody crypto wallet that replaces the seed phrase with key shares spread across your own devices. You hold every share. Nobody else can move your money.
Why is there no seed phrase?
A seed phrase is the easiest thing in crypto to steal. Vultisig never creates one, so there is nothing to phish and nothing to lose.
What does it cost?
Nothing. Vultisig is free and open source.
Which chains does Vultisig support?
Bitcoin, Ethereum and EVM networks, Solana and the Cosmos ecosystem, with 30+ chains in total. The full list lives at vultisig.com.
Which devices work together?
Your phone, tablet, computer and the browser extension. Any of them can be part of your vault.
One vault. Every device you own. No seed phrase anywhere. Download Vultisig and see for yourself.

bluejetty:00168624:android.description:
Feel like sorting things or having fun? Ball Sort will be a good choice if you are looking for an addictive color sorting game to challenge yourself and train your brain. 
With thousands of well-designed levels to play, Ball Sort will keep you entertained for hours. The game also helps you kill time when you are waiting for a bus, waiting in a long line or during a boring meeting. Play now and join the fun! 
KEY FEATURES
 - FREE and RELAXING color sorting game
 - TAP, TAP, TAP, one finger control to play
 - NO TIMER or MOVES limited, just enjoy it
 - Thousands of levels to play and challenge
 - Select the type of balls and tubes you like
 - Sharpen your mind in relaxing games
 - OFFLINE game, no need for Internet
 HOW TO PLAY
 - Tap any tube to pick up the top ball, then tap another tube to move it.

 - The balls of the same color are sorted into one tube, you win the level.
 - Use "Undo" to go back to previous steps.
 - Use "Add a tube" to help you get out of the stuck.
 - You can restart the level at any time.
If you have any questions or suggestions, please contact our support team at support@bidderdesk.com.

bluejetty:00092201:ios.description:
WSHU Public Radio App: 
The WSHU Public Radio App allows you to listen to WSHU live, pause and rewind the live audio, and view the program schedule for all the WSHU Public Radio Group streams at once! You can explore On Demand content, check out the latest WSHU news, find stories, bookmark a story for later, and wake up to WSHU with the alarm clock!
Live Streaming
• DVR-like controls (pause, rewind, and fast forward). You can pause the live stream to have a conversation and pick up right where you left off! Or rewind to catch a comment you just missed!
• Listen to live streams from WSHU Public Radio Group, even while traveling! Start the app and your favorite station starts playing – no clicks to start listening.
• Integrated program schedules for every station. You can display up to three of your favorites at a time or flick once to see the schedules for all of your favorite stations.
• One click stream switching – flip over to the program you noticed on another stream with a single click.
On Demand
• Access public radio programs from multiple content providers (NPR, PRI, APM and WSHU) easily and quickly.
• DVR-like controls. Pause, rewind and fast forward your program with ease. 
• When listening to national programs, individual story segments (when available) are listed so you can review and choose one or listen to the entire program.
• Easy to access past programs.
• The WSHU Public Radio App displays the web page associated with the program or story segment you are listening to On Demand so you can explore for more information.
Radio Bookmarks
• Save what you were listening to (Live or On Demand) so you can replay, follow-up, or share it later by simply clicking “Bookmark”.
• You can also access the Radio Bookmarks created on your iPhone/iPod on your computer. Just visit WSHU.org.
• Compatible with the popular Radio Bookmark device (www.radiobookmark.com).
Additional features
• Easily share stories and programs with family and friends via the “Share” button.
• A built in Sleep Timer and Alarm Clock allows you to go to sleep and wake up to your favorite station.
The WSHU Public Radio App is brought to you by the people at WSHU and Public Media Apps. We work to provide our valued listeners with great solutions to find what you want, when you want it, and where you want it.
Please support WSHU Public Radio by becoming a member today!
http://www.wshu.org
http://www.publicmediaapps.com
