bluejetty:00151725:ios.description:
HELLO BRAVE SOLDIER, WELCOME TO WAR ARENA!
War Arena: Survival FPS - a world of intense warfare for brave shooters to come and explore. This is an action shooting game where you play as a shooter defending your land against enemy battleships, fighter planes, battle tanks, robots, and rockets. There are so many powerful machine guns, and a variety of weapons are ready for the hero to pick up. Trying to survive till the end of every battle is your duty in War Arena!
HOW TO PLAY?
- In War Arena: Survival FPS, players have the task of protecting their ground, fighting against the onslaught of enemies by shooting and destroying their army.
- Fight back the enemy weapon systems such as MB78 tanks, Fuchs APCs with turrets and missile launchers, battleships, Cobra attack helicopters, CH53 Sikorsky, F101 jets, aircraft, and C-130 Hercules that transport rockets, bazookas, machine guns...
- At the beginning of War Arena, the enemy's military will appear sparsely along the beach, but as the tasks become more difficult in later stages, attackers become more numerous, and a rain of gunfire, rockets, missiles will pour down on your tank. You will see the invader’s helicopters and fighter planes everywhere in the sky, constantly throwing bullets at your position.
SOME KEY FEATURES:
- Over 10 different locations in War Arena: Survival FPS await you.
- Realistic weapons ranging from 50 mm, M60 machine gun, 75 mm AT, gatling machine guns to heat-fuse rockets, Javelin launchers, NLAW... Hundreds of fighters, more than 50 types of battle tanks, ships, guns, drones, along with other weapons and vehicles. Some of your weapons even have rockets attached to a side to strengthen your power.
- In each warfare in War Arena: Survival FPS, you will get support attacks from B58 bombers.
- You can also meet your comrade brothers from across the world.
Download and play War Arena: Survival FPS for free now!

Pay your bill, enroll in a payment program, report an outage and track its restoration, all with the new DTE Energy mobile app.

- Manage your saved payment methods 
- Get real-time account and payment related messages 
- Report a power outage, and dim or flickering lights 
- Report or get additional information on a gas leak or downed wire 
- Track restoration progress with updates via email, text or push notification 
- See what areas have outages and how many customers are affected 
- Look up nearby businesses to see which have power and their contact details
- Increase security while using the app with 1Password and enabling TouchID

bluejetty:00088040:ios.description:
Ti serve un taxi? Premi il pulsante di BTaxi e chiamerai il tuo taxi nel modo più semplice possibile.
Attenzione: BTaxi è utilizzabile, al momento, ad Alessandria, Torino, Empoli, Bologna e Barcellona
BTaxi nasce dall’esigenza, sempre più sentita dai clienti che utilizzano il taxi come mezzo di trasporto abituale, di ridurre i tempi di richiesta di un taxi, di avere a priori una stima sul costo della corsa e di trovare soddisfazione dal punto di vista della facilità dell’esperienza d’uso.
Cosa consente di fare:
- Preventivazione costo della corsa sulla base delle tariffe comunali in vigore, della geolocalizzazione e dell’inserimento della destinazione. 
- Premendo il pulsante nella schermata Home verrà inviata la richiesta e in pochi secondi si otterrà la conferma che prevede la ricezione del numero della corsa, della sigla e della licenza del taxi in arrivo e del tempo di attesa. Segui l’arrivo del tuo taxi visualizzando la distanza da te costantemente aggiornata, oppure sulla mappa.
La conferma del taxi in arrivo avviene con una notifica, con l’applicazione aperta oppure chiusa.
- Il taxi può essere pagato in diversi modi. Oltre ai contanti, è possibile pagare con carta di credito direttamente da BTaxi o per gli abbonati attraverso l’inserimento del codice abbonato, che permetterà a fine corsa di addebitare l’importo direttamente su un conto virtuale per essere poi fatturato a fine mese con il riepilogo delle corse effettuate.

bluejetty:00092421:ios.name: Endive - IBS Food Diary
bluejetty:00092421:ios.summary:
IBS tracker made easy. Learn how food affects your digestion. Simply track what you eat, your symptoms and moods and Endive will help you identify correlations in a visual graph form.
Food is a common trigger of digestive symptoms. Avoidin
bluejetty:00092421:ios.description:
IBS tracker made easy. Learn how food affects your digestion. Simply track what you eat, your symptoms and moods and Endive will help you identify correlations in a visual graph form.
Food is a common trigger of digestive symptoms. Avoiding certain foods or keeping a low FODMAP diet can dramatically improve issues like gas, bloating, stomach pain, diarrhoea, constipation and others.
However, everyone is different and there is no one-size-fits-all IBS diet: Keeping a diary of what you eat and how you feel is vital to learning what triggers your symptoms.
Take charge of your digestion and gut health.
PERSONALISED TRACKER 
Add custom foods and symptoms that are personal to you and track them together with the others. Endive knows recipes and breaks them down into ingredients to make IBS tracking faster and more efficient.
If you have a condition you know about, but want to optimise your diet to help improve your symptoms, Endive helps you keep track of what you have eaten and how you feel, both physically and psychologically. This allows you to learn how your body reacts to different foods, or which triggers (e.g. anxiety, depression) are causing you symptoms.
WIDE RANGING TRACKER
Endive helps you manage conditions such as:
• IBS (Irritable Bowel Syndrome)
• IBD (Inflammatory Bowel Disease)
• Food intolerance and sensitivities (such as Dairy, Wheat/Gluten, Lactose)
• Acid reflux
• Crohn’s disease
• Coeliac disease
• SIBO (Small Intestinal Bacterial Overgrowth)
• Ulcerative colitis
• Migraines & cluster headaches
• Skin issues (such as Eczema, Acne)
• Period / menstrual cycle related issues
• Bloating, heartburn, and many other digestive conditions
————————————————
We'd love to hear your thoughts!
Send your questions, feedback and bug reports to feedback@endive.app
————————————————

bluejetty:00185396:ios.description:
The Holiday Happenings App brings our entire range of fun-filled local activities, programs, and events right to the fingertips of our users. Full access to the app is free of charge giving all users the ability to: 
- access more detailed program information. 
- search and filter listings by name, category and age.
- view businesses offering FREE activities for kids.
- view activities closest to your location.
- save and quickly access your "favourites".
- contact activity providers from the app.
- access deals and promotions from holiday activity providers.
- access deals and promotions from other ACT businesses. 
Quickly and easily scroll the 'Activities Feed' through 16 categories and over 100 listings in the ACT region to find your child's next school holiday adventure.
Information is updated before every school holiday break so that parents can find all the latest information needed to get their kids involved. 
With a personalized "Favourites List", users can save activities for future reference and quickly access details without having to search for them again later on.
If it's happening during the school holidays, you'll find it at Holiday Happenings.
Currently ONLY available for the ACT Region
For our full privacy policy and terms of use visit https://www.holidayhappenings.com.au/apple-version-terms-conditions

bluejetty:00186432:ios.description:
Step into your greatness with Mindvalley, the world's most powerful transformational learning platform.
Most people spend their entire lives wondering what they're truly capable of. Mindvalley exists for the ones who decide to find out.
Mindvalley is built for people who refuse to settle for ordinary. Whether you want to rewire your mindset, heal your body, deepen your relationships, build wealth, or simply wake up feeling alive again - Mindvalley brings the world's greatest teachers directly to you.
Learn from Vishen Lakhiani, Lisa Nichols, Jim Kwik, Marisa Peer, Paul McKenna, Sadhguru, Keith Ferrazzi, Tony Robbins, and more. These are not motivational speakers. These are the people who have dedicated their lives to unlocking human potential - and they are here, in your pocket, every single day.
This is not a meditation app. This is not a course platform. Mindvalley is a complete system for becoming the person you've always known you could be.
What's inside:
Quests™ - Mindvalley's flagship transformation programs. Multi-week, expert-led journeys designed to create permanent change across every dimension of your life: mindset, health, relationships, career, spirituality, and purpose. Not content to consume. Experiences that transform.
Meditation & Healing - Hundreds of guided meditations, hypnotherapy sessions, Paul McKenna's mind-reprogramming techniques, Marisa Peer's Rapid Transformational Therapy, chakra balancing, sound healing, breathwork, and Reveri experiences. Fall asleep faster, quiet anxious thoughts, and lower daily stress — tools for real relief, available any time you need them.
Eve AI - Your personal transformation companion, powered by machine learning. Eve learns who you are, where you're stuck, and what you're reaching for — then builds a completely personalised learning path around your goals. Not generic. Not one-size-fits-all. Yours.
Live Events & Global Community - Mindvalley is not just an app. It's a movement. Join live workshops, global masterclasses, and in-person events with a worldwide community of growth-oriented people who will challenge, inspire, and genuinely change you.
Growth Across Every Area of Life - Mind. Body. Soul. Manifesting. Entrepreneur & AI. Speaking & Authorship. Longevity. Mindvalley covers the full spectrum of what it means to live an extraordinary life.
The people who change their lives are not the ones who waited for the right moment. They are the ones who started.
Great change starts here.
---
Subscription plans in the app are strictly processed via your App Store account and will automatically renew under Apple's terms and conditions. 
All in-app purchases on your Mindvalley account will adhere to the App Store’s payment, subscription, and refund policies. 
You can manage your subscription plans in your App Store account settings.
Privacy Policy: https://www.mindvalley.com/privacy-policy
Terms & Conditions: https://www.mindvalley.com/terms-and-conditions

bluejetty:00018617:ios.description:
Say “yes!” to living your best low-carb or keto life with the Diet Doctor app. You’ll get everything you need to succeed, lose weight, and improve your health.
What you’ll get:
- Personalized meal plans: Tell us about your goals, and we’ll make you a custom meal plan!*
- 1000+ free and delicious low-carb and keto recipes.
- 130+ Diet Doctor-tested meal plans with recipes and nutritional information you can trust — backed by the world’s leading experts on low carb and keto.
- helpful tips and evidence-based information
- easy weight tracking*
- visual guides that let you see how many carbs, or how much protein, are in common foods.
-access to a dynamic and supportive in-app community, Connect, of others doing the low-carb or keto diet.* Moderated by Diet Doctor staff, Connect is a safe place to ask questions, share progress, trouble-shoot challenges, get inspiration, and celebrate triumphs.
- The meal plans and recipes allow you to select your desired number of servings and have your weekly planning, recipes, and shopping lists all done for you.*
- Our shopping list feature works even offline.* Plus you are able to save your favorite low-carb and keto recipes — all in one place.*
This app is available in English, Swedish and Spanish.
* Requires a Diet Doctor membership. Not yet a member? Sign up for a one-month FREE trial to get started right away.
Why Diet Doctor?
Diet Doctor is the world’s #1 keto & low-carb site. Our goal is to empower people everywhere to revolutionize their health by making low-carb and keto simple.
Strict keto, moderate, or liberal low carb — you decide! We do the planning so you can focus on cooking, eating, and enjoying delicious and nutritious food.
Millions of people have used our site to lose weight, reverse their type 2 diabetes, normalize their blood pressure, or change their lives for the better in other ways.
If you’re interested in low carb or keto, we’ll help make your journey simple and inspiring.
1000+ LOW-CARB AND KETO RECIPES
Quick breakfasts, luxurious brunches, hearty dishes, simple snacks, and gorgeous desserts — all low in carbs! Search for an ingredient or dish type, browse vegetarian or dairy-free recipes, or dig into our seasonal collections to find new favorites. Grocery shopping is easy. Simply add all recipe ingredients to your shopping list.
MEAL PLANNER TOOL
With a Diet

bluejetty:00140380:ios.summary: School Run Boy: Life Simulator: Chase lets you step into the shoes of a clever student trying to outsmart teachers and avoid getting caught. After getting into trouble with your teachers, you need to run through various learning spaces, sol
bluejetty:00140380:ios.description:
School Run Boy: Life Simulator: Chase lets you step into the shoes of a clever student trying to outsmart teachers and avoid getting caught. After getting into trouble with your teachers, you need to run through various learning spaces, solve puzzles, and dodge obstacles in this fun chase game. Your goal is to navigate the building and make your escape in this exciting adventure filled with thrilling moments.
As you dash through different study areas, be mindful of desks, chairs, and books. You’ll need to think fast and be quick on your feet to avoid being spotted by teachers. Just like in a clown run, your agility is crucial for getting away! Use your skills to cleverly outsmart the obstacles in your path.
Can you master dodging and escaping like in a brothers runaway story or a thrilling high school running game? You’ll also need to discover hidden items, like a cuban link, to aid your journey. Keep your wits about you and try to escape before you get caught, as in many exciting survival games!
Packed with exciting gameplay, School Run Boy: Life Simulator: Chase offers a thrilling experience for fans of survival games. Whether you're playing like a scuf pro or just looking for fun, this game will keep you entertained. Experience the thrill of escaping in this ultimate chase adventure. Are you ready to help your character outrun the teachers and enjoy the adventure of escape? With each challenge, you’ll find new ways to enhance your skills in this exhilarating chase!
Fans of escape games and survival games will love this unique experience. Join the fun and see if you have what it takes to navigate without getting caught by the teachers. Don’t miss your chance to become the master of escape and enjoy one of the most engaging survival games in the genre!

bluejetty:00160643:ios.description:
Get ready to build the most exciting alpaca empire! Take care of amazing alpacas. Build and expand your farm. Beat the competition in exciting trade shows.
You will build an alpaca paradise, with stables, shearing rooms, spa, fitness room, … All your amazing animals generate lots of wool, that you craft into fashionable wares for the market. Hire sales managers to sell your wares on the market and earn money to expand in your farm.
Features:
BUILD - your alpaca shelter. Install new stables, workshops and facilities for animal care.
GROW - your herd to see new unique alpacas emerge from the hay day by day.
DESIGN - your booth for the trade shows to maximise sales and earn the best rewards.
UPGRADE - every part of your alpaca farm to take control of new and bigger markets.
CARE - for your alpacas in the spa to get the best out of every animal on your farm.
SELL - your products at trade shows and earn enough to boost your farm to the next level. 
DEVELOP - your product portfolio to make more sales than your competitors.
DECORATE - your farm and surroundings in different styles.
CRAFT - new decorations for your booth by recycling old ones.
Only the best alpacas and products will sell on the market as there is stiff competition! Add more and more attractive alpacas to your herd, offer high quality woollen crafts and use your most charismatic sellers to win on the market.
There is always something to do! Your employees will take care of the animals, design new garments, develop marketing gadgets to beat the competition, craft new decorations for your market stalls and sell the products on-line.
Become a farm owner - build and grow your alpaca empire 
What are you waiting for? Pre-order your new alpaca farm adventure now!
Please note Alpaca Farm is a free-to-play experience, but some game items are available for purchase using real money. A network connection is also required. See our terms of service for full details: https://www.saltcastlestudio.com/termsofservice/
Questions about the game? Ask our support team: support@saltcastlestudio.com

bluejetty:00096160:ios.name: PDF Editor | Files Converter
bluejetty:00096160:ios.summary: How do you convert a Word document to PDF on your phone? What if you need to compress a large file before emailing it? PDF Converter handles document conversion, compression, and editing directly on your iPhone without requiring desktop sof
bluejetty:00096160:ios.description:
How do you convert a Word document to PDF on your phone? What if you need to compress a large file before emailing it? PDF Converter handles document conversion, compression, and editing directly on your iPhone without requiring desktop software or internet connection.
Whether you are a student submitting assignments, a business professional sharing contracts, or someone who frequently works with documents on mobile, this app processes your files locally with professional-grade results.
HOW IT WORKS
The app uses native iOS document processing frameworks to convert between file formats without uploading your documents to external servers. When you select a Word document, the conversion engine analyzes the formatting, fonts, and layout structure to create an identical PDF version. Compression works by analyzing image quality, removing redundant data, and optimizing file structure while maintaining readability. Most conversions complete within 10-15 seconds depending on document size and complexity.
KEY FEATURES
— Word to PDF Conversion: Upload DOCX files from Files app, email attachments, or cloud storage and convert them to PDF format while preserving original formatting, fonts, and image placement.
— Adjustable File Compression: Reduce PDF file sizes by 50-90 percent using three compression levels for different content types and size reduction needs.
— Page Management Tools: Add blank pages, delete unwanted pages, duplicate existing pages, or rearrange page order by dragging and dropping within the document preview.
— Direct Email Integration: Share converted or edited documents through the built-in email composer without switching between apps.
— Batch Processing Support: Convert multiple Word documents to PDF simultaneously, or compress several large files at once to save time.
WHO USES THIS APP
Students who need to convert Word assignments to PDF format for submission through learning management systems that only accept PDF files. Business professionals who receive Word contracts via email and need to convert them to PDF for client sharing or digital signatures. Freelancers who create proposals in Word but need to deliver final versions as PDFs to prevent client editing. Remote workers who frequently email large documents and need compression to stay within attachment limits.
HOW TO GET STARTED
1. Download and open the app
2. Tap Convert and select your Word document from Files, email, or cloud storage
3. Choose your conversion settings and compression level, then share or save
SUBSCRIPTION
Annual Plan: $9.99 per year — less than $1 per month
Weekly Plan: $4.99 per week with 3-day free trial
Payment charged to iTunes Account at purchase confirmation. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the current period ends. Account charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of current period. Manage subscription and turn off auto-renew in iTunes Account settings.
DISCLAIMER
This app is designed as a productivity tool for document conversion and editing, not a replacement for professional document management software. Word and PDF are trademarks of their respective owners.
Privacy Policy: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ErOkSH_yYOdicFoQZxmDK1h5278j7WKxePYkJMPzpBQ/edit?usp=sharing
Terms of Use: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ihjBCAjaxUDUeGvnCKROsw7c02h5NNkI-UPRBSetgv4/edit?usp=sharing

Zoom Workplace brings video meetings, chat, phone, appointment scheduler, email, and collaborative documents together in a single app. With Zoom AI built in to help you take notes, summarize, write, and organize, you can get more done without the busy work.*
Power Your Work with AI 
• Capture every conversation: Whether you're hosting or joining, My Notes can automatically take notes during your Zoom Meetings and in-person conversations, so you can stay focused instead of scribbling.
• Catch up instantly: Get automatic meeting summaries and next steps sent to you after the call, so you don’t have to take notes again.
• Ask questions live: Missed something? Ask AI Companion questions like "What did I miss?" or "Was my name mentioned?" during a meeting without interrupting.
• Draft in seconds: Let AI embedded in Zoom Workplace compose emails, chat responses, and whiteboard ideas for you with a simple prompt.
• Summarize threads: Instantly turn long chat threads or SMS conversations into a quick summary so you can get the gist fast.
Seamless Communication
• Connect with anyone: Host or join meetings with crystal-clear video and audio, and work like you're side-by-side with immersive views.
• Stay in sync: Use Zoom Chat to message individuals or groups, organize conversations with channels, and share files instantly.
• Make business calls: Handle calls with Zoom Phone, a robust VoIP solution.*
• Update asynchronously: Record and share Clips—short video messages and screen recordings—to provide updates that your team can watch on their own time.
Next-Gen Collaboration
• Create together: Draft, edit, and collaborate on Docs in real-time, right inside your meetings.
• Brainstorm freely: Use Whiteboard to map out ideas with sticky notes and shapes—or ask AI Companion to generate a mind map for you instantly.
• Share information: Co-edit files and wikis that live right next to your team’s video interface so you never lose context.
Productivity & Organization
• Manage your day: Bring your email and calendar into one unified view to schedule meetings and check messages without switching apps.
• Stop the scheduling ping-pong: Use Zoom Scheduler to share your availability and let others book time slots that work for everyone.*
• Use Zoom AI agentic skills to answer questions like “summarize today's meetings” to instantly connect the dots across your workflows.
Zoom Workplace Pro
Unlock the full experience with a paid subscription:
• Core AI features embedded across Zoom Workplace
• Host unlimited meetings up to 30 hours each.
• Cloud recording storage to save and share your meetings.
• Grant co-hosting and scheduling permissions to other users.
Subscription Information: Zoom Workplace offers free and paid plans. Your Zoom Workplace Pro subscription will automatically renew unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the free trial or the plan billing period. After you start your subscription, you can manage it from either App Store settings or iOS settings. The amount charged to the payment method in your App Store account will vary by the plan you select and your country. The plan price will be displayed before you start your free trial or confirm your purchase.
Privacy & Terms: By installing the app, you agree to these terms and conditions: 
https://www.zoom.com/en/trust/privacy/privacy-statement/
https://www.zoom.com/en/trust/terms/
* Some features may require an additional add-on or paid license for access or to remove usage limitations. Availability and functionality may vary based on your subscription or license type.

bluejetty:00014131:ios.description:
With BooksRun, selling your used books and college textbooks has never been easier!
BooksRun gives books a new life and helps you earn extra cash. By prioritizing used books and extending their life cycle, it makes reading more accessible, affordable, and sustainable. 
► SELL BOOKS
The BooksRun book scanner app allows you to quickly sell books, both fiction and nonfiction—from last-semester textbooks and college materials (e.g., business, science, medicine, law, etc.) to trade books in all popular genres (e.g., thriller, horror, romantasy, science fiction, manga, and comics). 
BooksRun mobile scanner is a handy tool favored by book scouts, casual sellers, and book lovers. It’s especially helpful for those selling college textbooks; therefore, it’s a go-to solution for students, too. 
► HOW TO USE
The BooksRun app has a mobile barcode scanner and buyback book price checker, allowing instant access to the current buyback price information. To sell your book, follow these steps:
1. Scan the barcode or type the ISBN into the search field.
2. Get an instant buyback quote.
3. Ship your used books for FREE using a QR code and a prepaid shipping label.
4. Get cash for books once the order is processed (by check or PayPal within 2 business days).
► KEY FEATURES
Sell books or textbooks instantly—BooksRun offers the best prices and pays for shipping. All you need is a smartphone and a working Internet connection. The app is 100% FREE to download and use! 
- Barcode/ISBN scanner—No need to enter ISBNs manually. Scan items quickly.
- Built-in keypad—Type ISBNs faster by using 978 or X shortcuts.
- Best prices—Get the best offers for your old copies compared to other book-selling platforms.
- Free shipping—We provide FREE shipping on all buyback orders!
- Prompt and secure pay-outs—The swift transaction to your PayPal or by check.
- Eco-friendly—Help keep the cycle of book resell going and give them a new life.
Sell your books anytime and anywhere. Download the app now and join thousands of happy booksellers who are earning with ease!
BooksRun also helps you buy or rent books and textbooks. Visit the BooksRun platform for more services: https://booksrun.com/. 
Terms and Conditions: https://booksrun.com/page/terms-and-conditions 
Privacy Policy: https://booksrun.com/page/privacy-policy 
Have any questions or suggestions? Feel free to email us at info@booksrun.com.

bluejetty:00086248:ios.name: Vibe City — online RP
bluejetty:00086248:ios.summary:
In Vibe City, you can be whoever you want to be. Craft your ideal look with exclusive skins and accessories, pick your dream car, and show off your style to the whole open world online!
Explore a vast online open world where every house, s
bluejetty:00086248:ios.description:
In Vibe City, you can be whoever you want to be. Craft your ideal look with exclusive skins and accessories, pick your dream car, and show off your style to the whole open world online!
Explore a vast online open world where every house, street, and building is waiting for your attention. With an atmospheric map and detailed interiors, the city is ready to become part of your story. This city can be yours — all you have to do is claim it. What will be your story? Shooting your way to the top? Racing night streets of your one-state with your friends and gang?
- The choice is yours
You decide who you’ll become in Vibe City. Choose from a variety of starting professions: miner, builder, logger, truck driver, or cash transporter. Want more? Set ambitious goals and carve your path to success! Join the police to protect the citizens, or choose the criminal path and become part of a dangerous gang. But remember: every decision has consequences!
In Vibe City, a realistic economy means your efforts directly impact your earnings and opportunities. Whether through trade, services, or criminal activity, your actions shape the world around you. Will you build a successful business or dive into shady, probably criminal deals? The choice is yours!
- Race the streets
You can’t get far without a car. Buy or win an awesome ride, upgrade the engine, enhance its performance, and add custom body kits like spoilers, bumpers, and side skirts. Paint it any color you like, wrap it in vinyl, and deck it out with stickers. Show off your creative side and flaunt your unique car that no one else has. Then, hit the streets and race or drift through the city with your friends! Vibe City is all about fun, and cars play a big role in that.
 - Play with friends and find new ones
Team up with others to achieve more! Gather your friends, create a family or gang, own joint properties, build a shared car fleet, and run a business together. Explore the world, take part in events, and create your story as a team!
- We’re committed to making Vibe City even better!
Our developers actively listen to the community and welcome your feedback.
Expect regular updates with new features to keep the game fresh and exciting.
Join our community, share your ideas, and be part of shaping the future of the game.
Vibe City is a place where every day can be the start of something new. Explore the world, participate in events, live the life you’ve dreamed of, and enjoy every moment.
Our reality is virtual, but it feels real!
See you in Vibe City!

Whether you’re paying vendors or collecting client payments, Melio puts cash flow con
bluejetty:00089602:ios.description:
Melio is the all-in-one accounts payable and receivable platform that gives businesses the flexibility to pay and get paid their way—all from your phone.
Whether you’re paying vendors or collecting client payments, Melio puts cash flow control in your pocket with greater visibility and flexibility. Sign up and get started directly in the app in minutes.
AUTOMATE BILL PAYMENTS
• Easy bill upload: Capture bills instantly with your camera and upload them to your dashboard.
• Flexible payment options: Pay by ACH, card, check, or wire with expedited options up to instant payments. Your vendor still gets paid how they want, while Melio takes care of the complexity in between.
• Pay vendors globally: Send payments to global vendors in over 80 countries in their preferred currency with competitive exchange rates.
• Approve payments anywhere: Review and approve team payments with a swipe, based on approval workflows you control.
• Schedule and combine: Schedule payments in advance and easily process multiple bills at once.
• Maximize cash flow: Use your credit card to pay bills (even where cards aren’t accepted) to hold onto cash longer and earn rewards.
GET PAID FAST
• Create invoices on the go: Generate professional invoices in seconds and send them via email or link.
• Accept online payments fast: Send clients a custom link via text or email to get paid digitally, fast. You choose who pays card processing fees, and the money goes directly to your bank account.
• Track every dollar: See incoming payment statuses from scheduled and sent, to when you can expect funds to arrive.
MANAGE IT ALL IN ONE PLACE
• 2-way auto sync: Melio syncs seamlessly with QuickBooks and Xero to keep your books accurate and streamline reconciliation. (requires set-up in web browser)
• Total visibility: Get real-time notifications for money coming in and going out.
• Secure & trusted: Melio is trusted by top financial institutions and technology platforms including Capital One, Shopify, and Gusto, and received the 2025 FinTech Award for Best U.S. SMB Payment Solutions Platform from Wealth & Finance International
Download Melio today to pay and get paid on your own terms.

bluejetty:00070207:ios.description:
Los días de escribir en diminutos papeles rotos y elegir entre la maloliente gorra de béisbol de alguien quedaron atrás. ¡Nuestra nueva y mejorada versión de Charades te permite sumergirte directamente en las risas y los buenos momentos! Perfecto para cualquier tipo de reunión: ¡hay categorías para cualquier ocasión!
Usa tu imaginación y sé creativo para cantar, bailar, actuar, dibujar, describir o incluso dar pistas a la persona que adivina. Sea cual sea el medio que elijas, ¡recuerda hacerlo rápido antes de que se acabe el tiempo!
Impresionantes características de la aplicación:
- Cantidad ilimitada de jugadores
- Más de 16 categorías para elegir
- Categorías aptas para niños y familias
- Juego ilimitado, sin anuncios
Cómo jugar:
1. Elige una categoría
2. Seleccione el jugador uno: pídale que coloque el teléfono en la frente horizontalmente
3. ¡Listos, listos, ya!
4. Todos los jugadores dan pistas para ayudar al jugador uno a adivinar el objeto que tienen en la frente antes de que se acabe el tiempo.
- Si el jugador uno adivina correctamente, inclina el teléfono hacia abajo/adelante.
- Si el jugador uno no está seguro, incline el teléfono hacia arriba para indicar el siguiente elemento.
5. Una vez que se acabe el tiempo, ¡mira la puntuación que obtuviste!
- Pasar el teléfono al siguiente jugador.
Para acceder a todas las características, el contenido y la funcionalidad de Charades, puede suscribirse a una suscripción anual renovable automáticamente. Esta es una transacción recurrente que se cargará a su cuenta de iTunes en la confirmación de la compra y se renovará automáticamente a menos que la cancele al menos 24 horas antes del final de su suscripción. Las renovaciones tendrán el mismo costo dentro de las 24 horas anteriores al final del período actual. Puede administrar sus suscripciones y la renovación automática se puede desactivar yendo a la configuración de su cuenta de iTunes después de la compra.

bluejetty:00016298:ios.description:
If you’re a dog person and think you know everything about man’s best friend, your world is about to be rocked! Mix puppy breeds like you’ve never seen before and discover a whole new canine dimension that will leave you barking in such awe: the possibilities are much wow!
Dachshunds, beagles, corgies and retrievers are so last week. Evolved dogs should have an extra eye or two so they can watch over their human friends more efficiently, or a handy horn just in case they get into the odd bar skirmish with a mutant unicorn. It’s your duty to let the dogs out and help them evolve!
DOGE FEATURES
• Pantheon: a new place for supreme beings to look down on us mortals and laugh at our misery
• Impostors: watch out for impostors trying to steal the spotlight from the puppies
HOW TO PLAY
• Drag and drop similar puppies to create new mysterious doges
• Use dog eggs to earn coins, buy new creatures and make even more money
• Alternatively, fiercely tap a rabbit to make coins pop from their eggs
HIGHLIGHTS
• Different stages and many dog species to discover
• A mind-blowing story with surprising twists
• The unexpected mix of alpaca-like evolution and incremental clicker games
• Doodle-like illustrations
• Various possible endings: find your destiny
• No dogs were harmed in the making of this game, only developers
The dog days have just begun! Much fun such wow!
Disclaimer: While this App is completely free to play, some additional content can be purchased for real money in-game. If you do not want to use this feature, please turn off in-app purchases in your device's settings.

bluejetty:00063071:ios.description:
Turn every dice roll into a winning opportunity in this fast-paced business strategy board game! Compete in thrilling multiplayer matches, make clever investments, negotiate smart trades, and rise from a small investor to a powerful tycoon. Challenge friends, test your strategy against real players, and enjoy endless competitive fun with exciting twists, rewards, and unpredictable gameplay that keeps every match fresh.
Relive one of the most iconic board game series of all time, the classic Business game: Monopolist. Perhaps the best-known of all modern board games, Business is the game of buying and selling real estate. Snap up as many squares of land, utilities and railroads.
The objective of the game is to be the last player remaining with any money.
Business is derived from The Landlord's Game.
Wheel and deal as you build your fortune playing an exciting game of Business online: Monopolist. Buy up whole neighbourhoods, charge rent, and watch your empire grow. It's all about making deals and making money. But don't land in Jail! 
You better keep an eye on your money, because you never know when the dice will land you with a massive rent bill to pay.
Business Game: Monopolist is a great game for 2 - 6 players. It is a board game where players roll two six-sided dice to move around the game board, buying and trading properties, and develop them with houses and hotels. Players collect rent from their opponents, with the goal being to drive them into bankruptcy. Money can also be gained or lost through Chance and Community Chest cards, and tax squares; players can end up in jail, which they cannot move from until they have met one of several conditions. There are other places on the board which can not be bought, but instead require the player to draw a card and perform the action on the card, pay taxes, collect income, or even go to jail.
Play with your Facebook friends, against the computer, against your friends in Local Multiplayer or with millions of Business players around the world in Online Multiplayer Mode.
You can also create Private Rooms and invite your friends to play in Play with Friends Mode.
Business Board Game is the fast-dealing property trading game that your will have the whole family buying, selling and having a blast!
Business! There’s no better board game you can play with your friends and/or family when you want to spend a good few hours locked in a bitter class struggle until one person eventually emerges as both tycoon and victor – and thus, capitalism! 
Pass Go, take a Chance card, and you might just build the property of your dreams…or you might end up in Jail! Whatever happens, it's fun all the way to the top! 
So why not make it a reality by playing this game and reliving your childhood days?
Download Business Family Dice Game for free today!

1. Play with Facebook Friends or as Guest 
2. Create Private Room and Invite Friends and Family
3. Play with players across the world
4. 2, 3, 4, 5 or 6 Player Mode 
5. Play Local Multiplayer
Please don't forget to Rate and Review Business, we aim to make it one of the best board games out there.
Any suggestions? We always love to hear from you for making this game better.
Enjoy playing Business Game: Monopolist!!

bluejetty:00190367:android.summary: SURE Universal is the world-leading and award-winning Universal Remote Control App for home entertainment and smart home. SURE can send music, videos and photos to a Smart TV and other smart media devices. Legacy devices are supported using
bluejetty:00190367:android.description:
SURE Universal is the world-leading and award-winning Universal Remote Control App for home entertainment and smart home. SURE can send music, videos and photos to a Smart TV and other smart media devices. Legacy devices are supported using Infra Red (IR) using a phone with a built-in IR Blaster or a WiFi-to-IR converter (sold separately) . You can also control your smart home devices with the power of your voice using SURE voice control. SURE Universal™ is truly an all-in-one home IoT solution – the soul of IoT.
★ SURE Universal™ Makes Your Smart Home Simple ★ 
SURE Universal is easy to use! Within minutes of downloading, you can control your smart TV, media streamer, smart lights, air conditioner and more. 
★ Voice Control ★ 
Use voice commands inside the app! No need for integration with external voice assistants.
★ Media Player★ 
Conveniently browse and play your music and video by folder. 
SURE Universal media player supports all Popular Audio/Video formats. 
★ Stream Photos and Videos from Your Phone to a Smart TV ★ 
Stream audio, video and photos from your phone directly to your Smart devices with the built-in media player using WiFi and DLNA. Your favorite photos and videos look good on your phone, but they will look spectacular on a large, high-resolution TV screen. 
★ File Copy with Shared Network ★ 
Copy files from shared folders in a local network to your mobile device and from your mobile device to a local network.
★ SURE Universal - How it Works ★ 
SURE Universal works best on smartphones equipped with an Infra-Red (IR) blaster. For phones with no IR, you can use a Broadlink WiFi-to-IR converter (https://www.sureuniversal.com/ir-solution/) to enjoy all of the features. Using WiFi, you can control numerous smart TVs and media streamers, such as Samsung, LG, Android, Roku, Kodi, and Amazon FireTV. 
★ SURE Customer Support ★
We are here anytime to answer all customer requests and suggestions. Please write a review on the Google Play Store or email us at support@sureuniversal.com.
We maintain a large database of approximately one million IR appliances, however, some devices may be missing. If you can’t find your device, please send your device brand and model information to us at support@sureuniversal.com.
For more information please visit: https://www.sureuniversal.com/support-training
★ User Permissions ★
We have a strict privacy policy (see the web site link below), with no unauthorized access to user data, and no sign-in required to operate the remote control. When installing we ask user permissions for the following:
1. Identity - for billing in case you want to subscribe to the ad-free version
2. Location - For advertising and future IoT 
3. Photos/Media/Files - for streaming media from the phone to a Smart TV
4. Microphone - access to the microphone for voice commands
5. WiFi - for connecting to a Smart TV
6. Device ID & Call Info - for muting a Smart TV when your phone rings (enabled via settings)

bluejetty:00046428:ios.description:
Easily scan any QR code or barcode to access menus, product details, or find content online in seconds. You can also create custom QR codes to share your location, Wifi network, or business cards. The app is simple, powerful, and has everything you need. 
Key Features:
1. ScanShield for Safe Scanning
Take the guesswork out of scanning with the ScanShield feature, which verifies whether a QR code's destination is safe before you visit. No more worrying about malicious links—ScanShield will prompt you if the link is unsafe, giving you control over whether to visit the site or not.
2. Fast QR & Barcode Scanning
Scan QR codes to instantly access websites, contact cards, WiFi networks and more. Scan barcodes to access product information, including brand name, rating, ingredients, and more.
3. Create Custom QR Codes
Easily create personalized QR codes using templates, with the ability to configure logos, background color, and more.
4. Saved History
Find all your past scans in the history tab - every code you've scanned or created is saved forever. 
5. Dark Mode
Make nighttime scanning easier on your eyes with Dark Mode. The darker theme reduces brightness and eye strain while maintaining perfect scanning accuracy. 
6. Easy Sharing
Share any code instantly - tap once to send via text, email, or your favorite social apps. Perfect for sharing Wi-Fi codes with guests or sharing your contact information. 
By using this app, you agree to:

Our Terms of Service: https://aibarcodescanner.com/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00175311:ios.name: Love's Rewards
bluejetty:00175311:ios.developer: Love's Travel Stops & Country Stores, Inc.
bluejetty:00175311:ios.summary: Find your favorite Love’s Travel Stops, check your Love's Rewards account, secure the next shower with Mobile Shower Check In, activate commercial fuel pumps with Love’s Mobile Pay, view transaction and loyalty receipts, map your route, vie
bluejetty:00175311:ios.description:
Find your favorite Love’s Travel Stops, check your Love's Rewards account, secure the next shower with Mobile Shower Check In, activate commercial fuel pumps with Love’s Mobile Pay, view transaction and loyalty receipts, map your route, view real-time fuel prices, request Truck Tire Care roadside assistance and connect with our customer service team using the Love’s App. It’s the ultimate travel app for professional drivers, and your mobile guide to our Love’s Travel Stops & Country Stores.
No matter where you are in the country, the Love’s App finds the nearest Travel Stops, RV Stops and Country Stores based upon your location, city, state or zip code. Also view distances in road miles, and in just a few more taps, get driving directions too. You can search by highway, on-site restaurants, fuel type, shower facilities and other store amenities.
Love's Rewards
We remain committed to our professional drivers, while also now expanding Love's Rewards benefits to casual drivers. Earn points on fuel and merchandise. Scan the Love's App barcode in-store, earn points on every trip, and spend points just like cash.
View & Share Digital Receipts
Receive digital receipts for all Pay at the Pump, In-Store and Mobile Pay transactions within minutes of your purchase. All you have to do is scan your Love's Rewards card with every transaction.
Mobile Shower Check-In
Bypass the fuel desk with shower check-in at your favorite Love’s Travel Stop with showers. First, be on-site at a location with showers. Then, tap the blue Shower Check In button on the Home or Store Details screen. Once your location has been confirmed, our commercial drivers can complete the transaction with your Love's Rewards shower credits and/or points. You can also plan ahead by checking busy times at other locations.
Love’s Mobile Pay for Commercial Drivers
Activate the pump from the comfort and safety of your cab with Love’s Pay. Select your pump and fuel, and then answer the prompts as you do at the pump today. Once authorized, lift the nozzle and fuel. You may also add and manage commercial fuel cards in your wallet, as well as view and share transaction and loyalty receipts.
Mobile Deals
Take advantage of our always new mobile deals. Deals are categorized by the type of food or drink you may be craving on the road. By using the Deals Barcode, you get quick and easy redemption of our mobile deals.
Real-Time Fuel Prices
The Love’s App features real-time fuel prices for every single one of our travel stops. Watch fuel prices along your planned route to help you make better fueling decisions along the way.
Love's Services
We offer indispensable solutions that keep you and your truck running at peak performance. Connect with Truck Care centers or request roadside assistance, as well as get started with Love's Express billing program details, or Love's Financial freight factoring.
RV Experience
Find nearby Love’s RV stops, view available sites, and reserve your spot in just a few taps. Simply select your desired location and launch the CampLife reservation flow directly from the app. You can also filter the stores map by the RV amenities you need so you can plan your stop with confidence.
Clean Places & Friendly Faces
At Love’s we know your time is valuable. We want to know when we have done a great job and when we haven’t. Use our feedback section to help us improve your Love’s experience.

bluejetty:00034510:ios.description:
Test your general knowledge with our exciting trivia quiz game! ONE Second - an incredible guessing trivia game tailor-made for all quiz lovers.

Challenge your mind with hundreds of diverse quizzes in the One Second Quiz. Guess answers to questions spanning topics such as music, movies, logos, flags, general knowledge, and more.

bluejetty:00178706:ios.description:
Protect your sensitive PDF documents with strong password encryption or remove passwords from PDFs you own with just a few taps. PDF Lock & Unlock is a fast, secure, and easy-to-use tool designed to help you manage PDF security anytime, anywhere.
Key Features:
*** Lock PDF Files ***
Add password protection to PDF documents
Encrypt confidential files and prevent unauthorized access
Secure business, personal, and financial documents
*** Unlock PDF Files ***
Remove PDF passwords from files you have permission to access
Instantly unlock protected PDFs for easier sharing and editing
Fast and reliable PDF decryption
*** Simple & Fast Processing ***
User-friendly interface
One-tap PDF protection and unlocking
Process files quickly without compromising quality
*** Manage PDFs Securely ***
Keep your documents safe and private
Works with contracts, invoices, reports, forms, and more
No technical knowledge required
Why Choose PDF Lock & Unlock?
Whether you need to secure important documents with a password or unlock PDFs for convenient access, PDF Lock & Unlock provides a simple and efficient solution. Protect your privacy, safeguard sensitive information, and manage PDF security effortlessly.
Note: Our app does not break PDF password it just unlocks the PDF file with existing password and save it without any password. So you can open the PDF without entering the password every time you open the document.
Our App can be used for free with Ads and limited features, however, you can purchase a Unlock PDF Premium subscription for the additional advanced features, and remove Ads.
SUBSCRIPTION AND TERMS:
When you download our App you can opt in to a 3 days free trial for monthly and 7 days free trial for yearly subscription. Our App offers auto-renewing monthly/yearly subscription options for access to the app's features and content. Your Unlock PDF Premium subscription will automatically renew at the end of each term and payment will be charged through your iTunes account. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings but refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term. To avoid renewal, you must cancel at least 24 hours before your subscription or trial ends. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING:
Premium Monthly: $0.99 / Month (3 days free trial)
Premium Yearly: $5.99 / Year (7 days free trial)
Read more about our terms, conditions, and privacy here:
• Privacy Policy: https://www.racersoft.in
• Terms of Use: https://racersoft.in/terms-of-use/

ChatNow is an all-in-one AI assistant with 30+ of the top AI models in one place: GPT-6 Astra, Claude Fable 5.1, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Grok 4.5, and every new release that follows. Write, research, create images and video, and solve everyday or complex problems, without learning several tools, switching between apps, or paying for separate subscriptions.
Downloaded 13 million+ times* and rated 4.8 out of 5 from 400,000+ ratings and reviews.
HOW MANY AI MODELS ARE IN CHATNOW?
More than 30 today, covering chat and reasoning, images, and video. New flagship models are added as they launch, so you are never a generation behind.
WHICH AI MODELS ARE IN CHATNOW?
For writing, reasoning, and analysis: GPT-6 Astra, GPT-5.6 (Terra, Luna, Sol), GPT-5.5 Thinking, Claude Fable 5.1, Claude 4.8 Opus, Claude 5 Sonnet, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Gemini 3 Flash, Grok 4.5, Grok 4.3.
For images: Nano Banana Pro, Nano Banana 2, GPT Image 2, Flux.
For video: Veo 3.1, Sora 2, Kling 2.1, Seedance 2.5, Omni Flash.
This is not the full list. Open ChatNow for the current lineup.
WHICH MODEL SHOULD I USE?
Pick one in a tap, or ask several models the same question, compare the answers, and keep the best one.
CAN I USE GPT-6, CLAUDE, GEMINI, AND VEO WITHOUT SEPARATE SUBSCRIPTIONS?
Yes. One subscription covers all 30+ models instead of four or five separate bills.
Type, talk, or snap a photo and get a clear answer back.
KEY FEATURES
WRITING & GRAMMAR
Draft the email you keep putting off or turn messy notes into a clean report. Summarize, rewrite, translate, fix grammar, and polish your resume.
RESEARCH & SMART WEB SEARCH
Get up-to-date answers with sources: today's news, product comparisons, and fact checks on what you read online. Turn articles and PDFs into quick takeaways.
IMAGE & VIDEO CREATION
Generate images and edit photos with Nano Banana Pro and GPT Image 2. Make short videos with Veo 3.1, Sora 2, and Kling 2.1. New creative models land in Creative Studio right after release.
CODING
Describe your idea in Playground and watch it become a working app or website, no coding needed. Generate code, debug errors, and get step-by-step explanations.
VOICE MODE & VOICE TO TEXT
Ask out loud while cooking, driving, or walking, and get clear spoken answers in real time. Or skip typing and let voice-to-text do it.
IMAGE & DOCUMENT ANALYSIS
Snap a photo of a chart, a whiteboard, or handwritten notes and get a clear explanation.
WHAT USERS SAY
"I've tested at least 12 AI platforms for work. With four paid subscriptions for comparison, this one is the way to go." - Sohail R., US
"Works amazingly fast and has cut my work and life load in half." - Nienie, US
"At 71, learning something new is usually a non-starter. I needed research, and this app saved me HOURS." - Hoosier R., US
"All the solutions in one app, no need to download other apps." - Lokki, US
WHY CHATNOW
- 30+ models in one place, not one model per plan
- New models added as they launch, nothing to chase
- Text, images, video, research, and code side by side
- One price instead of five subscriptions
IS CHATNOW FREE?
Yes, ChatNow is free to download and you can start chatting right away. A subscription unlocks all 30+ models and features.
IS MY DATA PRIVATE?
Yes. ChatNow follows European data protection standards. Your conversations and content stay private.
WHO CHATNOW IS FOR
- PROFESSIONALS: draft reports, analyze data, and decide faster
- RESEARCHERS & LEARNERS: summarize sources and understand complex topics
- CREATORS: generate images, video, and content ideas
- ANYONE: ask in plain language and get help with everyday questions
Download ChatNow for free and make AI your advantage.

bluejetty:00157190:ios.description:
Think of CARTS Now as a whole new way to get around Bastrop — a ridesharing service that’s smart, easy, affordable, and green.
With a few taps, book an on-demand ride in the app and our technology will pair you with other people headed your way. No detours, no delays.
How it works:
Book a ride on your phone.
Get picked up at your location
Share your ride with others.
Save cash and reduce carbon emissions.
What we’re about:
SHARED.
Our algorithm matches people headed in the same direction. This means you’re getting the convenience and comfort of a private ride with the efficiency, speed, and affordability of a public one.
AFFORDABLE.
Aggregating people into one vehicle brings down prices. Enough said.
SUSTAINABLE.
Sharing rides reduces the number of vehicles on the roads, bringing down congestion and CO2 emissions. With a couple of taps, you get to do your part to make your city a little bit greener and cleaner, every time you ride.
Questions? Reach out at now@ridecarts.com.
Loving your experience so far? Throw us a 5-star rating.

With a few taps, book an on-demand ride in the app and our technology will pair you with other people headed your way. No detours, no delays.
 
How it works:
Book a ride on your phone.
Get picked up at your location
Share your ride with others.
Save cash and reduce carbon emissions.
 
What we’re about:
SHARED.
Our algorithm matches people headed in the same direction. This means you’re getting the convenience and comfort of a private ride with the efficiency, speed, and affordability of a public one.
 
AFFORDABLE.
Aggregating people into one vehicle brings down prices. Enough said.
 
SUSTAINABLE.
Sharing rides reduces the number of vehicles on the roads, bringing down congestion and CO2 emissions. With a couple of taps, you get to do your part to make your city a little bit greener and cleaner, every time you ride.
 
Questions? Reach out at now@ridecarts.com.
Loving your experience so far? Throw us a 5-star rating.

bluejetty:00017071:ios.summary:

Free the mad scientist in you and fuse different robots to create unpredictable new machine
bluejetty:00017071:ios.description:
Evolution isn’t a perk exclusive to humans and animals: machines can be dragged and dropped together to become wacky mutant creatures just as well!
Free the mad scientist in you and fuse different robots to create unpredictable new machines and build your own high-tech army!
You can engineer a machine to clean your house, a nanobot to fix your phone every time it breaks, a replicant to be your new bodyguard or a hive-mind swarm of sentient robots that will take over the world’s digital network and use it to control every other machine in the planet and usher a new era of human subjugation.
Fun times!
HIGH-TECH FEATURES
• Pantheon: a new place for supreme beings to look down on us mortals and laugh at our misery
• Impostors: watch out for impostors trying to steal the spotlight from the robots
HOW TO PLAY
• Drag and drop similar robots to create new mysterious creatures
• Use robot eggs to earn coins, buy new creatures and make even more money
• Alternatively, fiercely tap a robot to make coins pop from their eggs
HIGHLIGHTS
• Different stages and many robot types to discover
• A mind-blowing story with paleolithic twists!
• The unexpected mix of alpaca-like evolution and incremental clicker games
• Doodle-like illustrations
• Various possible endings: find your destiny
• No robots were harmed in the making of this game, only developers
Skynet has to start somewhere!
Disclaimer: While this App is completely free to play, some additional content can be purchased for real money in-game. If you do not want to use this feature, please turn off in-app purchases in your device's settings.
Like our page on Facebook and be the first to know about our upcoming games and updates! http://fb.com/tappshq

bluejetty:00024767:ios.name: Business Card Scanner + Reader
bluejetty:00024767:ios.summary: Business card scanner is also a digital business card reader. Now, you no longer need to spend a couple of hours manually entering a stack of business cards into your database. The business card scanner + reader can do it for you by quickly
bluejetty:00024767:ios.description:
Business card scanner is also a digital business card reader. Now, you no longer need to spend a couple of hours manually entering a stack of business cards into your database. The business card scanner + reader can do it for you by quickly transferring and organizing business card contact information into digitally transcribed contacts. Now, you can scan many cards using the online business card organizer app.
No doubt this business card scanner makes it easy for you to remember more about the individuals you meet. The free business card scanner app scans business cards with Optical Character Recognition (OCR) and everything into a contact note, including:
• Name, company, title, and other contact information
• An image of the card
How Does a Business Card Scanner App Work?
Business cards play a crucial role in quickly sharing contact information with someone. It gives a professional first impression especially when you meet with a potential client. There’s no doubt these cards remain a constant even as people use the business card scanner + reader app to store their paper cards into digital business cards. 
The business card scanner app for iOS helps to scan business cards and organize the contact information into the contact list of your phone. The business card reader app uses your phone's camera for card scanning stores the entire information in a digitized way and converts a card to a virtual business card.
Ease of Use: The business card organizer app makes organizing, scanning, and transcribing business cards relatively simple. 
What Look For The Best Business Card Reader App:
Aim for a business card scanner app that provides you with advanced OCR features, a high degree of accuracy, ease of use, device capability, and additional features such as different OCR language support. 
For most individuals, the free version of the business card organizer app will be sufficient according to their needs. The free version of the business card keeper will quickly and accurately save the information for your new contact. However, marketers may account for a paid version of the card scanner app so they can readily & accurately save their cards in a single place and access them when required. 
Best Features Provided By Business Card Scanner App:
Let’s take a look at the advanced features of this app.
• The app uses advanced OCR technology to scan business cards, it recognizes the text of cards and transcribes them in digital form
• Business card reader scans QR Code and fetches the contact information
• Allow you to store business cards in a digitized way
• Allow auto-sync of contacts
• Support a cloud-based (auto backup) system for your contacts
• Export business contacts help to export scanned contacts to Google (CSV), Outlook (CSV), and vcard files.
• Import allows you to import the contacts from the vcard file to your app
• The business card scanner allows you to read and scan the multilanguage cards. This business card app supports more than 30 languages
• Scanning limits: When it comes to a free plan, users get limited card scanning, to enjoy unlimited scanning you have to head to the business card scanner app pro version
Let’s Sum Up:
So,say goodbye to piles of paper business cards right now, and scan and organize your card contacts into a digitized form using the business card organizer app.
Disclaimer: This app is originally built and not copied from any other source. Your privacy is fully respected - we do not share your personal data with any third parties.

bluejetty:00040923:ios.name: Bandbreite
bluejetty:00040923:ios.summary: Browse the full catalogue of official bands, build your collection, and stay inspired by stats, insights, curated collections, and the community. Whether you’re a pro, a beginner, or curious about every official watch band ever released, Ba
bluejetty:00040923:ios.description:
Browse the full catalogue of official bands, build your collection, and stay inspired by stats, insights, curated collections, and the community. Whether you’re a pro, a beginner, or curious about every official watch band ever released, Bandbreite gives you the tools to explore, collect, and stay inspired. 
＊ Bands. All bands. :: Since 2015, Bandbreite has catalogued every official watch band ever released. With over 1,000 bands organized by style, color, or release date, it’s never been easier to explore more than 10 years of watch bands. You can browse detailed specs, swipe through image galleries, and discover the bands that fit you and your style best.
＊ Collection, Wishlist, and more. :: Add bands to your collection or wishlist and mark them as in transit or up for trade. Bandbreite helps you track everything you own and everything you might have your eye on. There’s always that one band missing, right? Our curated collections show band groups like "Adventure awaits", or "Made in Switzerland", and can be used to get informed, inspired, or to see which bands fit well together. Once a band joins your collection, add details like purchase date, price, and notes.
＊ Stats & Insights. :: Discover your collecting and wearing habits with statistics and charts on your favorite styles and colors, most-worn bands, and more. All insights are generated
right on your device — privacy built in.
＊ Logbook. :: Log the bands you’re wearing! Keep track of which bands are being worn the most, and which are used the least and might need more of your attention. A simple tool that emphasises your favorites and helps you understand your collection and your habits a bit more. It’s also fun! Additionally, you can also track days with third-party bands, or even mark a rest day when your watch stays on the charger. A timeline view shows when you've logged a band over the years.
＊ Always Up to Date. :: Bandbreite's database is updated over-the-air with every new band release. We work closely with the community to keep it accurate and helpful.
"This app really wouldn’t be the same in anyone else’s hands."
We promise to live up to one of our favorite reviews.
＊ All features are free to explore and use. To manage collections with more than five (5) bands, a one-time upgrade to Bandbreite Pro unlocks your unlimited collection. No subscriptions.
Do you have questions, feedback, or a bug to report? We’d love to hear from you.
You’ll find contact details in the app’s settings, or join us on Discord.
Built entirely in SwiftUI. Requires iOS 18 or later, but iOS 26 or later is recommended for the best experience.

- Over 100 batters to collect so you can find your favorite slugger!
- Unlock Retro uniforms to suit up your batter in classic style
- Free Daily Rewards in a monthly calendar
- Free rewards with every Season Pass
- Free Packs every four hours -- just login to redeem!

bluejetty:00066201:ios.name: Piano with Songs
bluejetty:00066201:ios.summary: Start playing the songs you love, even if you’ve never played piano before. Choose from over 2,000 songs and follow the falling notes on the piano keyboard, or try Starfall and tap the notes as they fall. Take it at your own pace, with a ba
bluejetty:00066201:ios.description:
Start playing the songs you love, even if you’ve never played piano before. Choose from over 2,000 songs and follow the falling notes on the piano keyboard, or try Starfall and tap the notes as they fall. Take it at your own pace, with a band that plays along with you, not the other way around.
Play a full 88-key piano right on your iPhone or iPad. Record your own music, edit the notes, and share your songs.
OVER 2,000 SONGS. PLAY WHAT YOU LOVE.
Play today’s chart-toppers and all-time greatest hits from a catalog of over 2,000 songs. Taylor Swift, Billie Eilish, Bruno Mars, Adele, and Ed Sheeran are just a few of the artists you’ll find.
Discover Pop, Rock, Country, Jazz, Classical, movie themes, and children’s favorites. Enjoy piano classics like Canon in D, Für Elise, and Moonlight Sonata. New songs are continually added, so there’s always more to play.
PLAY WITH YOUR OWN BAND
You’re on piano. Your band joins in on drums, guitars, and piano accompaniment, following your pace in real time. Slow down while you get comfortable with a song, then pick up the tempo when you’re ready.
STARFALL. ANOTHER WAY TO PLAY.
Play your favorite songs by tapping the notes as they fall. Watch your playing light up the screen with fireworks and bursts of stars. Choose your backgrounds and explosion effects to make each performance look the way you like.
CREATE YOUR OWN SONGS
Record a melody or a full performance, edit the notes in the song editor, and share your finished song.
YOUR OWN 88-KEY PIANO
Turn your iPhone or iPad into a piano with professionally recorded sound. Adjust the key size for comfortable playing, or switch to a dual-row keyboard to bring more notes within reach. Practice a favorite piece or improvise. Add sustain as you play and keep time with the built-in metronome.
Choose from five instruments: Grand Piano, Harpsichord, Electric Keyboard, Organ, and Glockenspiel.
Download Piano with Songs and play your first song today.
LICENSED MUSIC
Better Day Wireless supports songwriters and music publishers through licensed music.
PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION
Premium includes the full song catalog in Perform and Starfall, all five instruments, and unlimited song creation while your subscription is active.
Choose a weekly, monthly, or annual plan. Eligible subscribers can try the weekly plan free for 7 days. After the trial, the weekly subscription automatically renews at the price shown before purchase unless canceled. Prices are displayed in the app and may vary by region.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase, or after any free trial ends. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings. To avoid being charged after a free trial, cancel at least 24 hours before the trial ends.
Privacy Policy: https://www.betterdaywireless.com/privacy Terms of Use: https://www.betterdaywireless.com/termsofservice.html

bluejetty:00161804:ios.description:
Cooking Wonderland: Chef Game - Have fun cooking and serving at amazing places with special guests !!!
Tap, tap, tap! Simply tap to cook, serve and explore in Cooking Wonderland, one of the addictive restaurant games. Join a FREE food cooking game now, with fast - paced gameplay and simulation fun.

- You have a passion for cooking
- You want to experience the special dishes of different cultures
- You want to explore the wonderland of food
- You want to become a cooking masterchef

You will also need to learn how to manage time and ingredients to ensure that dishes are served on time and taste good.

* Step 1: Take orders from the customers
You will take orders, cook and serve delicious dishes to the customers!
You need to arrange the time properly to avoid customers leaving or food being burned
* Step 2: Cook yummy meals
Tap to cook and complete your mission

* Step 3: Serve guests
Once the customers are satisfied, you will earn gold and money tip from them
In addition, you can collect keys to unlock new restaurants and locations
* Step 4: Explore & Learn
Start with a simple restaurant, then explore new locations, new missions
Learn about unique recipes of food from other cultures
Complete your missions and receive trophies

You will cook, serve and discover interesting and surprising things in the game. You will experience joy and happiness when being a great chef. You will satisfy your passion and creativity when cooking delicious and beautiful dishes. You will connect and share with other players around the world. You will live in a wonderful and amazing culinary world!
DOWNLOAD, PLAY & EXPERIENCE!

bluejetty:00036161:ios.name: Ride On Trip Planner
bluejetty:00036161:ios.summary: Montgomery County Department of Transportation (MCDOT) partnered with Moovit, a global bus trip planning mobile app software company, to launch a new Ride On Trip Planner – a Ride On bus passenger load and local trip planning app. This new,
bluejetty:00036161:ios.description:
Montgomery County Department of Transportation (MCDOT) partnered with Moovit, a global bus trip planning mobile app software company, to launch a new Ride On Trip Planner – a Ride On bus passenger load and local trip planning app. This new, innovative app will allow riders to plan their next trip and to tell how crowded a Ride On bus is – before it arrives – with the crowdedness indicator on the app riders can choose if they want to get on the bus arriving, wait for the next bus depending on how many people are on the bus, or choose another travel option, such as other local transit services, bikeshare, and scooter. It gives riders more control over their transportation experience. The app also includes dashboards for the Ride On Central Communications team to monitor bus loads and more quickly dispatch additional buses when buses are full.
The Ride On Trip Planner app is easy to use and can be downloaded from the Apple app store. Riders choose their current location and their destination and then pick the most desirable route that fits their travel plans. Once the route is chosen, the app will give the exact time the next bus will arrive, while providing step-by-step directions on how to get to the bus stop and how to get to the rider’s destination after getting off the bus. The app will also notify riders when it's time to get off so they can browse other apps and surf the web, without having to worry about missing their stop. The app was created to alleviate stress and worry about bus times and continue to reduce the spread of infectious diseases with the crowdedness indicator.
This Ride On Trip Planner app is being funded by a federal grant to help the community continue to travel locally in a safe and more efficient way. This partnership is a two-year pilot to test the combined Ride On passenger load and trip planning functionalities in the County and beyond. After the pilot is completed, decisions will be made on whether to keep this application, expand its capabilities, or use it to replace the current Ride On Real Time application, based on feedback from County residents and other users. 
The Ride On Trip Planner solution is based on Moovit’s long-running robust native and web transit apps designed for endless scale and serving 100s of millions of users worldwide, with zero downtime. 
The application features: 
• Multimodal trip planning – in addition to Ride On route options, it will include other options like local transit services, bikeshare and scooter options
• Real-time arrivals
• Customized micro-mobility integrations
The Ride On Trip Planner app solution includes the iPhone app, which benefits from Moovit’s rich user interface (UI) and user experience (UX), as well as comprehensive transit data, developed in partnerships with some of the most well-known transit, mobility and accessibility organizations worldwide.
The Ride On Trip Planner app will feature a range of accessibility capabilities to benefit users with disabilities, including blindness or low vision, ambulatory impairments, and hand-motor disabilities, enabling them to use public transit confidently and maximize their opportunities in the workplace, education, and social life. 
The Moovit technology has more than 1.7 billion users in 112 countries, 3,500 cities, 7,500 transit agencies, and in 45 languages, and is a leading Mobility-as-a-Service (MaaS) solutions company and the world’s most popular urban mobility app, making getting around cities easier and more convenient.
For more information, visit https://www.RideOnBus.com/TripPlanner .

bluejetty:00127707:ios.description:
Hey there, health champs! It's me, Max, your pill-popping pal. Let's grow those healthy habits together with my friendly reminders!
[NEW] Share & Care
Invite family or friends to manage medication reminders together!
Now you can easily look after your parents' meds from afar.
No more daily "Did you take your pills?" calls!
[How to use Max]
▸ Fetch your reminders! You can set personalized schedules—daily, on specific days, or at intervals.
▸ When Max's "Woof Woof" alarm sounds, chow down on your meds and hit the "taken" button. Max automatically records the medicine name and time, crafting a pawsitively awesome health journal.
▸ If there's no response to the timely push notification, Max will bark up your phone again. *It's not a real call, so don't be startled!
[Recommended for]
▸ From conception to 16 weeks of pregnancy: Folate plays a major role in cell creation. Don't gobble it all up at once—Max suggests a daily dose with his "Pill Paws" alert to keep things steady.
▸ Office pups glued to screens: If those peepers are feeling ruff, set Max's "3-Hour Howler" alarm to keep those eyes rested. Adding some lutein to the mix is a real tail-wagger, too!
▸ Diabetic dogs on meds: Those taking diabetes meds might run low on Vitamin B. It's like the secret sauce for energy production, so Max's reminder pack always includes this woof-tastic nutrient.
▸ Caring for parents from afar: Hard to keep track of your parents' meds? Use Share & Care to check their medication status in real-time!
Stay barking healthy with Max's tail-wagging reminders!

bluejetty:00022817:ios.description:
The Brussels App lets you book flights, choose seats and get your boarding passes in order. It is the perfect mobile travel partner and gives you peace of mind so you know your journey will go off without a hitch. 
Once you’ve got the Brussels App, you’ll receive push notifications as well as real-time flight information, important flight status updates and relevant offers straight to your smartphone. This way you won’t miss out on any last-minute changes to your journey.
The Brussels App accompanies you the whole time, from the minute you book your flight to when you land at your destination and even afterward to make sure the whole experience is as seamless as possible. Simply access your personal profile if you need to make any changes to your information.
The Brussels App ensures you’re well looked after throughout the entire flight experience.
Here are the main features of the Brussels App:
Before the flight
• Book flights, add baggage and choose seats: Purchase the flight that best suits you and even add a rental car if you need to. You can also add baggage and reserve or change your seat.
• Online check-in: The Brussels App enables you to check in for all flights operated by Lufthansa Group Network Airlines. Your mobile boarding pass will then appear on your smartphone and can be accessed easily.
• Travel ID and Brussels Miles and More: You can store various payment methods in your Travel ID account with the new digital wallet, making it easy to pay anytime, anywhere. Your Travel ID or Brussels Miles & More account can be used for personalized services. You can save your personal information in the Brussels App for better accessibility.
• Real-time information and flight status: From 24 hours before your flight, you will be provided with important details and updates about your journey thanks to your mobile travel companion. Notifications for check-in and the flight status will pop up on your home screen as well as any gate changes so you won’t miss out on any news. This way you can rest assured that you’re up to date with all your flight information.
During the flight
• Flight ticket and onboard services: You always have your mobile boarding pass and onboard services to hand thanks to the Brussels App – even when you don’t have internet access. All relevant flight information is at your fingertips, so you know your flight status without having to ask the flight crew.
After the flight
• Track baggage: Your digital travel companion will still be at your side even after you’ve arrived at your destination. Locate your checked-in baggage in the app and stay informed about the subsequent parts of your trip.
The Brussels App is the perfect chaperone for a flawless travel experience. It has never been easier to book your flights and rental cars via the app, receive notifications and updates about upcoming flights, and manage your personal data effortlessly all while on the go.
Get your hands on the Brussels App now and see how it can improve your travel experience! It’s at your side before, during and after your flight.
Check out brusselsairlines.com and follow us on Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and X to stay up to date with the latest news and flight offers.
If you have any questions or need our help, please get in touch with us. You can contact us at https://www.brusselsairlines.com/be/en/contact.
