bluejetty:00181192:android.description:
Welcome to the first mobile RPG with no forced ads and no pay-to-win. As an ode to our pixelated past, Pixel Quest offers a puristic retro experience with beautiful pixel art and turn-based gameplay.
Step into a lengthy and varied gameplay experience featuring solo dungeons, co-op PVE dungeons, and ranked PVP! Choose your starting hero from a nostalgic cast - Warrior, Mage, or Rogue - and then forge your strategy as you progress through a deep, fully customizable skill tree and seek out powerful new items.
With a constant stream of new content to explore and a dedicated indie development team, players can rest assured that Pixel Quest will always offer a refreshing, hardcore RPG experience crafted with love. And once you have sought out the most powerful items, captured the rarest monsters, and tailored your character to spec, you can step into the Dragons Arena to test your skills against other ranked players!
Key features:
- An entirely free indie game with optional cosmetic upgrades (No pay-to-win)
- Turn-based solo, PVP, and PVE battles
- 100 dungeon levels full of new challenges to explore
- Monster capturing, user-created dungeons, and a real-time tradable market with other players
- Fantasy pixel art style and nostalgic 8-bit soundtrack
- Active and responsive development team with an active Discord community full of RPG enthusiasts to team up with
The game is only available in English, and a network connection is required to play.

bluejetty:00186461:ios.name: Monster Games: for Kids
bluejetty:00186461:ios.summary: Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading,
bluejetty:00186461:ios.description:
Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading, and more. Curated by experts, the content fosters curiosity, creativity, and confidence in young learners, assisting them as they grow. 
SKIDOS PASS: ALL IN ONE
With the SKIDOS Pass, children explore a safe and age-appropriate space with 1000+ fun and engaging activities, gaining life skills and receiving positive reinforcement for academic success. Parents can create up to 6 personalized profiles for their kids. and customize each according to age, gameplay preferences, and subjects to learn. Monitoring kids' progress is easy - learning reports in the app or via email give you a simple overview of their growth and challenges.
GAMEPLAY:
COLOR FRIENDS
In a faraway corner of the universe, small Color Friends are kept as hostages. You can help them to escape! Run and rescue as many friends as you can on a dangerous field filled with traps. Get the friends to the stargate which teleports them into safety. 
Main features:
- Explore 7 fantastic episodes
- Play on 63 different maps
- Collect candies to unlock helpful or funny items
LEARNING CURRICULUM
Our curriculum mixes engaging games with learning content, improving your child's learning skills and promoting active play.
MATH: Our math exercises cover a comprehensive list of topics, including number sense, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, geometry, and more. Tasks evolve as your child progresses. Interactive design and animations help support learning - three cute SKIDOS mascots will offer assistance, encouraging kids while they work on the assignments.
TRACING LETTERS & NUMBERS: You can pick tracing letters and numbers for your child to practice. A ladybird will show your little learner how to trace with their finger, while visuals and voiceovers teach new words and counting.
READING: Children will be introduced to the world of phonics, sounds, letters, and reading. Interactive designs and smart prompts help kids make their first confident steps toward reading, while storytelling with songs keeps them engaged and curious about new learning journeys.
EMOTIONAL WELLBEING: Through engaging activities, kids learn to understand and express their emotions and nurture positive attitudes.
EDUCATIONAL VIDEOS: Our video content piques kids' curiosity in a fun and easy way. We've curated just the right mix of entertainment & learning in our video catalogue.
SAFE & AD-FREE
SKIDOS ensures an ad-free online environment, providing kids with a positive and uninterrupted learning experience. Our apps are COPPA & GDPR-compliant.
ABOUT THE SKIDOS PASS SUBSCRIPTION:
- We offer monthly, quarterly, bi-annual and annual auto-renewable subscriptions
- Every subscription starts with a 3-day Free Trial
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account only after a free trial period, wherever applicable
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing cycle
- The user may turn off the subscription auto-renewal in the user's device Account Settings
- Cancellation goes into effect at the end of the current billing cycle
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a SKIDOS pass, where applicable
Privacy Policy: http://skidos.com/privacy-policy
Terms & Conditions: https://skidos.com/terms/
Support: support@skidos.com

- Will you help S
bluejetty:00164573:ios.description:
Peek a Phone is a realistic mystery adventure game where you’ll dive into an immersive story that sharpens your detective skills. Unravel the mystery, find the vital clue, solve the puzzle, and enter into realistic games!
- Will you help Sarah find her husband's secret lover?
- Can you locate the missing Chief of Police?
- Prepared to interrogate suspects and solve a criminal case?
- Want to peek through a dead man’s phone to solve a murder mystery?
- Ready to play texting games with a kidnapper?
If you answered YES to any of these questions, Peek a Phone’s mystery games are a perfect match for you!
Peek a Phone’s adventures are released in missions, with a new one every week! In each of these adventure games, you will:
- Access a fictional character’s mobile phone and reveal its unique story through investigating and unlocking apps, gathering clues, and resolving the central mystery.
- HACK into authentic-feeling apps by solving brain puzzles that simulate real life.
- HELP your clients by returning their lost phones. You’ll peek into their unread messages, learn their story, and help the police crack the case using your detective and technology skills.
- UNLOCK phone apps and discover new detective games. Deal with personal dilemmas and remember that everyone’s a suspect - even your clients!
Cracked the Simulacra detective thriller? Solved the Sara is missing texting games? Finished the Duskwood interactive investigation? Then it’s time to uncover new mysteries in this ultra-realistic phone investigation game. Discover our unique and realistic game mechanics with our text-based missions. You’ll race the clock to find the last clue, enter into texting games with a kidnapper, send real emails, visit real websites, solve real cases, and much (much!) more.
Enjoy text-based puzzles, group chats, actual phone and video calls, photos, hackers, and video evidence. Blur the line between game and reality!
Imagine you’ve found an unlocked phone lying on the ground. Do you think you have what it takes to locate its rightful owner by playing our unique mystery games?
Good luck, detective!
Please don't hesitate to contact us for any questions or comments via email: feedback@faintlines.com.
Follow us on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/peekaphone/

- Aggregate your financial accounts

bluejetty:00100097:ios.summary:
Overthinking every text? Getting mixed signals? Lucen's AI reads your conversations, scores their interest level, spots red flags, and tells you exactly what to say next. Stop guessing where you stand.
What you’ll see in your Lucen Report:
bluejetty:00100097:ios.description:
Overthinking every text? Getting mixed signals? Lucen's AI reads your conversations, scores their interest level, spots red flags, and tells you exactly what to say next. Stop guessing where you stand.
What you’ll see in your Lucen Report:
* Interest Score (with receipts): a plain-English read on “do they like you?” backed by patterns and quotes.
* Green & Red Flags: what’s working, what to watch, and why it matters.
* Ghost Risk Meter: early signs of pull-back or fade-outs, plus how to steady the vibe.
* Effort balance, one-sidedness, tone (casual vs flirty), reciprocity, and more.
* Ask Lucen about any message: paste a text and get a quick verdict, the evidence, and smart ways to respond—only when you want help.
* Smart Replies: what to say next, in your voice
* Timeline of Turning Points: key moments and shifts laid out in order so you see the story clearly.
Private by design Import from iMessage, WhatsApp, Instagram, or any texting app (screen recordings work too). You decide which messages to share, and you can delete them anytime.
Why people use Lucen? Less spiraling. Fewer mixed signals. More confident next steps—move forward, set a boundary, or move on.
Subscription: Upgrade for unlimited analyses and deeper insights. Cancel anytime.
Support: support@lucen.app
Terms: https://lucen.app/terms
Privacy: https://lucen.app/privacy

bluejetty:00029580:ios.summary:

We will be so happy if you and someone you know w
bluejetty:00029580:ios.description:
Our goal is just to make the funny and easy to use the drawing app for kids & writing notes, editing photos for everyone. 
We will go on to improve it with your reviews, feedbacks, supports.
We will be so happy if you and someone you know who both enjoy using it, thank you so much!
APP Features:
* Draw something what you want with the tools, colors, templates what you like and save them as images to your library album.
* Write your notes words anytime and anywhere and save them as pictures to your album.
* Paint everything on your photos from your library and save them.
* Edit your painting things, writing notes, drawing something as photos, pictures, images with Filter, Adjustment, Effect, Blur & Focus, Rotate, Draw, Splash, Crop, Resize, ToneCurve, Sticker, Emotions, Text.
* Custom the size(0-33) of your drawing, writing, painting tools such as Pen, Line, Arrow, Rect(Stroke), Rect(Fill), Ellipse(Stroke), Ellipse(Fill), Eraser.
* Custom the alpha(0-1) of your drawing, writing, painting colors.
* Undo, Redo, Clear and Wipe off drawing, writing, painting actions.
* Add blank paper to your canvas restart your drawings, writings, paintings.
* Change the background color by pressing on the ColorsPicker.
* Remember your last used marker colors and sizes and your canvas color.
* Import photos from your album or take pictures through camera or choose images from template to trace, annotate, and have fun with them.
* Save your drawings, writings, paintings to your Photos Library.
* Print your drawings, writings, paintings to AirPrint enabled printers.
* Draw, write, paint together and share with your friends and family through the social media app. 
* Just send your drawings, writings, paintings to them and they can open it and draw, write, paint on it too and then send it back.
I just think that everybody love it so much because it's no extra stuff to get in the way, you can just be totally immersed in drawing, writing, painting.
• Please rate this app to support me to do better and for so more people can find, download, use and enjoy it.
• Please share it with your friends and family members to help for getting the word out.
• Please send me email and let me know how you to use it, send me your drawings, writings, paintings, questions, concerns and feedbacks.

bluejetty:00065756:ios.name: tint.
bluejetty:00065756:ios.summary: Tint lets you solve puzzles by painting. Mix watercolors to match the color of the origami - all at a soothing pace and in the comfort of your own garden studio. Here are no timers, no countdowns, no points and certainly no rush, whenever y
bluejetty:00065756:ios.description:
Tint lets you solve puzzles by painting. Mix watercolors to match the color of the origami - all at a soothing pace and in the comfort of your own garden studio. Here are no timers, no countdowns, no points and certainly no rush, whenever you feel like a break.
330 LEVELS AND COUNTING
Each level can often be solved in multiple ways, feel free to try a stroke of genius. More levels and challenges will continuously be added at no extra cost. Enable notifications and we will let you know when more are available.
NATURE SOOTHES YOU
Nature is all around you when playing ‘tint’. Play on a warm summer morning or a light drizzle of rain - with every chapter the weather will change around you.
HEAR THE BIRDS
Your headphones give you the full binaural audio experience. Every sound has been carefully crafted by hand using real objects found in nature and in an art studio.
PLAY TINT IN ZEN MODE
Zen Mode is a full book of relaxing and easy levels. Zen Book unlocks right after you complete 50 levels of Book I.
It will take you to the sunny shore of a crystal clear stream, where you can focus on the art process and simply enjoy painting the most beautiful solutions.
Great for children and the whole family to experiment with watercolor.
COLORBLIND & VISION IMPAIRED MODE
Each color has its own unique tune, and if you are colorblind or vision impaired, you can enable a special mode in the menu that will help you better see the color differences with unique patterns on each color.
NO IN-APP PURCHASES, ADS OR TRACKING
That’s it. We simply want you to enjoy the game we created for the Apple Arcade. To protect your privacy no information is collected and we will never try to sell you anything at any point during the game, promise.
A perfect mix of passion, sweat and tears has gone into this game, we hope you like it!
Mika, Tomek , Jakob

bluejetty:00114542:ios.description:
Safy – Smart Security for Your iPhone
Safy brings essential protection tools into one place, helping you stay secure, private, and aware of potential digital risks. The app provides intuitive features that enhance your online experience and give you greater control over your privacy and device safety.
Features:
• VPN – Encrypt your connection and browse with enhanced privacy on public and private networks.
• Ad Block – Reduce intrusive ads and limit tracking for a more comfortable browsing experience.
• SMS Filter – Identify and filter unwanted messages to help avoid scams and spam.
• Identity Monitoring – Check if your email address appears in known data leaks and take proactive steps to stay safe.
• Device Security – View important security status such as iOS version and passcode availability.
• Web Shield – Receive alerts about potentially harmful websites before visiting them.
• Battery Health – Monitor battery condition to help keep your device performing well.
Safy works quietly in the background, assisting you in making informed decisions and supporting a safer digital lifestyle.
Subscription Information
Safy offers optional premium features through auto-renewable subscriptions:
• Weekly Subscription — includes a 3-day free trial
• Yearly Subscription
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account upon confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscription at any time in your App Store account settings.
Free trial automatically converts into a paid subscription unless canceled before the trial ends.
Privacy Policy: https://safy-security.com/privacy
Terms Of Use: https://safy-security.com/terms
Stay protected with Safy — your digital security companion.

bluejetty:00155293:ios.description:
Welcome to Paschall Truck Lines!
As a 100% employee owned company the PTL mobile app was designed with our fellow owners and valued professional drivers in mind. This is a portal to make it easier and more efficient for drivers on the road and employees to access the information they need. You can do many things through this app, including:
• Scan and send documents
• View load and stop details, including fuel stops
• Vertical Alliance Training
• Access Weigh My Truck App
• Accept/Reject planned loads
• Perform DVIR 
• View Insurance/Certificates
• Access/View pay and HR information
• Run the app from tablet devices for larger screen viewing
… And much more — anywhere you happen to be!

bluejetty:00129639:ios.name: Cookbook Junior - Healthy Food
bluejetty:00129639:ios.summary: Huddle up your family and cook yummy food with the easy cooking guide in our app. Find the best family-friendly food recipes that children will love to eat at home. We have a vast selection of easy recipes for you to cook at home with your
bluejetty:00129639:ios.description:
Huddle up your family and cook yummy food with the easy cooking guide in our app. Find the best family-friendly food recipes that children will love to eat at home. We have a vast selection of easy recipes for you to cook at home with your children. Check out the app for healthy and tasty recipes for your children!
Enjoy thousands of easy recipes
Find plenty of healthy recipes to cook with your children for breakfast, lunch, and dinner to make them happy. Enjoy making a quick snack and baking a dessert for your children at home. From nutritious meals like soup and salad dishes to a variety of delicious fast foods like pizza and burgers. Feel the experience of using a perfect recipe book with your fingertips.
Enjoy family cooking time
How often do you get to enjoy the feeling of cooking tasty food with your children? It is quite an amazing experience to prepare food with your children and to enjoy meals together. Get new ideas and tips on cooking different dishes from a variety of cuisines with our cookbook. children need food rich in protein, carbs, and good fats, like meat and fish. Take a chance to think outside the box and try baking healthy foods for your kids. Learn to make new recipes and enjoy cooking with your children with our easy recipes.
Recipe manager and guide
Use our online recipe keeper to store your children's favorites. Do try your children's favorite recipes on holidays and make them happier. It is always best to think ahead for the daily school meal box, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Do sit with your children and plan meals for the whole week. Find some quality time on weekends to cook with your kids and prepare their favorite meals. Let us guide you through our good food ideas to save your time and spend quality time with your kids.
Health benefits of cooking at home
Let it be a snack, dessert, or a quick meal; any food prepared alongside family should be nutrition-friendly. Try to cook healthy as well as easy meals for your children. While fried fast foods and dessert recipes are easy to make, they are rich in unhealthy fats and bad for your health. Cook a fruit salad over a chocolate cookie for your junior champs. 
Follow our tips to make amazing recipes for children. We also have some tips and easy tricks for the junior cooking champs. Take the challenge to think outside the box and cook with your family. With more information than all those recipe books can handle, we will guide you through the entire cooking process step by step.
Download the Cookbook Junior Recipes app and get easy and fun recipes to prepare at home with family!
Terms of use - http://thecookbk.com/terms.php?appname=cookbook.recipes.for.kids
Privacy Policy: http://thecookbk.com/privacy.php?appname=cookbook.recipes.for.kids

bluejetty:00134985:ios.description:
Looking to relax or unwind? It's coloring book time. Magic Color combines fun, stress reduction, and beautiful art into one awesome coloring games app. Relax color with a free color by number system. Paint by numbers to bring life to artwork with ease. Accessible and intuitive controls mean you can paint by number with just one hand. At home coloring with free color by number games is a great way to pass the time.
The app goes above and beyond to bring users a premier coloring experience.
Check out these powerful features:
- Enormous variety of beautiful artwork
- Amazing art from our featured artist
- Simple controls, smooth interface, and eye-catching notifications
- New artwork added daily
- Library of more than 4500 works
- Recommend for you: popular works suggested for you
- Tips and tricks throughout the app to help you create flawless artwork
This coloring book app was made to help people find a moment of calm. Relax color or paint a portrait on the subway, color a cartoon from your home, or fill out a free oil paint by number anywhere. Easily complete beautiful painting games with this color by number app. Send fun greeting cards to friends, solve color puzzle games, or check out fun flower coloring books.
Millions of people around the world enjoy coloring games, what are you waiting for? Who wouldn’t want color matching games, oil paint by number, number color puzzles, and paint by number all in a single color by number app.

bluejetty:00129653:ios.name: Visual Code
bluejetty:00129653:ios.summary: Visual Code transforms your iPhone and iPad into a complete development environment. Built with performance, portability, and flexibility in mind, it allows you to write, debug, and run code wherever you are. Whether you’re a student, hobby
bluejetty:00129653:ios.description:
Visual Code transforms your iPhone and iPad into a complete development environment. Built with performance, portability, and flexibility in mind, it allows you to write, debug, and run code wherever you are. Whether you’re a student, hobbyist, or professional developer, Visual Code gives you the power of a desktop IDE in a mobile-first design.
Powerful and Intuitive
Visual Code features a sleek, modern interface optimized for productivity. With syntax highlighting, intelligent formatting, and customizable themes, you can focus on what matters most: writing clean, efficient code.
Multi-Language Support
Work in the language of your choice without switching apps. Visual Code supports a wide range of popular programming languages, including: Python, JavaScript, C, C++, PHP, Java, Swift, HTML, CSS, Golang, Rust, Ruby, Objective-C, Perl, and Lua.
Built-In Terminal
Run commands directly inside the app with the integrated terminal. Manage projects, test scripts, and control workflows seamlessly without ever leaving Visual Code.
Optimized for iOS 27 and iPadOS
- Liquid Gas Design: Smooth, futuristic UI tailored to the latest iOS standards.
- Deep iPad Integration: Take advantage of multi-window support, multitasking, and full external keyboard compatibility.
- Keyboard Shortcuts: Streamline your workflow with shortcut support for iPad keyboards, making coding even faster.
Why Choose Visual Code?
- Work on the go with an all-in-one coding environment.
- Enjoy a familiar desktop-like experience with mobile convenience.
- Build, test, and refine projects without compromise.
Disclaimer
Visual Code is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected to Microsoft Corporation. It is also not related to, nor a part of, Microsoft Visual Studio. All trademarks are the property of their respective owners.
-------
Visual Code Pro is an auto renewable subscription:
- Edit Files
- AI integrations 
- Themes
-------
Price may vary by location and active promotion. Subscriptions will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account. Your subscription will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage your subscriptions in Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.
-------

bluejetty:00138484:ios.name: Brain Test All-Star: IQ Boost
bluejetty:00138484:ios.summary: Brain Test All-Star: IQ Boost offers players a new set of original brain teasers using the fan-favorite puzzle brain games formula. On top of 100s of new levels, IQ Boost introduces a brand-new IQ scoring system that will help our players t
bluejetty:00138484:ios.description:
Brain Test All-Star: IQ Boost offers players a new set of original brain teasers using the fan-favorite puzzle brain games formula. On top of 100s of new levels, IQ Boost introduces a brand-new IQ scoring system that will help our players to increase their intelligence in various ways.
It has been a long journey for the Brain Test brand as we’ve published 6 /.different installments within the franchise in several years. IQ Boost comes as a culmination of years of experience and tricky puzzle fun!
Brain Test is an addictive free tricky brain puzzle game with a series of tricky brain teasers for a relaxing brain out. These offline mind games, brain games, IQ tests, thinking games and puzzle games are perfect for those who love brain exercises! Enjoy brain games for adults and brain teasers.
Brain Test All-Star: IQ Boost’s huge level trove includes mind games, iq games, puzzle solving games, and brain teasers all at once. Test your brain with this ultimate free brain games experience. 
This new iteration of the most successful brain puzzle game provides a new way of challenge for the veteran players. Test your brain with a highly difficult set of hard puzzles. Only the accomplished players of Brain Test 1, 2, 3, and 4 will have a chance of completing these Brain Test 5 tricky puzzles.
Whether you call it mind games, smart games or riddle games, the 5th version of Brain Test satisfies every player with a diverse selection of brain teaser games and brain out scenarios. Use your smart games skills to overcome this free brain test and become a champion of brain games. 
For the daily active brain masters, we offer daily challenges that provide a unique experience every single day. Completing these daily brain puzzle tests offer both a sense of accomplishment and material rewards in the form of lots of bulbs. Use these bulbs to unlock hints and face the puzzle brain games with a wider arsenal.
Revisit your dear Brain Test friends such as Agent Smith, Monster Hunter Joe, Uncle Bubba, Doctor Worry, and Tom the Cat. Their adventures are even trickier this time to boost your iq and develop your thinking game skills. Puzzle solving games genre has never been so rich before as we will offer at least 1000 levels in Brain Test All-Star: IQ Boost.
Enjoy an improved Brain Test experience with smoother controls, fluid animations, colorful graphics, and enhanced sound effects. Our team of experts worked meticulously to make every technical part of this free brain teaser game experience perfect. Riddles and brain quiz levels have never been so immersive before in the history of problem solving games.
Challenging games are off-putting for some players. That is why Brain Test All-Star: IQ Boost puts forward intuitive hint and skip systems that allow everyone regardless of their age and education level to play it easily. After all, brain-teaser games are there to test your brain, not your patience. 
Free brain games should never require payment and internet. That is the exact case with the latest brain test iteration named Brain Test All-Star: IQ Boost. Puzzle solving game lovers can enjoy the mind games filled with brain teasers anywhere and anytime. Take your phone and play this at a park, library or even during a flight! Free brain games are something you can find here.
Features:
● More than 1000 tricky puzzle levels
● Extensive IQ scoring system that tracks your development
● Frequent updates that add new levels
● Hard challenge levels for the veteran players
● Daily levels for active players
● Free brain training
● Provides mindfulness 
● Improved hint and skip systems
● Enhanced graphics and visuals
● Smooth controls and flawless gameplay
● Can be played with one hand
● Can be played offline
● No WIFI required
● Completely free, no hidden fees
● All levels are free to play

Welcome to Chair Yoga for Seniors at Home – your ultimate companion for promoting fitness and well-being, right from the comfort of your own home. This app is exclusively crafted to introduce you to the gentle yet transformative practice of chair yoga and other workouts, specifically tailored for seniors.
Discover the therapeutic benefits of chair yoga, where every movement is carefully designed to nurture your body and mind. Perfect for seniors seeking a safe and accessible way to stay active, Chair Yoga for Seniors at Home is your gateway to a healthier lifestyle.
Embracing the principles of chair yoga, this app offers:
Tailored Workouts: Experience a series of chair yoga sessions meticulously designed to cater to the unique needs of seniors. Each session is crafted to enhance strength, flexibility, balance, and overall well-being, all while seated comfortably in a chair.
Gentle Guidance: Follow along with clear, step-by-step instructions accompanied by soothing videos, ensuring that each movement is performed with ease and confidence.
Joint-Friendly Exercises: Enjoy low-impact exercises that are gentle on your joints and muscles, allowing you to reap the benefits of yoga without strain or discomfort.
Personalized Approach: Receive personalized workout plans tailored to your individual fitness level and goals, empowering you to progress at your own pace.
Track Your Progress: Stay motivated and accountable with our intuitive progress tracker, monitoring your achievements and celebrating your milestones along the way.
Feedback Feature: Utilize our feedback feature to share your thoughts and insights directly with us. Your feedback helps us tailor the app to better meet your needs and preferences.
Experience the transformative power of chair yoga and unlock a world of health and vitality with Chair Yoga for Seniors at Home. Download now and embark on a journey towards a happier, healthier you!

bluejetty:00143050:ios.description:
Testi will help you access your booking quickly, find an earlier driving test (or a new test) and get a UK driving licence as quickly as possible!
How Testi works:
1. Download the Testi app and login with your details on the in-app browser.
2. Use the in-app browser for a quicker access to your booking (or book a new test)
3. Share tests availability with other learners and they will share with you.
4. Change your test quickly using the in-app browser.
Features
- Quick login to the DVSA website using our in-app Browser or Safari Extension (one-tap only, no password required).
- 3 additional test centres (Premium account).
- Notifications service for new available tests (Premium account).
- Unlimited use until you pass your test.
Upgrade to Premium
- Unlimited usage of our in-app Browser or Safari Extension.
- Notifications service for new available tests.
- 3 additional test centres.
- Multi-device support: up to 5 devices per driving licence.
- Unlimited use until you pass your driving test.
- Ad-free experience
Additional information:
- Premium account is linked to your driver licence, not your Apple id or your device.
Note: Testi is not affiliated with the DVLA or DVSA.
We DO NOT book, change, cancel, or swap tests. We never did, and we never will.
We DO NOT login to the DVSA website on your behalf, you are in full control of your booking and personal details.
All the interaction with the DVSA website is done by you in the in-app browser while you are using the app.
Questions or feedback? Contact us: support+ios@testi-app.co.uk

bluejetty:00065737:ios.summary: Get food delivery to your doorstep from thousands of amazing local and national restaurants. Find the meal you crave and order food from restaurants easily with the Uber Eats app. Track your order in real-time. Request an Uber ride directly
bluejetty:00065737:ios.description:
Get food delivery to your doorstep from thousands of amazing local and national restaurants. Find the meal you crave and order food from restaurants easily with the Uber Eats app. Track your order in real-time. Request an Uber ride directly from the Uber Eats app.
FIND YOUR FAVORITE FOOD & RESTAURANTS
Order food from nearby restaurants and search by cuisine, restaurant name, dish, and meal. 
Food delivery options for you to order and enjoy including pizza, burritos, burgers, sushi, donuts, and Chinese takeout.
Prefer pickup? Skip the line and reservations and choose to pick up your order instead. Choose your favorite delivery options with the Uber Eats app now.
REQUEST AN UBER RIDE 
You can request an Uber ride directly from the Uber Eats app, alongside ordering food, groceries, and other essentials.
SUBSCRIBE TO UBER ONE
For $9.99 per month, Uber One subscribers enjoy $0 Delivery Fee and up to 10% off orders over $15 at participating non-grocery stores (and 5% off orders over $35 at participating grocery stores) available on Uber Eats. Members are also eligible for rewards, perks, coupons, and offers. View full Uber One Terms & Conditions in app. 
ORDER ALMOST ANYTHING, ANYTIME
Order household needs from your favorite drug stores, supermarkets, and pet shops. Baby food or diapers, pharmacy needs, beauty products and cosmetics. Grocery staples like bread and milk, bananas and produce, flowers and plants, packaged foods or frozen treats. 
You can even order alcoholic drinks including beer, wine, liquor and cocktails. *
SIMPLE DELIVERY ORDERING
Pick your food order from any menu and add it to your cart with a few taps. That’s it.
Uber Eats makes it easy to order food delivery online or through the app and have it delivered by restaurants and delivery people near you.
Or, schedule your order in advance for a delivery person to pick it up later. Your choice!
ORDER FOOD AHEAD WITH PICKUP
Now you can also order food ahead for Pickup instead of just ordering delivery. Select Pickup, add food items to your cart, and skip the lines to the restaurant to get your food.
REAL-TIME ORDER TRACKING
Track your food delivery order on a map as it heads your way.
See the estimated arrival time at your address.
Get notified when your order arrives.
FIND SOME OF YOUR FAVORITE NATIONAL RESTAURANTS
Some of our food delivery partners include: Pizza Hut, Little Caesars, Buffalo Wild Wings, Papa Johns, Shake Shack, Domino’s Pizza, Nando’s, Burger King, CAVA, A&W, Chick-fil-A, Chipotle, Dunkin', IHOP, KFC, McDonald's, Panda Express, Panera, Popeyes, Shake Shack, Sonic, Starbucks, Subway, Sweetgreen, Taco Bell, Tim Hortons, Wendy's, Five Guys, Jersey Mikes, White Castle, Jack in the Box, Outback Steakhouse, Red Lobster.
FIND PHARMACIES, GROCERY STORES, AND MORE
Order from grocers such as Albertsons and SEG. Other delivery partners in the pharmacy, convenience, and retail space include CVS, Walgreens, 7-Eleven, Wawa, Gopuff, BevMo!, and Total Wines.Order from stores such as Walmart, Walgreens, CVS and Safeway. Other delivery partners include Petco, Drizly, and Favor.
Uber Eats is currently available in cities and metro areas including Adelaide, Amsterdam, Atlanta, Auckland, Austin, Baltimore, Brussels, Cape Town, Chicago, Dallas, Denver, Johannesburg, Glasgow, London, Los Angeles, Madrid, Melbourne, Mexico City, Miami, Milan, Nashville, New Orleans, New York, Ottawa, Paris, Philadelphia, Rio de Janeiro, San Diego, San Francisco, Seattle, Stockholm, Sydney, Taipei, Tokyo, Toronto, Warsaw, and Washington DC. Uber Eats helps you find food delivery around the world. See full list of available countries in the app.
*Alcohol in select markets. Must be at least 21 to purchase. Item availability varies by market. See app for details.

Don't Touch My Device app to prevent someone else from touching your device

bluejetty:00071238:ios.description:
Don't Touch My Device app to prevent someone else from touching your device
Don't touch my phone AntiTheft is an app designed to enhance the security and privacy of personal devices from unwanted user touch. Don't touch my phone AntiTheft provides users with a way to secure the device from unauthorized access and protect sensitive information. One of the key features of this app is intruder detection with an alarm, which can easily identify suspicious activities and capture unauthorized attempts to access the device. Users can set up customizable alerts, including sound notifications, allowing them to stay informed about whether someone is trying to access their device.
The Don't touch my phone AntiTheft app's intuitive user interface makes it easy for individuals of all technical levels to navigate and customize settings to suit their security preferences. In addition to the Don't touch my phone AntiTheft app's best intruder detection capabilities, Don't touch my phone AntiTheft offers a variety of anti-theft features to safeguard the device with pin protection. You can also find how-to-use details to easily understand the app and set the protection with ease through the Don't touch my phone AntiTheft App
FEATURES:
* Protect your device from unwanted users
* All the instructions are available on how to activate the security system
* Different security tunes are available
* One tap to activate or deactivate
* Pin code for Protection to activate and de-activate security alarm
* Nice app coming with clear UI design
For more information : 
Privacy Policy : http://nhapplab.in/privacy_policy.html
Terms of Use : http://nhapplab.in/terms_of_use.html

bluejetty:00035929:ios.description:
CHRISTMAS ADVENTURE 3: MATCH-3 – YOUR ULTIMATE HOLIDAY PUZZLE GAME!
Celebrate the magic of Christmas with Christmas Adventure 3: Match-3! 
This Christmas game brings over 2,500 levels of festive match-3 puzzle fun to keep you in the holiday spirit. Enjoy cozy vibes as you match ornaments, snowflakes, ginger bread, and more!
DIVE INTO ENDLESS CHRISTMAS MATCH-3 FUN
Unwind with our Christmas match-3 puzzle game! With no lives to lose, you can play as long as you want – perfect for both kids and adults. Whether you’re new to match-3 games or a pro, you’ll love the endless fun of matching Christmas icons.
PLAY ANYTIME, ANYWHERE!
Enjoy Christmas Adventure 3 anytime! It’s the perfect game for winter nights, family gatherings, or cozying up by the fire. Plus, it’s completely FREE to play – no annoying time limits or friend requests.
FEATURES THAT MAKE CHRISTMAS SPECIAL
• Over 2,500 levels of Christmas-themed match-3 puzzles
• Unique power-ups to clear obstacles and boost your score
• Seasonal themes with snowflakes, bells, presents, and holiday treats
• No lives system – play as long as you want, without any limits
EASY TO PLAY, HARD TO MASTER
Match 3 or more Christmas items – snowflakes, bells, or baubles – to clear them from the board. Create bigger matches to unleash powerful boosters like line-clearing bombs and festive explosions. Each level brings new match-3 challenges with exciting holiday twists.
CHALLENGE & CLIMB THE LEADERBOARD
Compete on the leaderboards, track your progress, and challenge loved ones to beat your high scores. Who can make the most magical matches?
PERFECT FOR FANS OF CHRISTMAS GAMES
If you love match-3 games with a holiday twist, Christmas Adventure 3: Match-3 is the game for you! It’s the ideal Christmas puzzle game for fans of holiday games who enjoy a relaxing, festive match-3 experience.
Make this season special with endless holiday puzzles! Download Christmas Adventure 3: Match-3 today and feel the joy of Christmas games! Merry Christmas and happy matching!

Organizing and storing games – Let’s fill up the refrigerator!
Easy to grasp, easy to play – Anyone can pick up the game and start organizing in no time.
We've also introduced a new Mini Game mode to add extra layers of fun and challenge!
Get that satisfying feeling of restocking, just like in real life – Experience the thrill of organizing everyday items in realistic home spaces.
Stack snacks and drinks neatly in the fridge, arrange makeup and accessories on the vanity table, line up toiletries on the bathroom sink, and fold clothes into baskets in the laundry room.
Just click and swipe to perform every action, and enjoy the soothing joy of a perfectly organized space.

bluejetty:00091592:ios.description:
Manage your program from anywhere—list puppies and access our nationwide network of serious buyers actively searching to add a puppy to their home. Manage your applicants, message buyers, accept secure payments, and keep your records all in one place with our app built just for breeders.
With our app, you can:
- Send and receive messages from buyers
- Manage your puppy listings
- Share photos and videos
- Receive and review puppy applications
- Match buyers to puppies
- Receive secure payments and keep your records organized
- Post updates about your puppies with our new built-for-breeders social feed, Good Dog Updates
- Stay updated with the latest Good Dog features, exclusive resources, and discounts
Message your buyers from anywhere
Easily send and receive messages from buyers. Search by name, find conversations quickly, and stay connected throughout the process.
Share photos and videos with buyers

Keep track of applicants

Post your Good Dog Updates from anywhere

Manage your program with ease

Access exclusive resources and discounts
Stay informed with exclusive educational resources, discounts, and updates on new Good Dog features and benefits.
At Good Dog, we’re committed to supporting our certified breeders, the caring families they work with, and the dogs that bring us together.
Finding great homes for your puppies has never been easier. Download the Good Dog Breeder app today.

WATCH NBC'S THE VOICE LIVE ON TV
• WATCH LIVE as the show goes on!
• WATCH video clips of your favorite artists’ performances after each episode.

• FOLLOW the artists on social media.

bluejetty:00041799:ios.description:
The HalalTrip app is now back with an updated look! 
Track your salah with the all new prayer analytics. Plan your next holiday with us and choose from a wide range of Muslim friendly travel packages. Be prepared always with the app that allows you to easily find nearby Halal food and mosques while traveling, Qibla direction of Ka’aba in Makkah (Mecca) – be it on the road, in the plane or on sea - and it is the only app that calculates prayer times and Qibla direction for your flight! 
KEY FEATURES INCLUDE:
- The world's first prayer performance tracker. Allows you to track the percentage of times you pray alone or in Jamaath, where you have prayed (masjid, home, workplace etc.). It also allows you to compare your stats with all users and friends.
- Start your day with an inspirational Islamic quote 
- Nearby interactive map that finds Halal food, Mosques and attractions near you 
- Get Trips-piration from our articles, guides and videos to plan your next Halal trip
- Accurate Prayer Times (Salat/Namaz) and Qibla compass for any location, whether you are on land on a flight
- In-flight Prayer Times and Qibla direction finder when you are on a plane
- Dua for Travelling (Safar/Journey) and others in Arabic and English with audio
- Muslim-friendly travel packages
- Downloadable Muslim Visitor Guides for selected cities
- Buy City Attraction & Dining passes
- Get to know Muslim travel etiquettes
- Help other Muslim by sharing your travel experiences and reviews of new food places, prayer places, attractions, destinations and cities.
- Comprehensive search function to search (by name) Halal restaurants, attractions, mosques, travel packages, HalalTrip passes and articles.
SALAH PERFORMANCE TRACKER
The world's first prayer tracker. With this feature, users can track how they have performed their prayers and make plans to improve. The feature allows you to track the percentage of times you pray alone or in Jamaath, where you have prayed (masjid, home, workplace etc.). Users can also record the Masjid they performed the salah. It also allows you to compare your stats with all users and friends.
NEARBY HALAL RESTAURANTS & FOOD FINDER
Find food and restaurants near you on an interactive map. The nearby feature makes it quick and easy for travelers to instantly discover restaurants within your current location, read reviews and guides and also use it to plan your next trip.
PLAN YOUR NEXT TRIP
Find travel tips and ideas to plan a Muslim-friendly holiday. Holiday packages are tailored for every occasion. A wide range of destinations for family, winter, honeymoon and Islamic heritage tours are available to choose from.
GET PRAYER TIMES AND NEARBY MOSQUES FOR ANY LOCATION
Available in the "Prayer Times" section, get prayer timings (Salat/Salah/Salath/Namaz) for the current location, the distances/directions to mosques and the time it takes to reach masjid. It also shows the fasting times (Imsak and Iftar) for Ramadan. It will also show the remaining time for the next Salat. You can choose calculation method in the "Settings" tab.
IN-FLIGHT PRAYER TIMES AND QIBLA DIRECTION CALCULATOR WHILE ON A PLANE
Get the In-flight Salat schedule for your next trip. Enter the flight details and plan your prayers on board the plane. The calculator also shows Qibla direction along the aeroplane's route. Set up the flight before you start your trip to get the Ka'ba pointer in relation to the flight's path.
QIBLA COMPASS TO LOCATE THE DIRECTION OF KAABA WHEREVER YOU ARE
Qibla (Kaaba) direction finder for any location using an online compass and maps. Just tap on the feature and obtain the precise position using three different methods. 
CITY ATTRACTION AND DINING PASSES
Save by buying HalalTrip passes for Attractions and Dining. Have a hassle-free experience from purchasing the pass to using the pass with QR codes, integrated information and taxi services on the app.
*Now available in English, Arabic, Turkish, Bahasa Indonesia and Bahasa Melayu.

bluejetty:00086955:ios.description:
Nau mai, haere mai | Welcome to Ako Tahi
A grassroots, whānau-led and community-driven Te Reo Māori app. Learn, listen, practice, and share 2,500+ phrases.
Ako Tahi means “Learn Together.” It’s a free Te Reo Māori learning app with 2,500+ commonly used phrases, designed to help you use Te Reo Māori in everyday life, at home, at mahi, and with whānau.
Ako Tahi supports learning through touch, vision, listening, speaking, and by challenging yourself and others.
What you can do with Ako Tahi:
• Explore 2,500+ everyday Te Reo Māori phrases
• Listen to audio to support pronunciation
• Learn and practice at your own pace through simple repetition
• Quickly search and find phrases when you need them
• Share phrases easily, perfect for everyday messaging
Important note
Ako Tahi is not a translation app. You can’t type any word or sentence and receive a full translation. The app contains a curated library of predefined phrases, and search results only show what exists in the app.
Dialect and translations
Ako Tahi uses the Ngāpuhi dialect (Te Tai Tokerau / Northland). We acknowledge dialect differences across Aotearoa, and our translations into the Ngāpuhi dialect are best-effort. We are supported by whānau and fluent speakers who help review and improve phrases over time, to keep the content as accurate and consistent as possible.
We hope this app supports your Te Reo journey.
Ngā mihi nui

TownsFolk – Build. Survive. Explore.
Lead a group of settlers into the unknown and build a thriving colony in a world full of mystery and danger. Manage scarce resources, make tough choices, and face the unpredictable frontier. Will your town prosper or fall?
Lead, Expand, Survive:
• Build & Expand – Grow your village by managing Food, Gold, Faith, and Production.

▪ Roguelite Strategy – New challenges every playthrough.
▪ Skirmish Mode – Test survival skills in standalone scenarios.
▪ Puzzle Challenges – Solve strategic puzzles for rewards.
▪ Pixel Art World – Handcrafted visuals & atmospheric music.

▪ Factions – 5 unique Factions, each with their own strengths, stories, and playstyles.

Play for Free – Upgrade Anytime
TownsFolk lets you jump in for free! Enjoy the How to Play missions, test your skills in Puzzle Missions, and try out Skirmish Mode with a fixed setup.
Want more? A one-time in-app purchase unlocks the full Campaign and lets you customize settings in Skirmish Mode for endless replayability.

bluejetty:00045362:ios.description:
EzWIC provides all the tools to make WIC shopping easy!
The EzWIC app is for families in the Arizona, American Samoa, Commonwealth of the NorthernMariana Islands (CNMI), District of Columbia (DC), Guam, and Navajo Nation Special SupplementalNutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children (WIC) Programs. You can use Clinic Search to find anearby WIC clinic. You can use the Store Locator to find a nearby grocery store to shop for WIC foods.Shopping for WIC foods in the grocery store can be confusing and hard, and this app makes it easier.You can view the Food List in the app to see what types of foods are WIC approved. You can also scanthe barcode of a food with your phone and the app will tell you if it is WIC approved.
Register your eWIC card for additional features:
• Scan the barcode of a food with your phone and the app will show if you can buy the food withyour eWIC card and will display the available benefits. This will help avoid awkward situations inthe checkout lane.
• Check your latest benefit balance at any time.
• See details regarding your current home WIC Clinic.
• Receive and manage additional notifications:
 o Appointment reminders
 o Forgot documents
 o Food benefits expiring soon
 o Food benefits expired
 o Breast pump return reminders
For Arizona WIC Program only: Submit a complaint against WIC Participants, WIC Staff, or WIC Vendorsunder ‘Contact Us’. By selecting the menu called ‘Other Resources” you can view eWIC Card balancesand food list information in multiple languages, or view the “WIC in a Click” Website for WIC trainingvideos.

bluejetty:00065964:ios.description:
THE MOST SATISFYING DRIFTING & TRAFFIC STREET RACING YOU CAN GET ON MOBILE.
Drift Hunters is a realistic drift and racing simulator: highway traffic racing, night drift open world, touge tracks, deep car tuning and the spirit of street racing.
NEW: HIGHWAY BATTLE & TRAFFIC RACING
Hit the night highway at full speed. Swerve through traffic, score near misses, chain combos and chase the perfect clean run:
- Highway Battle - high-speed traffic racing on track sections from short sprints to marathon runs
- Free Drive - highway cruising with adjustable traffic density

A new open world map built for street drifting - drift through live traffic, explore different spawn points, and turn every intersection into your playground.

The new Garage and improved tuning system give you full control: performance upgrades, stance, wheels, body and rim paint. Build your car, dial in your setup, and feel the difference on track.
REALISTIC DRIVING PHYSICS
Physics built for real drifting: natural grip, smooth weight transfer, precise throttle control. Every car feels alive - from classic JDM legends to modern muscle.
FREE DRIVE - PURE FLOW
Practice drift lines, test tuning setups, experiment with cars - or just drift for the vibe and flow state.

Radio Vision Latina 96.7 FM is a Spanish radio station reaching the Latin community to provide guidance on the various problems they are experiencing. 
Testimonies of life transformation are presented on Radio Vision Latina where people testify how a life change is possible through faith. Those who tune in to the radio can also call, since the programs are done live to be able to listen to the needs or problems that people are going through.
The Radio Vision Latina programs also have current news segments, traffic reports that happen in the city of Los Angeles, CA. Listeners can also enjoy music for all tastes and ages. 
Every hour you will hear a different program with messages that inspire and motivate a person not to give up, regardless of the situation, the adversity or the problems that they are experiencing.
Radio Vision Latina can be listened to comfortably from home, car, work or wherever you are. We are here to listen to you wherever you are tuning in and thus be able to provide you with the best possible guidance and solution according to your needs.

• Continuous pads in different keys, with transiti
bluejetty:00200165:ios.description:
PadLab brings ambient pads, drums and instruments together for rehearsals, music creation and live performance. Play on your iPhone or iPad screen, or connect a compatible MIDI controller.
• Continuous pads in different keys, with transitions and level controls.
• Drum Pads with kits, individual sound selection and batch sample import.
• Live Loops, available as a standalone one-time purchase or included in PadLab Full App, for creating patterns and recording quantized drum hits in one-loop or overdub mode. Arrange scenes, build your own kits and explore Gospel/worship presets.
• A Live Loops mixer with volume, pan, mute, solo and convolution reverb with individual sends for each drum part.
• A metronome with adjustable tempo, time signature, sound and volume.
• MIDI Learn for pads, drum parts, transport, volume and set selection.
• Complete performance sets that bring together pads, drums, Live Loops and StageLab instruments and settings when used. Arrange them in Set List for quick access.
• Import and export performance sets and Live Loops sets with the personal files they use. Performance packages can include your samples and SF2 files.
• On-screen guides to help you learn the controls and revisit them whenever needed.
StageLab is an optional expansion unlocked through an in-app purchase. Combine up to eight sounds, use library instruments or import SoundFont SF2 files. Adjust levels, keyboard ranges, MIDI channels, envelopes, EQ, compression and reverb. Per-sound effects include chorus, tremolo, auto pan, drive and Leslie. Master controls provide volume, separate gain up to +9 dB and MIDI Learn.
Inside StageLab, the WAVE 3 synthesizer offers oscillator, filter, envelope and effects editing, plus an integrated arpeggiator and sequencer. Explore a bank of 24 ARP/SEQ presets, create your own sounds and save your presets.
In the standalone app, WAVE 3 and Live Loops follow the shared metronome. The AUv3 extension lets you use instruments in compatible hosts; Live Loops playback is available only in the standalone app. In AUv3, WAVE 3 retains Local/Host clock options.
PadLab Full App includes Live Loops and StageLab, including for existing Full purchasers. WAVE 3 arpeggiator and sequencer are included in StageLab at no additional charge. Previous standalone ARP/SEQ purchasers retain access to their legacy tools. Buying Live Loops alone does not unlock StageLab or all premium drum kits. Other optional sounds, kits and features are offered through in-app purchases. Factory content referenced by a set depends on the library and purchases available on the destination device.

StageLab is an optional expansion unlocked through an in-app purchase. Combine up to eight sounds, use library instruments or import SoundFont SF2 files. Adjust levels, keyboard ranges, MIDI channels, envelopes, EQ, compression and reverb. Per-sound effects include chorus, tremolo, auto pan, drive and Leslie. Master controls provide volume, separate gain up to +9 dB and MIDI Learn.

Inside StageLab, the WAVE 3 synthesizer offers oscillator, filter, envelope and effects editing, plus an integrated arpeggiator and sequencer. Explore a bank of 24 ARP/SEQ presets, create your own sounds and save your presets.

In the standalone app, WAVE 3 and Live Loops follow the shared metronome. The AUv3 extension lets you use instruments in compatible hosts; Live Loops playback is available only in the standalone app. In AUv3, WAVE 3 retains Local/Host clock options.

PadLab Full App includes Live Loops and StageLab, including for existing Full purchasers. WAVE 3 arpeggiator and sequencer are included in StageLab at no additional charge. Previous standalone ARP/SEQ purchasers retain access to their legacy tools. Buying Live Loops alone does not unlock StageLab or all premium drum kits. Other optional sounds, kits and features are offered through in-app purchases. Factory content referenced by a set depends on the library and purchases available on the destination device.

The running app uses GPS tracking to support you during all your sporting activities, be it running, jogging, cycling, inline skating, mountain biking, nordic walking, cross-country skiing, hiking, golfing, riding, walking the dog, long boarding, or whichever winter sport takes your fancy. • Do you want to improve your health or maintain your target weight?
• Do you want to combine sport with fun and share your activities with your friends?

Trusted by over 500 million users, Truecaller uses smart spam detection to help protect you from unwanted calls, scams, and fraud while keeping your communication safe and under control.
CALLER ID & SPAM BLOCKING
• A new Caller ID experience on iPhone with iOS 18.2 and above
• Automatically identify spam, fraud, scam, and robocalls before you pick up
• View and search previously identified calls directly in the Phone app
• Block unwanted callers and reduce spam calls
• Enable spam identification via Settings > Apps > Phone > Call Blocking & Identification
• A paid subscription is required to access this feature
TRUECALLER FAMILY PLAN: PROTECT YOUR LOVED ONES
Share Truecaller Premium with your family and help keep your loved ones protected from spam, scam, and fraud calls.
• Add up to 4 family members to your plan
• Share Premium benefits with your family
• Help your loved ones identify spam and fraud calls
• Keep your family safer from unwanted callers
• One subscription for the whole family
TRUECALLER eSIM: GLOBAL DATA FOR TRAVEL
Stay connected worldwide with Truecaller eSIM — fast, secure, and reliable mobile data wherever you travel.
• Coverage in 155 countries across Europe, Americas, Asia, and more
• Instant activation — no physical SIM required
• Affordable prepaid plans with transparent pricing
• No hidden roaming fees or unexpected charges
• Flexible data options for any trip duration
• Secure, stable connectivity wherever you go
Available for users from selected markets:
Italy, Sweden, Spain, France, Germany, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Netherlands, Belgium, Ireland, Austria, Finland, Czech Rep., Denmark, Hungary, United States, United Kingdom, Australia, Canada, New Zealand, Switzerland, Norway, Chile, Indonesia, Malaysia, South Africa, Egypt, Nigeria
IDENTIFY ANY NUMBER
• Search any phone number to find the name and relevant information
• Works for both local and international numbers
• Easily search numbers from your call history via share extension
TRUECALLER PREMIUM: UPGRADE YOUR EXPERIENCE
• Automatically identify and block spam calls
• Remove all ads
• Unlimited number lookups
• See who viewed your profile
• Family Plan for up to 4 members
• Premium badge on your profile
• Auto-renewing subscription with a free trial for new users
Truecaller respects your privacy. Your phonebook is never made searchable or public.
Terms of use: https://www.truecaller.com/terms-of-service
Please note: Payment for auto-renewing subscriptions will be charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your Account Settings.

bluejetty:00042075:ios.description:
Looking for an easier way to grocery shop, save money and manage your weekly grocery list? The Smith's app makes grocery shopping simple with Delivery, Pickup and In-store options, digital coupons, weekly ads and personalized savings.
Download the Smith's grocery app to shop groceries online and find the best deals all in one place.
Shop Groceries Your Way
 • Order groceries with Pickup (where available) or Delivery
 • Scan a recipe to quickly find ingredients and add them to your cart
 • Shop thousands of additional grocery and household items
Save More on Groceries
 • Browse weekly ads and sales
 • Clip digital coupons and apply them at checkout
 • Discover personalized deals, bonus rewards and Cash Back offers
 • Track and redeem fuel points for gas savings
Fast, Convenient Checkout
 • Use Kroger Pay for fast checkout in-store
 • Add your Fresh Values Rewards Card Card to Apple Wallet
 • View purchase history and quickly reorder favorite items
Helpful Everyday Tools
 • Refill and track Smith's Pharmacy prescriptions
 • Use the store locator to find the nearest Smith's store or fuel center
Improving Your Experience
To provide and personalize our offerings, make recommendations, detect and prevent fraud, and improve our services, we use tools that collect and record your data, which may include your searches for and purchases of health and wellness products. We also may share non-sensitive data with third parties, such as advertising and analytics vendors, social networks, technology providers, and research providers. By continuing to use our websites and apps and shop our store, this means you consent to these practices and accept our Terms (https://www.smithsfoodanddrug.com/i/terms/website-and-app) and our Privacy Policy (https://www.smithsfoodanddrug.com/i/privacy-policy).
To use the Smith's app, you need a Smith's digital account. You can create a digital account and link your Smith's Rewards ID through the app. Don't have a Rewards ID? You'll get one when you create your digital account and enroll in Smith's Rewards Program. You must be 18 to register for an account or join our rewards program (to obtain a Rewards ID). Terms apply: https://www.smithsfoodanddrug.com/i/terms/website-and-app.

bluejetty:00170795:ios.name: Wisuki - Wind and Waves
bluejetty:00170795:ios.summary:
Wisuki is a powerful wind, waves, weather and tide forecast app with advanced features that allows you to instantly find best spots based on your preferred conditions, and analyze forecast data with an unprecedented level of detail.
Wisuki
bluejetty:00170795:ios.description:
Wisuki is a powerful wind, waves, weather and tide forecast app with advanced features that allows you to instantly find best spots based on your preferred conditions, and analyze forecast data with an unprecedented level of detail.
Wisuki helps you to plan even better your outdoor activities like surfing, kitesurfing, windsurfing, fishing, sailing, paragliding, biking and more.
COMMUNITY
• Post sessions, share private or public, like and comment.
• Posting sessions will link them with forecast at the exact session time. 
• Better understand how forecasts work under any conditions. 
• Search and follow other users. 
SPOTS LISTINGS
• Nearby, favorites, and custom spots.
• Wind orientation (offshore, side off, side, side on, onshore).
• Wind direction (wind from right, wind from left).
• Tide trend and tide height (%).
• Time picker (1 hour interval).
• Filters (wind orientation, wind direction and distance).
FORECAST
• 1 hour and 3 hours data intervals.
• 24 hours wind and waves daylight highs.
• Wind: Alert icon, direction, speed, gust.
• Waves: Alert icon, direction, height, period.
• Weather: Alert icon, temperature, clouds, precipitations.
• Forecast chart with 10 minutes resolution.
• Nighttime on/off switch.
• Water temperature.
• Spot time zone.
RADAR
• Animated wind and waves arrows overlaid on spot map.
• Dynamic arrow sizes and colors according to conditions.
• Standard, satellite and hybrid map modes.
• Zoom in and out.
• Time picker (1 hour interval).
MAPS
• Daily highs wind and waves markers.
• Weekday picker.
• Direct access to all spot options.
• Spot tide reference buoy location.
• Standard, satellite and hybrid map modes.
• Route to spot.
TIDES
• 30 days tide forecast and moon phases.
• Moonrise/moonset times, and sunrise/sunset times.
• High/low tide times, height and tidal coefficients.
• Daily detailed tide interactive chart.
• Time to next high/low tide.
STATISTICS
• Wind, waves, weather statistics monthly statistics.
• Wind speed and wind gust average and reliability.
• Waves height and waves period average and reliability.
• Temperature and precipitations average and reliability.
• Wind a waves roses per alert levels and months.
MORE
• Wind units: knots, Beaufort, km/h, mph, m/s.
• Waves units: m, ft.
• Temperature: ºC, ºF.
• Distance: km, mi.
WISUKI PRO
Wisuki PRO membership is a month-to-month or year-to-year subscription that provides unlimited access to all Wisuki app features, like Enhanced forecasts, Forecast charts, Radar charts, Tides chart, and removes all app banners. You can easily cancel anytime, online, 24 hours a day. There are no cancellation fees.
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at the rate of your selected plan above.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings on the device.
Privacy policy: http://wisuki.com/mobile-apps/privacy
Terms of service: http://wisuki.com/mobile-apps/terms
Help: http://wisuki.com/mobile-apps/contact?report=i-need-help

bluejetty:00144583:ios.description:
The 99 app is now much more! In addition to rides with 99Pop, 99Plus, 99electric-Pro, 99Taxi, and 99Moto, you can also send packages with 99Entrega, order food with 99Food, and use 99Pay — the digital account that lets you make Pix transfers, pay bills, grow your money, and even apply for personal loans. Delivery, transport, and payments — all in one app!
Great value, safety, and categories for every moment of your day! With 99, you can travel by car or motorcycle and even send or receive packages. Plus, you can count on our 24-hour support, so you never have to worry about the unexpected.
99 rides are monitored 24 hours a day! There’s also a Help Center in the app whenever you need assistance. With 99, safety comes first — along with comfort and savings.
Check out our ride options:
99Pop: The affordable choice for every occasion.
99Moto: Practical and budget-friendly motorcycle rides for your daily trips.
99Plus: For those who need a more spacious and comfortable ride.
99electric-Pro: Perfect for anyone looking for a quiet, comfortable trip in an electric vehicle.
99Taxi: The traditional taxi, now in your hands — with the safety, comfort, and agility of 99.
99Entrega: Send gifts or business packages safely with 99’s delivery service.
99 has the ideal car, motorcycle, or taxi for whatever you need!
24/7 Support
With 99, passengers have access to 24-hour support for any request related to rides, deliveries, or partner drivers.
Safety
All 99 partner drivers go through a security check before joining the platform. To give you more peace of mind, the app also shows each driver’s total trips and time of service.
Clube99
With Clube99, you get discount coupons to use on your rides at a lower price. To access your vouchers, just open the app, click the menu icon, and tap the gold banner labeled “Clube99.”
99Pay
99Pay is 99’s digital account, available right inside the app. With 99Pay, your money grows up to 110% of the CDI rate every day — even on weekends and holidays. Enjoy convenience and security while you make Pix transfers, pay bills, recharge your phone, earn cashback on 99 rides, and even apply for personal loans.
Convenience
99 makes your route easier by offering ride options by car, motorcycle, or taxi with private drivers, as well as an exclusive category for deliveries and package transport.
Value and safety in every trip — whether by car, motorcycle, taxi, or delivery. Count on 99!

bluejetty:00069109:ios.description:
Solve Match-3 levels and design the mansion in this memorable story with Emma!
Have fun while testing your puzzle solving skills!
Help Emma renovate her Grandpa’s beautiful old mansion. Design the interior and exterior of the house by refurbishing vintage furniture, choosing new stylish objects, and so much more.
Match-3, to unravel an intriguing storyline. Complete levels to unlock new chapters in the story, new rooms to renovate, and uncover hidden mysteries left from her Grandpa!
Adventure is just around the corner, including a little bit of romance.
The game features all sorts of excitement:
• A challenging journey: Solve Match-3 levels and help Emma renovate the old mansion.
• Design: Create your dream house, decide how everything looks!
• Exciting Match-3 levels: A game for puzzle masters, are you up for the challenge?
• Fun characters: Meet Pizza David, Handyman Bob and more. Can you feel the romance in the air?
• A cute pet: Who's a good boy?? Meet Max, Emma's new best friend!
The old mansion is in desperate need of a makeover, and Emma can’t do it alone. Put your decorating skills into practice, choosing various components for the interior and exterior of the house. Maximize the fun by being in control of the design process: You’ll get to pick and choose many of the new items and furniture for the mansion, ensuring that you have a say on the final appearance.
As soon as you solve your first level, you are on your way of helping Emma fix up the old mansion! Play now, and create the house of your dreams!
Learn more about the game on Facebook:
https://www.facebook.com/Puzzleton-111991057300359
Questions? We'd love to help! Contact our support team by sending an email to support@qiiwi.com

bluejetty:00158262:ios.name: PrEPtime Pill Reminder
bluejetty:00158262:ios.description:
{ Intro }
PrEPtime is a reminder app designed to support people taking PrEP (pre-exposure prophylaxis) to prevent HIV infection. Whether you're on a Daily or On Demand regimen, PrEPtime helps you stay on track.
{ Features }
* Daily PrEP: Get a reminder at your chosen time each day.
* On Demand PrEP: Add dates or weekdays when you plan to be sexually active to receive relevant reminders.
* Track intake: See your logged and upcoming PrEP intakes in a timeline and calendar.
* Pill counter: Track your supply and get notified when you're running low.
* Log history: Mark how many pills you took retroactively, even for past days.
* Guideline context: Compare your intake history with your plan and public guidelines.
{ Privacy and Security }
* All data is stored locally on your device.
* The app works offline and does not share any information with third parties.
* Optionally protect access with Face ID or Touch ID (if supported).
* Delete all app data from settings at any time.
{ Disclosure }
PrEPtime is intended only for individuals already using PrEP under medical supervision. It does not provide medical advice or recommendations. Always consult a qualified healthcare provider for guidance. Use of the app is at your own risk.

bluejetty:00073920:ios.description:
Need to know what the marine forecast is before you go boating or during your boating trip? The Boating Weather App for iPhone and iPod Touch is the answer.
This intuitive app will show you the wind speed, surf and wave height for your coastal zone in the United States. Marine weather data is provided by the National Weather Service (NOAA).
Features:
- One touch National Weather Service forecast for today, tonight and this week.
- Shows wind speed, seas wave height and surf forecast.
- Add a location to Favorites for easy reference when switching between zones
- Shows small craft advisories.
- Set your default location to show your local boat weather forecast.
- Simple, intuitive design, quick loading
Whether you want to go on a boating trip, out fishing or for a quick sail, the Boating Weather iPhone App will tell you in a snap what the seas are doing!
Thank you for choosing our marine weather application. We understand that some users have encountered issues due to recent changes in the NOAA API endpoint. Our team has worked diligently to resolve these issues and has updated the application accordingly.
To benefit from these changes, we kindly request that you update or re-install the application. Should you continue to experience difficulties, please don't hesitate to contact us at support@bluewhaleapps.com. Our team is committed to assisting you promptly.

bluejetty:00037813:ios.description:
Die RVV App liefert Ihnen den schnellsten Weg zu Ihrem Ziel und bietet Ihnen selbstverständlich gleich das passende Ticket dazu an. Ausgehend von Ihrem jeweiligen Standort erhalten Sie mittels weniger Klicks eine Auswahl an Möglichkeiten auf dem schnellsten Weg zu Ihrem Ziel zu kommen. Ihr Deutschlandticket und weitere Tickets aus dem Sortiment des RVV für den Gelegenheitsverkehr erhalten Sie über die RVV App jederzeit bequem und schnell auf Ihr Smartphone.

 - Tickets können zum sofortigen Fahrtantritt oder für einen späteren Zeitpunkt gekauft werden
 - Möglichkeit zum Abschluss des Deutschlandticket Abos
 - Bezahlung der Tickets mittels Lastschrift, Kreditkarte und Paypal möglich
 - Die App enthält alle relevanten Informationen zu aktuellen Umleitungen oder weiteren Verkehrsbeschränkungen
 - Häufig genutzte Haltestellen können als persönliche Favoriten angelegt werden
 - In den Einstellungen können weitere Individualisierungen (z. B. TabBar, Fußweggeschwindigkeit, etc.) vorgenommen werden

bluejetty:00164724:ios.description:
Azal is a social voice chat app that helps people connect through group voice rooms and shared interests. Join conversations, Connect with friends and other users locally or globally, and enjoy interactive social features in a friendly community environment.
With Azal, users can communicate through voice chat, messaging, and group interactions while taking part in social games and activities designed to encourage engagement and connection.
Key Features
 Voice Chat Groups
-Join or create group voice chat rooms to talk, laugh, and connect with others. A variety of voice chat rooms are available. 
- Go on the mic, send messages in chat, or exchange virtual gifts to enhance the fun.
- Play mini-games directly in the room for a lively group experience.
 Messaging & Group Chat 
-Send instant messages 
-Participate in group conversations 
-Voice notes, and more in a personal space.
 Virtual Gifts 
-Send virtual gifts to other users.
-Express appreciation and support during chats.
 In-Room Games & Entertainment
Azal offers a variety of casual, social mini-games that can be enjoyed directly within chat rooms. These games are designed for entertainment and social interaction, not real-money gambling.
Available games may include:
- Card and board games such as UNO®, Ludo, and Domino
- Azal Happy Farm, a casual simulation game
- Virtual diamond slot-style games played with in-app virtual currency only
All games are designed purely for entertainment purposes and do not involve real-money gambling or cash rewards.
 PK (friendly user or room challenges for entertainment)) 
-Participate in friendly PK interactions between users or rooms. 
-Engage in social competition for entertainment purposes.
 Families & Communities 
-Create or join families (community groups).
-Build long-term social connections with other users.
 Moments & Stories 
-Share moments and stories with your community. 
-Interact with content shared by others.
Membership Options (VIP & PRO) 
Membership is optional and not required to use the core features of the app.VIP and PRO memberships may include: 
-Visual entrance effects, profile frames, name cards, and microphone animations. 
-VIP or PRO badges displayed on your profile Additional customization and social privileges.
Privacy & Safety 
Azal is committed to providing a respectful and safe environment: 
-Community guidelines apply to all users. 
-Reporting and blocking tools are available.
-Moderation actions may be taken against policy violations.
Contact & Support 
Your feedback helps us improve Azal. 
Email: info@azallive.cn

LaMusica – Your Home for Latin Radio, Livestreams, Playlists & More
Experience the best in Latin music, radio, and live content – all in one place! LaMusica brings you the top Latin radio stations, exclusive livestreams, and expertly curated playlists, connecting you to the industry's hottest sounds and most prominent personalities.
RADIO – The #1 Latin Stations
Tune in to the most popular Latin radio stations in the U.S. and Puerto Rico, playing the latest hits, classic favorites, and exclusive shows:
• New York: La Mega 97.9 (WSKQ), Amor 93.1 (WPAT)
• Miami: El Nuevo Zol 106.7 (WXDJ), Z 92.3 (WCMQ), Ritmo 95 (WRMA)
• Los Angeles: Mega 96.3 (KXOL), La Raza 97.9 (KLAX)
• Puerto Rico: Mega 106.9 (WMEG), Z 93 (WZNT), La Nueva 94 (WODA), Estereotempo 96.5 (WRXD)
• Chicago: La Ley 107.9 (WLEY)
• San Francisco: La Raza 93.3 (KRZZ)
• Houston: La Ley 92.1 (KROI)
• Orlando & Tampa: El Zol 95.3 (WPYO), El Zol 97.1 (WSUN)
Wherever you are, LaMusica keeps you connected to the Latin rhythms you love.
PLAYLISTS – Non-Stop Latin Hits
Discover hundreds of expertly curated playlists featuring the best in Reggaeton, Salsa, Bachata, Merengue, Regional Mexican, Latin Pop, and more. Whether you're getting hyped for a party, chilling at home, or working out, we have the perfect playlist.
LIVESTREAMS – Your Favorite Radio Shows, Anytime
Get up close and personal with the most prominent voices in Latin radio through exclusive livestreams of your favorite shows:
• El Vacilón De La Gatita
• El Despelote
• El Vacilón de La Mañana
• El Circo
• What's Up
• Mega Reguero
• La Guerrilla de la Mega
• El Barrio 94
• El Party de la Tarde
Enjoy real-time entertainment, exclusive interviews, and the latest music trends, all at your fingertips.
WE WANT TO HEAR FROM YOU!
Your feedback helps us improve! Let us know what features you'd love to see in future updates by emailing us at feedback@lamusica.com. Be part of making LaMusica the ultimate app for Latin music lovers.
Download LaMusica today and turn up the volume on the best Latin music experience!
