bluejetty:00016377:ios.description:
There's usually one question you keep circling back to. Whether it's going to work out. Whether they're still thinking about you. Whether you're on the right path at all.
FaldanAdam sits down and answers it. Sometimes in seconds. Sometimes because a real person spent an hour on it.
ONE FREE READING EVERY DAY
A credit renews every morning and a coffee reading costs exactly one, so there is always something you can do without paying. You can start without making an account.
UNDERSTAND WHY YOU'RE LIKE THIS
Give your birth date, time and place once. Your Sun, Moon and Rising are read separately: what comes easily to you, where you keep getting stuck, what you actually need from people. It isn't a chart you look at once and forget — every morning you're told what the sky is doing to it today, in plain language, no jargon.
START THE DAY KNOWING WHAT'S IN IT
A short read waits for you each morning: the day's mood, one sentence worth sitting with, and two lists — what to lean into today, what to leave alone. Your love, career, money and health are scored out of ten, with your lucky hours and colour underneath.
HAVE A PERSON READ IT, NOT A MODEL
Pick one of the readers in the app. You can see their rating, how many reviews they have and what they actually read. They take your order, write it by hand and send it back in about an hour. You don't have to sit and wait: the countdown runs on your Lock Screen and you get a notification when it lands. If something in the answer raises a new question, you can send that same person a follow-up; it costs a few more credits.
SEE WHERE THE RELATIONSHIP IS GOING
Put two charts side by side. Love, communication, long term and passion, each scored, then a straight answer about what to do with it. Katina, a Turkish card system that reads nothing but romance, gives you the same thing from the other direction — and you choose the cards yourself.
PULL YOUR OWN CARDS
In tarot you shuffle, you choose, you turn each card over. Love, career, your path, or knowing yourself better. In palm reading you hold your hand up to the camera and your life, head and heart lines are traced on your own palm before they're read.
READ WHAT'S LEFT IN THE CUP
This is where the app started. Photograph the grounds in your coffee cup and the symbols are found one at a time — where each one sits, what it means. Turkish coffee has been read this way for centuries, and it still lands harder than it has any right to.
ASK ONE REAL QUESTION
Not a chatbot. You ask the thing that's on your mind, a long answer comes back without padding, and that's the end of it.
NOTHING YOU READ GETS LOST
Everything sits in one list by date. Months later you can go back and see what it said at the time. Keep the ones you want to find again.
FALDANADAM PREMIUM
Premium doubles your daily credit, opens your full history, removes ads, unlocks the one-question feature, takes 50% off every reader in the app and halves how long you wait for them.
Weekly and yearly plans, both starting with 3 days free. The current price is shown on the purchase screen and payment is charged to your Apple Account on confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends; manage or cancel yours in Settings › Apple Account › Subscriptions.
Terms of Use: https://faldanadam.com/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://faldanadam.com/privacy.html
SUPPORT
Write to us and a person answers: destek@faldanadam.com

A credit renews every morning and a coffee reading costs exactly one, so there is always something you can do without paying. You can start without making an account.

UNDERSTAND WHY YOU'RE LIKE THIS
Give your birth date, time and place once. Your Sun, Moon and Rising are read separately: what comes easily to you, where you keep getting stuck, what you actually need from people. It isn't a chart you look at once and forget — every morning you're told what the sky is doing to it today, in plain language, no jargon.

START THE DAY KNOWING WHAT'S IN IT
A short read waits for you each morning: the day's mood, one sentence worth sitting with, and two lists — what to lean into today, what to leave alone. Your love, career, money and health are scored out of ten, with your lucky hours and colour underneath.

HAVE A PERSON READ IT, NOT A MODEL
Pick one of the readers in the app. You can see their rating, how many reviews they have and what they actually read. They take your order, write it by hand and send it back in about an hour. You don't have to sit and wait: the countdown runs on your Lock Screen and you get a notification when it lands. If something in the answer raises a new question, you can send that same person a follow-up; it costs a few more credits.

SEE WHERE THE RELATIONSHIP IS GOING
Put two charts side by side. Love, communication, long term and passion, each scored, then a straight answer about what to do with it. Katina, a Turkish card system that reads nothing but romance, gives you the same thing from the other direction — and you choose the cards yourself.

PULL YOUR OWN CARDS
In tarot you shuffle, you choose, you turn each card over. Love, career, your path, or knowing yourself better. In palm reading you hold your hand up to the camera and your life, head and heart lines are traced on your own palm before they're read.

READ WHAT'S LEFT IN THE CUP
This is where the app started. Photograph the grounds in your coffee cup and the symbols are found one at a time — where each one sits, what it means. Turkish coffee has been read this way for centuries, and it still lands harder than it has any right to.

ASK ONE REAL QUESTION
Not a chatbot. You ask the thing that's on your mind, a long answer comes back without padding, and that's the end of it.

NOTHING YOU READ GETS LOST
Everything sits in one list by date. Months later you can go back and see what it said at the time. Keep the ones you want to find again.

FALDANADAM PREMIUM
Premium doubles your daily credit, opens your full history, removes ads, unlocks the one-question feature, takes 50% off every reader in the app and halves how long you wait for them.
Weekly and yearly plans, both starting with 3 days free. The current price is shown on the purchase screen and payment is charged to your Apple Account on confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends; manage or cancel yours in Settings › Apple Account › Subscriptions.

bluejetty:00179150:ios.description:
ShiftKing – The Essential Shift Schedule App for Shift Workers!
Manage your shift schedule with ease using calendars and widgets.
Record vacations, shift swaps, and replacement shifts all in one place.
Get instant access to over 3,000 company shift schedules.
Key Features
1. View your shift schedule at a glance on the calendar.
2. Apply vacations, shift swaps, replacement shifts, and other schedule changes to your roster.
3. View your shift schedule in an easy-to-read table format.
4. Check your shift schedule directly from your Home Screen with widgets.
5. Calculate your annual leave quickly and easily.
+ Help expand our company shift schedule database so your coworkers can find their schedules more easily.
++ If your company's shift pattern is irregular, send the schedule information to the developer and we'll add it to the database.
========= How to Use =========
1. Go to Settings > Company Search, select your company, and start using your shift schedule instantly.
2. If your company is not listed, you can create your own shift schedule.
3. After creating your schedule (including coworkers' shifts), enable "Send to Developer" to submit it for inclusion in the database.
● Tap a date to record shift changes, notes, and overtime hours.
● Assign custom colors to each shift type.
● Display the lunar calendar.
● Show public holidays from your device's default calendar.
● Import events from your device's default calendar.
■ If your company's shift pattern is irregular, send the schedule information to the developer and we'll add it to the database.
■ If you have an irregular work pattern (such as nurses), select "Settings > Make New Shift> Direct Type" to enter your shifts directly from the main screen.

bluejetty:00134653:ios.description:
USE ROUTE PLANNER APP TO PLAN ALMOST UNLIMITED ROUTES AND UNLIMITED ADDRESSES PER ROUTE.
Routing chaos finally solved, plan your appointments, pickups, and deliveries into the optimized sequence using enRoute Route Planner. Save your time and fuel, when you are covering many stop points. Leverage the app’s AI engine to increase your savings.
Are you a professional road warrior, field-sales rep, field-service tech, delivery driver? Or an explorer, driving (or riding) multi-destination routes? Plan, drive & organize details for your exploration or reporting purpose. Your route guide is in your pocket!
Start connecting-the-dots (route) automatically!
Powerful features to help you:
► Plan a trip covering more than 10 stoppages en-route.
► Effectively plan return trips.
► Automatically re-sequence stop points in route using Artificial Intelligence to save your time and so cost.
► Save frequent stops and add them easily in next trips.
► Auto save route history to re-plan trips covering the same places.
► Share your route history with co-workers & friends to help them access the best route.
► Get step-by-step navigation and voice instructions using your favorite apps like Google Maps, Apple Maps, or Waze.
► Keep track of progress by marking locations visited and departed.
► Store status at each stop point such as delivery notes, pics, customer signatures in a few taps.
► View & export trip details including photos & signs as helpful reports.
► Estimate with accuracy - know exactly how long your route will take and how many miles (or kilometers) you will drive.
When people use this app:
• A Gift Shop owner has a guy, who needs to deliver a gift pack at each of 15 locations in town.
• A company’s service engineer needs to visit 11 sites, and report completion status with photos.
• 3 friends are on a charity drive covering different routes, and meet at the same destination for dinner.
• Mr. mechanic needs to repair 4 cars broken down at popular junctions in city.
• And many other situations that have more stops in route...
Help yourself to plan the best routes! Instantly fix incorrect choices, inaccurate time estimations, and inefficient driving. Be a smart driver, download this enRoute app and experience the magic.

bluejetty:00034816:ios.summary: Welcome to the official app of the New Jersey Devils and Prudential Center! Find all of your event needs, access tickets, explore the arena offerings and so much more in our mobile app. Whether you’re a die hard Devils fan, or visiting the
bluejetty:00034816:ios.description:
Welcome to the official app of the New Jersey Devils and Prudential Center! Find all of your event needs, access tickets, explore the arena offerings and so much more in our mobile app. Whether you’re a die hard Devils fan, or visiting the Prudential Center to see your favorite performer, our app is your one-stop shop to have a seamless experience. Find the latest Devils game highlights, news and real time updates, as well as Prudential Center event announcements right here.Features:NJ Devils
• Latest Devils Team News, Video, and Game Highlights: Never miss a thing about your favorite players and team! Read recent news, find video highlights, injury reports, and more.
• Team Schedule, Roster, Stats, and Standings: Stay on top of the Devils and individual players performance over the season. See who leads the team in points!
• Real-time Box Scores and Stats: Keep up with each game remotely! Never miss a beat even if you can’t tune in to the game.
• Live Game Radio Broadcasts: Tune in to listen to each game in real time!
• Interactive In-Arena Games: Participate in fun games while at Prudential Center. Enter for chances to win, even if it is bragging rights!
• Customizable Push Notifications: Set your app up to your personal preferences. Get notified about what you want to know most, enter sweepstakes, and more.Black and Red Member HQ
• Mobile Ticket Management: Easily access your tickets from your phone, forget about paper tickets. Manage your tickets directly in the app with Ticketmaster.
• Member Quick Links for Buy Back, Swap Program and More: Convenient ways to access special programs with the Devils.
• Personal Account Manager Contact Details: Get all of your questions answered by our dedicated account teams.
• Member Exclusive Content: As a Black and Red Member, you can access exclusive content that is only available to you - get the inside scoop about the Devils!Prudential Center
• Latest Prudential Center News: From seasonal events, to popups at the arena, and event announcements, never miss a thing about what’s happening at the Rock!
• Prudential Center Event Calendar: Check out our calendar of upcoming events. Filter by event type; whether you want to see a concert, family show, comedy, browse our calendar today!
• Event Ticket Management: Manage your tickets for upcoming events in our app. Hassle free entry every time!
• Interactive Concourse and Seating Map: Locate the nearest restrooms, food or drink options, easily find your section, and much more in our interactive maps.
• Arena Information, Parking, and A to Z guide: Ensure a worry-free trip to Prudential Center and easily plan out your transportation, find our bag policies, and more!
The New Jersey Devils are part of the 32-team National Hockey League, with teams throughout the United States and Canada. Established in 1982, they are celebrating their 42nd season in the Garden State. During that time, the team has won three Stanley Cup Championships: 1995, 2000 and 2003.
Prudential Center is the world-class sports and entertainment venue located in downtown Newark, New Jersey. Opened in October 2007, the state of the art arena is the home of the New Jersey Devils, Seton Hall University’s NCAA Division I Men’s Basketball program, and more than 175 concerts, family shows and special events each year. 
Prudential Center is recognized as one of the premier venues in the United States, and hosts over 2 million guests annually.
The New Jersey Devils organization and Prudential Center are properties of Harris Blitzer Sports & Entertainment.

bluejetty:00140699:ios.description:
Stay connected and protect your family’s digital well-being with Watchly Last Seen Tracker, the AI-powered family assistant for real-time online activity monitoring. Whether you’re a parent managing your children’s screen time or simply staying updated on your family’s online habits, Watchly offers powerful tools to keep you informed and in control.
Key Features:
 • AI Family Assistant: Get insights and suggestions on managing your family’s screen time, powered by AI to help promote healthy digital habits.
 • Parental Control & Family Tracking: Monitor your children’s online activities in real-time and ensure they’re developing responsible online habits.
 • Instant Real-Time Notifications: Receive immediate alerts when family members go online or offline, ensuring you stay updated without delay.
 • Track Multiple Family Members: Add and monitor several family members at once for a comprehensive overview of everyone’s online activity.
 • Detailed Activity Reports: Analyze when and how long your family members are active on messaging apps, with easy access to in-depth usage reports.
 • Historical Data Tracking: Review past activity to spot long-term online behavior trends and adjust screen time management accordingly.
 • Privacy & Security: Watchly only uses publicly available data for tracking. You’re always in control of your data, with easy deletion options available in the app.
Why Choose Watchly?
 • AI-Driven Insights: Let AI assist you in improving your family’s online habits, making screen time management easier than ever.
 • Parental Control Simplified: A must-have tool for parents looking to oversee their children’s online behavior and screen time in a responsible way.
 • Comprehensive Tracking: Stay informed about your family’s online activity with real-time notifications and detailed reports, all in one place.
 • Secure & Private: Your data belongs to you. Watchly never accesses private messages, and your data can be deleted anytime with a single tap.
Download Watchly Last Seen Tracker today and take control of your family’s online activities with confidence.

Watchly offers a subscription with in-app purchases. Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at the time of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel your subscription in your iTunes account settings.

Got a tricky problem on your hands? Just use the camera to scan and watch Solvi work its magic. You’ll get not only the answer but also detailed step-by-step solutions that help you understand the process, making it easier for you to tackle similar problems in the future.

bluejetty:00015463:ios.name: Mental Math Cards Games & Tips
bluejetty:00015463:ios.summary: Want to improve your math skills without having to memorize a hundred tricks? Mental Math Cards is designed to help people of all ages and skill levels improve their arithmetic abilities through easy to remember (and use) tips, practice que
bluejetty:00015463:ios.description:
Want to improve your math skills without having to memorize a hundred tricks? Mental Math Cards is designed to help people of all ages and skill levels improve their arithmetic abilities through easy to remember (and use) tips, practice question sets, and an addictive game. Unlike many other math apps, advanced problems are also supported to keep things challenging as your skills improve.
Mental Math Cards is fully integrated with Game Center - providing both Leaderboards and Achievements. The Game Center features allow you to test your skills against the rest of the world and to share your scores and accomplishments with friends. 
Mental Math Cards provides step by step instructions on how to approach solving all of the problems it shows - for all operations and difficulty levels. Each difficulty level for each operation type is carefully thought out to build on the skills mastered in previous levels. For instance, hard multiplication problems are shown to be solvable by breaking problems down into medium and easy level problems. 
Students: Prepare for the math sections of the PSAT, SAT, ACT, GRE, GMAT, and MCAT, as well as for regular school tests. Many tests don't allow for calculators, and greater comfort with arithmetic will still improve your scores even if calculators are allowed. 
Professionals: Impress colleagues, family, and friends with lightning fast and accurate mental math skills. Impress interviewers during job interviews that have quantitative component by solving problems without needing a pencil and paper. 
Mental Math Cards supports 1 by 1, 2 by 1, 2 by 2, and 3 by 3 digit problems. Given that flexibility, Mental Math Cards is as appropriate for use by beginning students as it is for college graduates looking to sharpen their skills for quantitative interviews and to impress friends & colleagues.
Mental Math Cards supports all four of the major arithmetic operations - as well as a mixed operations mode that randomly shows all types of problems. 
- Addition
- Subtraction
- Multiplication
- Division
Feel free to contact me with any feedback and feature suggestions.
==================================
Mental Math Cards Pro Edition Subscription
Mental Math Cards provides additional features using a subscription model - that includes a 3 day trial period. Purchases will be applied to your iTunes account at the end of the trial period. Subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled within 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel anytime with your iTunes account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription. For more information, see our Privacy Policy and Terms of Service - linked below.
Please visit the following link for more information on AppStore app subscriptions: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039.
Our Privacy Policy: https://app.termly.io/document/privacy-policy/a868b26d-f39d-40f2-ad2d-bf5caba22382
Our Terms of Service: https://app.termly.io/document/terms-of-use-for-ios-app/f7c97c5f-d070-420c-999a-b32fdec5dcb2

***** - Epic - "This app really works I got an a+ on my math test when I studied with this app"

bluejetty:00045036:ios.description:
State Bank IN Mobile is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with State Bank Mobile:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount.
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend.
Transfer money between your accounts.
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back.
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it.
View and save your monthly statements.
Find branches and ATMs near you.
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the State Bank Mobile app, you must be enrolled as a State Bank digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

- Select a photo from your gallery or share from other apps like Facebook, Twitter, Chrome, or Google Photos.

- Photos are stored for only 24 hours and can be removed instantly with our 'Quick Removal' feature.
- Images are processed on remote GPU servers, ensuring quick and secure colorization.
We Value Your Feedback:
- Use the 'Report Bug' feature within the app or contact us directly with any issues or suggestions. Your input helps us improve.
Tips for Best Results:
- Ensure source images have good quality, contrast, focus, and correct orientation.
- Preprocessing like contrast correction or sharpening can enhance results.

bluejetty:00044657:ios.summary:

TEAM CHAT
An announcements channel that only coaches post in, so the important message doesn't get
bluejetty:00044657:ios.description:
Bravara is the app coaches use to run their team's season. Chat, schedule, player development and game day are in one place, for any sport.
TEAM CHAT
An announcements channel that only coaches post in, so the important message doesn't get buried. Replies go in threads. Parents choose what notifies them, like mentions only.
CALENDAR AND RSVPS
See the season in a month view. Open any game or practice to RSVP, get directions, or record video. Coaches see who's coming.
TASKS AND SIGN-UPS
Send families the things you need from them, like snack sign-ups, jersey sizes and photo orders, and see what's done.
PLAYER DEVELOPMENT
Assign drills with video that players do at home. Softball IQ and Basketball IQ teach players where to be on a 3D field or court.
SCORE AND STREAM (BASEBALL AND SOFTBALL)
Score games pitch by pitch, by tap or by voice. Families follow the live game view, and you get a box score and stats when it ends. Stream the game from a phone.
BASKETBALL PLAYS
Draw a play with your finger, watch it run step by step, and share it with your team.
TRYOUTS AND DRAFTS
Rate players at evaluations and build teams from the results.
Evaluation, draft, and season tools require access through a participating Bravara league. The league purchases its Bravara plan separately; there is no purchase option for that plan in this app.
Softball IQ and Basketball IQ team training are optional. Unlocking all plays, weekly lessons, and the team leaderboard requires a separate in-app subscription. A sample play is available without a subscription.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Bravara Terms of Service: https://bravara.com/terms

bluejetty:00015810:ios.description:
Total Brain helps you understand and train all your brain capacities to improve your mental health and wellness.
Founded on the principle that our mental health can be measured, improved and managed like our physical health, Total Brain measures the 12 brain capacities that define your mental health and screens for the risk of common mental conditions. Then, based on that assessment, Total Brain provides you with specific mental fitness programs designed to strengthen your brain capacities and improve your mental health. 
Scientific, Simple and Convenient to Use:
Measure Monthly - Take our easy to use, 20 minute, confidential, clinically validated assessment.
Understand Totally - Get results showing 12 brain capacities that identify strengths/weaknesses and potential health risks.
Train Specifically – Start a custom mental fitness program with digital brain exercises, breathing and meditation for just 15 minutes a day, then reassess and track progress.
Benefits:
Self-Awareness – Learn about your strengths, weaknesses and risk of mental conditions
Effectiveness Monitoring – Monitor the impact of mental fitness programs and treatment 
Confidentially Screen – Screen for risk of common mental conditions and receive immediate, in-app referrals to third party health services 
Improved Performance [1] – Measurable improvement across each of the 12 brain capacities, yielding an improvement in overall mental health

bluejetty:00095649:ios.description:
Lumo is a zero-access encrypted AI assistant that keeps every conversation private. Your data is never logged, shared, or used to train models. Your chats are yours, and yours alone. 
Built by Proton, the privacy brand trusted by over 100 million people and the team behind Proton Mail, VPN, Drive, and Pass.
THOUGHTFUL HELP FOR ANY TASK
Lumo handles everything from quick questions to more complex work. Choose Fast for quick answers or Thinking for multi-step reasoning.
FAST, POWERFUL WEB SEARCH
Get precise, real-time answers in seconds. Lumo cites live sources so you can verify facts, dig deeper, and stay current on news, events, financial data, and more.
CREATE AND REFINE IMAGES AND FILES
Work with images and files just by telling Lumo what you need, from generating and editing images to analyzing documents. Connect your Proton Drive account for seamless access to stored files.
AI THAT EVOLVES OVER TIME
Lumo gets better every time you use it. Memory retains context and preferences across sessions, and you can set tones and styles to get the exact Lumo experience you want.
STAY PRODUCTIVE AND ORGANIZED
Projects give you dedicated encrypted spaces for tasks that span multiple chats, files, and instructions, while Custom Lumos let you create assistants tailored for specific tasks. Switch between light and dark modes for a more comfortable experience throughout the day.
GHOST MODE
For conversations where you want maximum privacy, choose Ghost Mode. Chats are instantly deleted once you close them for greater peace of mind.
PRIVACY YOU CAN VERIFY
Lumo is founded on zero-access encryption with no server-side chat logs, and never uses your data for profit or model training. Like all Proton products, Lumo is built and hosted in Europe and is fully open-source.
Lumo helps you stay productive, curious, and informed — without ever compromising your privacy. Start a confidential chat for free today.

bluejetty:00038452:ios.description:
Welcome to the livesign app: the most advanced, straightforward and convenient digital identity verification and document signing solution. 
livesign works in combination with document signing platforms that utilise the livesign verification API for VOI, so you can be confident the person behind the keyboard is who they say they are. It's witnessing reimagined, not removed.
livesign uses biometric and cryptographic technology that binds the person behind the device at the point of signing, to their ePassport, Driver's License or any other government issued photo ID.
How does livesign work?
 • ePassports have a contactless NFC chip that is digitally encrypted by the issuing country to prevent cloning as well as protected to safeguard against unauthorised access
 • livesign uses the smartphone camera and Optical Character Recognition (OCR) technology to scan the Machine Readable Zone (MRZ), which are the two lines at the bottom of the passport, for the password information needed to unlock the chip
 • The complex cryptography that is needed to verify the authenticity of and information on the chip provides a secure, smart and simple way to verify the authenticity of your signer's identity, in seconds
 • The ePassport chip contains reliable government issued information about the holder, including their full name, birth date and nationality. This is done without any manual input by the user to remove the opportunity for accident or deliberate data-entry error
 • The chip also contains a high-resolution photo at a much higher quality than the photo printed on the identity document, providing the highest possible source image. This government issued image then biometrically bound to the signer via a passive liveness verification to reduce look-alike fraud
 • By synchronizing the digital signing and digital identity process, livesign technology provides clarity and certainty that the person signing your digital documents is who they say they are.
Benefits of livesign:
 • Higher compliance and lower risk of fraud
 • Digital signing with accurate and reliable witnessing
 • Identity check at the exact moment of signing
 • Secure, smart and simple way to verify the authenticity
 • Witnessing and signing in just seconds
 • An effortless customer experience
How to verify your identity with livesign:
 • You will need to install livesign if you have been asked to verify your identity while signing documents issued by your legal representative.
 • Enter the phone number of the device you are using via the livesign window that appears at the time of signing a document
 • Multiple signers can share the same device simply be entering the same phone number
 • You will be required to take pictures of your government issued ID and confirm certain details
 • You will be required to take a selfie to confirm your identity
 • In the interest of security none of your documents or details are stored within the livesign app on your phone
 • Copies are encrypted on livesign secure web servers and will be shared with your legal representative only

bluejetty:00186214:ios.name: Juno: New Origins Complete Ed.
bluejetty:00186214:ios.summary: Bring to life anything you can imagine from rockets and airplanes to cars and more. Automate them with a visual programming language. Explore 3D planets and download more from the community. Share your creations online. Complete contracts,
bluejetty:00186214:ios.description:
Bring to life anything you can imagine from rockets and airplanes to cars and more. Automate them with a visual programming language. Explore 3D planets and download more from the community. Share your creations online. Complete contracts, conquer milestones, and unlock technology in the newly added Career Mode.
AEROSPACE SANDBOX
Juno: New Origins is a 3D aerospace sandbox where players can use customizable parts to construct and test rockets, planes, cars, or anything they can imagine in an environment with realistic physics across land, sea, air, and space.
CAREER MODE + TECH TREE
Take control of your own aerospace company and earn money and tech points as you progress through the game. Complete contracts to earn money, and discover a mixture of hand-crafted and procedural contracts that offer countless hours of new gameplay. Conquer milestones and explore landmarks to earn tech points and unlock new technology in the tech tree. Interactive tutorials are available to show how to build and operate rockets, cars, and airplanes.
RESIZE AND RESHAPE PARTS
Stretch and shape fuel tanks, wings, cargo bays, fairings, and nose cones with easy-to-use tools that help you create exactly what you want. Resize solar panels, landing gear, pistons, jet engines, etc to fit your needs. Paint your craft custom colors and tweak their reflectiveness, emissiveness, and texture styles.
DESIGN ROCKET AND JET ENGINES
Engines can be adjusted in a myriad of ways, such as changing the power cycle, combustion pressure, gimbal range, fuel type, and adjusting nozzle performance and visuals. You can customize an engine to be a power house for lift off, or to be a super optimized vacuum engine that maximizes Isp for interplanetary travel. The engine's performance affects its visuals in flight too as shown by the exhaust's expansion or contraction based on its interplay with the atmospheric pressure. Shock diamonds are pretty but they are a symptom of suboptimal engine performance! If you don't care about any of this, then you can just attach a pre-built engine and hit launch!
PROGRAM YOUR CRAFTS
Easily drag and drop code blocks to program your crafts to log telemetry, automate them, design your own MFD touch screens, etc. With Vizzy, a programming language designed specifically for Juno: New Origins, you can expand the capabilities of your crafts while learning programming, maths, physics, etc.
REALISTIC ORBIT SIMULATION
Orbits are realistically simulated and support time-warp so you don't have to wait several months to reach another planet. The Map View makes it easy to see your orbits and plan future burns, which you can use to set up future encounters with other planets or satellites.
DOWNLOAD CRAFTS, SANDBOXES, AND MORE
Download from a huge collection of user-uploaded crafts, sandboxes, and planets on SimpleRockets.com. Upload your own crafts and sandboxes and share them with the community. Rise through the ranks from a white level builder to a gold level builder and beyond.

bluejetty:00065196:ios.description:
PayNow for Stripe is a minimalist point of sales app, allowing you to accept card payments quickly and easily using just your iPhone.
FEATURES
•  Accept all major debit and credit cards - Visa, MasterCard, American Express
•  Take payments in 135+ currencies!
•  Supports Tap to Pay payments
•  No extra hardware required
•  Highest level of security & PCI Compliance
•  Use device camera to populate card details fast (optional)
•  Simple, intuitive & elegant UI
•  Cost is 0.8% per transaction + Stripe fees
We are a Stripe verified partner: https://stripe.com/partners/paynow
Full details and FAQs on our website at https://paynow-app.com//
WHAT DOES IT COST?
PayNow for Stripe adds a fee of 0.8% per transaction.
Stripe has its own costs, which are outlined on their website at https://stripe.com/pricing
Stripe has no set up fees, no monthly fees, no refund fees, and no hidden costs.
All up, this is about as cheap as it gets for processing credit cards.
WHAT IS STRIPE?
Stripe is a credit card processor for web and mobile. They process billions of dollars a year for thousands of companies of all sizes. One of the best things about Stripe is their awesome set of APIs, which allow developers to build tools that do more with Stripe – that’s what we've done with this app. You will need a Stripe account to use PayNow for Stripe, and keep in mind is that it’s Stripe doing the real work. PayNow is just a nicely designed mobile app interface you can use to talk (send a credit card charge) to Stripe. Please visit our website to find out more.
TRANSLATIONS
The app has translations in a handful of languages so far. If you want to submit a correction to your language, or translate a new language we would be very grateful for your help. Visit this link: https://poeditor.com/join/project/ruLhR2MJHF
LEGAL INFO
EULA & Privacy Policy: https://paynow-app.com/eula-privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00185260:ios.description:
Letterboxd for iOS puts the popular social network for film lovers on your iPhone or iPad, so you can log films and catch up on your friends’ activity with ease.
Sign in with your existing account (or create one for free) to enjoy our native app interface. These features of the web experience are supported, with more to come:
– Sign in (with 1Password support) or create an account
– Browse popular, highly rated and most anticipated films (including our official list of the Top 250 Narrative Features)
– Log films with date, rating, review and tags
– View film info (including cast & crew, popular lists and reviews) and rate, like, watchlist or mark as watched
– View (and filter) your activity feed
– Read and comment on reviews and lists
– Create and edit lists
– View member profiles including films, reviews, diary entries, tags, stats and more
– Follow members to see their activity in your feed
– Filter and sort collections of films based on specific criteria
– Search for films, content and people
– Edit your profile settings
Our app offers account upgrades:
– Upgrade to 1 Year of Letterboxd Pro or Patron
– Pro tier adds annual and all-time stats pages based on your account activity, advanced activity and streaming service filters (including the option to pick and filter by the streaming services you subscribe to, powered by JustWatch.com), list cloning and removes third-party ads.
– Patron tier provides all the benefits of Pro, plus the option to customize film posters, backdrops on your profile and content (if available), additional stats, a listing in the Patrons directory on our website and early access to new features.
– Payment is charged to your iTunes Account when you confirm purchase and your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is disabled at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Your iTunes account will be charged for a renewal up to 24 hours before the end of each current period, at the same annual fee.
– You can manage your subscription and disable auto-renewals in the App Store app following purchase.
– Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription to that publication, where applicable
Our terms of use are always available at: https://letterboxd.com/legal/terms-of-use/
We welcome your feedback regarding Letterboxd for iOS. Please email us: hello@letterboxd.com

bluejetty:00128633:ios.summary: Looking for the perfect Christmas gift for your little engineer? Labo Christmas Train is the ultimate digital train toy that combines the creativity of brick building with the charm of classic wooden railway play. Designed to inspire the ne
bluejetty:00128633:ios.description:
Looking for the perfect Christmas gift for your little engineer? Labo Christmas Train is the ultimate digital train toy that combines the creativity of brick building with the charm of classic wooden railway play. Designed to inspire the next generation of inventors, this STEM-focused app lets children create, build, and engineer their own train masterpieces.
Why Parents Choose Labo Christmas Train:
• STEM Learning Excellence: Hands-on engineering skills through creative train building
• Classic Train Designs: Classic blue locomotives and timeless train aesthetics young engineers love
• Educational Value: Develops spatial reasoning, problem-solving, and creativity
• Christmas Gift Ready: The perfect present for curious young minds who love to build
Two Creative Modes for Every Young Builder:
• Template Mode: Choose from 60+ classical locomotive templates (Steam Engines, Diesel Powerhouses, Modern High-Speed Rails)
• Free Mode: Design original trains using colorful digital bricks and custom parts
Build Like Young Inventors:
• Multiple brick styles for creative construction
• 10+ vibrant colors for personal expression
• Authentic train wheels and mechanical parts
• Extensive sticker collection for customization
• Real physics simulation for realistic movement
Railway Adventures:
After building their masterpiece, children can embark on exciting railway adventures, race against time, and explore endless possibilities with built-in mini-games that reinforce STEM concepts through play.
Educational Philosophy:
"To invent, you need a good imagination and a pile of junk." — Thomas Edison
We believe in nurturing the inventive spirit that Edison embodied - the combination of creativity and hard work that leads to breakthrough innovations. This app provides a safe, educational sandbox where children experiment with engineering principles while having fun. Perfect for ages 4-12, it's designed to grow with your child's developing skills and inspire their inner inventor.
About Labo Lado
Labo Lado develops apps for kids that inspire creativity and pique curiosity. We don't collect personal information or include third-party advertising.
Privacy Policy: https://www.labolado.com/apps-privacy-policy.html
Contact Us
We value your feedback! Email us at app@labolado.com with questions, suggestions, or concerns.
Summary
Perfect for train fans and young creators! Labo Christmas Train is a digital train toy and simulator that lets kids become train builders and drivers. Create trains freely or build classic locomotives from templates. Race your custom trains on scenic railways. An excellent creative game for kids and preschoolers who love transportation, trains, and railway adventures.

Create a Task Force with players around the world to take on the enemy together in fierce multiplayer combat. Scout, plan, then BOOM THE BEACH in this action-packed RTS warzone!
Experience the thrill of war and shooting as you engage in RTS combat. Strengthen your army and build a powerful kingdom to dominate the warzone. Utilize strategy and war skills to conquer enemy bases and emerge victorious in this multiplayer RTS war game.
Strengthen your defenses and expand your kingdom as you explore the vast archipelago. Only the bravest will lead their kingdom to ultimate supremacy in Boom Beach's thrilling RTS warzone. War Battles

Explore the Archipelago

Combat Blackguard Bosses

Build Your Army

How to Build Strong Arms in Only 30 Days? 
How to Develop Arm Muscles at Home?
The Strong Arm In 30 Days app has changed the physiques of thousands of people around the world. We have developed extremely effective training plans from the most experienced personal trainer. You're busy with your career, family, friends, and travel, making it tough to find time to hit the gym. Thankfully, you don’t need to go to the gym to achieve fabulously toned arms. Below are some of our favorite arm exercises that will help you tone your arm muscles and lose arm fat without weights, on your own time. Say goodbye to flabby arms!
Achieving toned arms comes as a result of exercising all the major muscle groups in your arms and shoulders. If you're ready to look picture-perfect in all your sleeveless tops, perform the following lifestyle and exercise changes and you'll have toned arms in no time. This app is integrated with HealthKit, so you can find your calories burned data in the Health App. You can turn on the "Apple Health" option to sync your calories burned to Apple Health.
Features:
- Sync your calories burned to Apple Health.
- Only 10 to 20 minutes are needed for each upper body workout, with an amazing 30-day training plan and your personal trainer.
- Arm workout exercises are grouped by muscle group with difficulty level (easy, medium, hard) and include videos showing how to do each exercise.
- Developed by a certified personal trainer, all workout exercises are designed using 3D modeling with HD resolution videos.
- Absolutely no gym equipment is required for your arm training. The arm workout exercises can be used anytime, anywhere, for both men and women.

bluejetty:00169426:ios.name: Super QR Code Reader
bluejetty:00169426:ios.summary: Super QR Code Reader is a QR code scanner and barcode reader that will allow you to read any code you find using your device's camera or by scanning an image. In addition, this application is also a free QR code generator and barcode genera
bluejetty:00169426:ios.description:
Super QR Code Reader is a QR code scanner and barcode reader that will allow you to read any code you find using your device's camera or by scanning an image. In addition, this application is also a free QR code generator and barcode generator, so you can create your own personalized QR codes and barcodes with the data you enter.
Features:
- Scan QR codes and barcodes with your device's camera
- Execute the correct action after scanning with the barcode reader: open websites, connect to WiFi networks...
- Read codes by scanning images of your device
- QR creator: create QR codes and barcodes
- Keep track of all codes read and created in the History section
- Customize the look and behavior of the app
> What steps do I have to follow to scan a code with the free QR scanner?
When you find a QR code or barcode and want to scan it to view its contents with the QR scanner, all you have to do is open the app and point your device's rear camera at the code. The reader feature will detect it and the details of it will automatically be shown to you. From there you can perform the appropriate action on the code depending on its type, for example opening a website or connecting to a WiFi network, as well as being able to view other details of the code.
> I have a code within an image, can this app scan it?
Yeah! This free barcode scanner app allows you to perform a scan of any image file you have saved on your device. To do this, go to the image scanning tab, press the scan button and a selector will open where you can choose the image to scan. The QR reader feature will try to detect QR codes or barcodes and show you the same information screen that would be shown if you had scanned the code with your device's camera.
> Is this app also a QR code creator?
Of course! Super QR Code Reader is not only a scanner app for reading and detecting QR codes, it also has a QR maker function. To use it as a QR code creator, go to the creation tab where you will see all the different types of QR codes that you can generate. Once the data is entered, the barcode generator function will create the code. Then, this code will be stored in your history section, where you can view it, execute your action, or share it.
> Will the codes I have read with the QR reader or created with the QR code creator be saved?
Of course. You can go to the History section at any time where you can review all the codes you have read with the barcode reader, either through your device's camera or by scanning an image file. In this same section you can also find the codes generated by you. In addition, you will have complete control over this section, you will not only be able to recover previous codes, but also delete them if you do not need them. Additionally, you can disable the save codes option in this section if you don't need it to save space.
In short, Super QR Code Reader is your all-terrain tool that will allow you to read any type of code, whether QR or barcode, to be able to see its details and be able to take the correct action on it. In addition, it will also help you create your own codes. Download now and get this utility for all your code scanning needs!

From there you can perform the appropriate action on the code depending on its type, for example opening a website or connecting to a WiFi network, as well as being able to view other details of the code.

> I have a code within an image, can this app scan it?

Yeah! This free barcode scanner app allows you to perform a scan of any image file you have saved on your device. To do this, go to the image scanning tab, press the scan button and a selector will open where you can choose the image to scan. The QR reader feature will try to detect QR codes or barcodes and show you the same information screen that would be shown if you had scanned the code with your device's camera.

> Is this app also a QR code creator?

Of course! Super QR Code Reader is not only a scanner app for reading and detecting QR codes, it also has a QR maker function. To use it as a QR code creator, go to the creation tab where you will see all the different types of QR codes that you can generate. Once the data is entered, the barcode generator function will create the code. Then, this code will be stored in your history section, where you can view it, execute your action, or share it.

> Will the codes I have read with the QR reader or created with the QR code creator be saved?

Of course. You can go to the History section at any time where you can review all the codes you have read with the barcode reader, either through your device's camera or by scanning an image file. In this same section you can also find the codes generated by you. In addition, you will have complete control over this section, you will not only be able to recover previous codes, but also delete them if you do not need them. Additionally, you can disable the save codes option in this section if you don't need it to save space.


In short, Super QR Code Reader is your all-terrain tool that will allow you to read any type of code, whether QR or barcode, to be able to see its details and be able to take the correct action on it. In addition, it will also help you create your own codes. Download now and get this utility for all your code scanning needs!

bluejetty:00022417:ios.name: Idle Distiller: Tycoon Games
bluejetty:00022417:ios.summary: Build your brewery empire in Idle Distiller Tycoon, an idle tycoon game where you brew beer, distill spirits and turn a small business into a growing factory empire. Hire managers, automate production and invest your in-game cash as you exp
bluejetty:00022417:ios.description:
Build your brewery empire in Idle Distiller Tycoon, an idle tycoon game where you brew beer, distill spirits and turn a small business into a growing factory empire. Hire managers, automate production and invest your in-game cash as you expand into breweries, distilleries and wineries.
Enjoy idle games and tycoon games? Take charge of a brewery where every upgrade helps your operation grow. Upgrade your factories, increase profits and build an idle tycoon empire that keeps earning between sessions. A corrupt mayor wants to shut your business down. Ready to give him a brewery he cannot ignore?
BUILD YOUR BREWERY TYCOON EMPIRE
Start by brewing your first beer, then grow beyond your original brewery. Unlock factories, develop your distillery and expand into wine production. Every business is another opportunity to invest your earnings and build a bigger empire.
Combine beer brewing with factory management as you build your drinks empire. Choose where to spend your in-game money, improve production lines and turn small profits into your next expansion. For fans of tycoon games, the goal is simple: build, upgrade and grow.
AUTOMATE YOUR IDLE FACTORY
Hire managers to automate your brewery and distillery businesses. Keep production moving without endless tapping and let your team handle the factory workflow. Your job as a tycoon is to decide what comes next.
Enjoy the progress of idle games with a hands-on management twist. Collect idle cash, upgrade your factories and put your profits back into the business. This idle factory simulator lets you focus on expansion while your managers keep things running.
UPGRADE YOUR BUSINESS AND EARN IDLE CASH
Make your next investment count in this idle tycoon simulator. Upgrade production lines to increase profits, unlock new factories and build your business empire one improvement at a time. Spend your in-game money on the upgrades that move your operation forward.
Your automated businesses keep earning between sessions. Return to collect idle cash and choose your next upgrade. Whether you enjoy idle clicker games for quick check-ins or tycoon games for growing an empire, your next investment is waiting.
TAKE ON THE MAYOR
A corrupt mayor is determined to close your business. Follow a humorous storyline as you grow your brewery empire and push back against his plans. Build your distillery, expand your factories and give him more than a small business to worry about.
Idle Distiller brings a story-driven adventure to idle tycoon games. You are not just watching numbers grow: you are building a business with a rival who wants to see it fail. Keep investing and prove you have what it takes to become a distillery tycoon.
EXPLORE EVENTS AND FACTORY CHALLENGES
Step into themed events alongside your main business. Take on factory challenges, work toward rewards and enjoy a change of setting. Collect bottle caps and earn achievements as you keep progressing.
Play your way with idle clicker gameplay and optional tapping boosts, or let automation handle production. From a quick upgrade to another event challenge, there is more to explore as your brewery grows.
BUILD, AUTOMATE AND BECOME A TYCOON
Turn your first beer into a thriving drinks empire. Idle Distiller combines the growth of idle games, the upgrades of tycoon games and the satisfaction of automating your own factories. Manage your factories, hire your managers and make every batch part of your next expansion.
From brewing beer to distilling spirits, you set the pace. Take charge of production, grow your profits and make your brewery thrive.
Start your idle tycoon adventure and build your brewery empire today!
Follow us on social media
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/idledistiller
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@idledistiller
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/idledistiller
Have issues or feedback? Contact us at idle.distiller.support@kanoapps.com
Playing Idle Distiller Tycoon requires an internet connection.

bluejetty:00179464:ios.name: Azan Times Pro
bluejetty:00179464:ios.summary: Azan Times Pro helps you follow accurate prayer times, adhan times, imsak time, and iftar time based on your location. Track the five daily prayers, use the qibla finder, receive adhan reminders, and manage your daily worship routine in one
bluejetty:00179464:ios.description:
Azan Times Pro helps you follow accurate prayer times, adhan times, imsak time, and iftar time based on your location. Track the five daily prayers, use the qibla finder, receive adhan reminders, and manage your daily worship routine in one simple app.
View Fajr, Sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, and Isha on a clear daily screen. Follow the next prayer, countdown, and remaining time instantly. You can receive reminders before prayer time and notifications when the time begins. During Ramadan, imsak time, iftar time, and sahur tracking become easier to follow.
Azan Times Pro is more than a prayer times app. It includes a qibla compass, nearby mosque search, Hijri calendar, karahat times, Quran reading, dhikr counter, qadha prayer tracking, and daily prayer tracking. Whether you search for prayer times, muslim prayer times, namaz vakitleri, qibla, or qibla finder, the app brings essential Islamic tools together in one place.
In the Quran section, you can browse surahs, search, continue where you left off, read daily verses, and listen to audio recitation. Download support makes it easier to access the surahs you need.
With the dhikr counter, you can track daily dhikr, create your own custom dhikr list, and personalize the counting experience. Daily prayer tracking helps you mark completed prayers, edit previous days, and build a more consistent worship routine. Qadha prayer tracking helps you keep missed prayers organized.
With Salawat Chain, you can join collective salawat goals, follow newly approved chains, contribute, and invite others by sharing a link. This makes the app not only useful for prayer times and adhan times, but also a more meaningful spiritual companion.
Widgets and Live Activities let you follow the next prayer, countdown, imsak time, and iftar time without opening the app. Premium features also offer an ad-free experience and extra convenience.
Key features:
• Accurate prayer times and adhan times worldwide
• Five daily prayers: Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha
• Imsak time, iftar time, and Ramadan tracking
• Next prayer countdown
• Adhan reminders and prayer time notifications
• Qibla finder and qibla compass
• Nearby mosque search
• Hijri and Gregorian calendar support
• Karahat times and notifications
• Quran reading, search, audio, and resume support
• Daily verses
• Dhikr counter and custom dhikr
• Daily prayer tracking and previous day editing
• Qadha prayer tracking
• Salawat Chain
• Widgets and Live Activities
• Ad-free premium experience
Premium features in Azan Times Pro are offered through a paid subscription available as an in-app purchase.
• Auto-renewing subscription options:
1 year (₺2,499.99), 1 month (₺79.99)
Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

Terms of Use: https://beytekin.net/project/ezanVakti/terms.html
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00170374:ios.summary: Unravel supernatural crimes across London, Paris, and Rio in this massive free hidden object adventure! Step into the role of a seasoned detective investigating mysterious disappearances in three iconic cities, each hiding its own magical s
bluejetty:00170374:ios.description:
Unravel supernatural crimes across London, Paris, and Rio in this massive free hidden object adventure! Step into the role of a seasoned detective investigating mysterious disappearances in three iconic cities, each hiding its own magical secrets.
In London, a vampire emissary pleads for your help: an elven alchemist who created a synthetic blood serum has vanished, pushing the vampire community to the brink of madness. Your investigation reveals a dark conspiracy that could ignite a war between magical races—unless you can stop it in time.
Meanwhile, in Paris, a wave of brutal killings targets the shapeshifting Animages. With the Ministry for the Control of Magical Races unable to contain the threat, you must uncover the truth behind the attacks and face a rogue werewolf bent on annihilating all Animages in his quest for vengeance.
In sunny Rio, a beloved siren has disappeared — and the ocean grows restless. If she doesn't return to calm the waves with her song, a deadly tsunami could strike. But darker forces are at work: someone has stolen her voice for their own twisted ends.
· ENJOY THE PLOT! 
Spend your time with pleasure playing as a magical detective! A fast-paced story full of crime and mystery won’t leave anyone indifferent. Can you uncover the truth and save the world?
· MYSTERIES AND SECRETS!
 Get ready for thrilling puzzles and challenging mini-games! Explore streets filled with dark secrets and hidden objects as you dive into the life of a city detective in a magical world. Your logic and sharp mind will be your best tools in this gripping investigation!
· COLLECT TREASURES!
 Put your skills to the test with intricate puzzles and seek-and-find challenges. Enjoy relaxing brain teasers and uncover a wide variety of collectible items to enrich your adventure!
· A VARIETY OF ACHIEVEMENTS!
 Delve into a world of mystery as you solve mind-bending puzzles and hunt for hidden objects. Can you balance the human and the beast within while cracking the case and unlocking all achievements?
Explore beautifully illustrated hidden object scenes, solve magical mysteries, and stop evil powers from unleashing chaos in this story-rich, free-to-play detective adventure!
-----

Find other games on our official website: https://dominigames.com/
Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames
Check out our Instagram and stay tuned: https://www.instagram.com/dominigames

bluejetty:00155804:ios.name: Momcozy
bluejetty:00155804:ios.developer: HONG KONG LUTE TECHNOLOGY CO., LIMITED
bluejetty:00155804:ios.summary: Momcozy is the all-in-one app built around your breastfeeding and parenting journey—organize your pumping routine, track your baby's growth, and control your connected Momcozy devices, all in a single place. Records, reminders, and smart AI
bluejetty:00155804:ios.description:
Momcozy is the all-in-one app built around your breastfeeding and parenting journey—organize your pumping routine, track your baby's growth, and control your connected Momcozy devices, all in a single place. Records, reminders, and smart AI support come together, so whatever you want to check, log, or manage is always right where you expect it. And we're with you through every stage—trying to conceive, pregnancy, and postpartum.
Smart AI Support, Tailored to Your Stage
- AI Lactation Plan: Get a personalized pumping schedule based on your pumping habits, synced to your reminders so you stay on track with every session.
- AI Sleep Prediction: As your baby settles into a routine, estimate their next nap window based on the sleep you've logged.(Available in North America)
- Daily Personalized Tips: Get AI-generated personalized insights, refreshed daily and matched to your current stage.
Note: Momcozy's AI features are for informational and planning purposes only and do not constitute medical advice. Always consult with a qualified medical professional.
Built for Everyday Parenting Moments
- One-Tap Quick Logging: Log pumping, feeding, sleep, diapers, and supplements in a single tap, even in your busiest moments.
- Your Day at a Glance: See your most-used records and upcoming reminders the moment you open the app.
- Knowledge at Your Fingertips: Get stage-based articles recommended for where you are, plus daily tips tailored to your stage—all just a tap away.
Everything Connected, All in One Screen
- Unified Device Control: Connect your Momcozy smart breast pumps, baby monitors, baby thermometers, sound machines, and more—adjust pumping, check on your baby, monitor temperature, and control lighting right from your phone, all from one dashboard with no app-switching.
- Device Status in Real Time: View battery levels, temperature readings, and connection status for all linked devices in one place, for peace of mind that everything's running smoothly.
All Your Records, Tracked Smarter
- Switch Stages Anytime: Move from trying to conceive to pregnancy to postpartum with a tap—your records and tips adjust to match.
- Timeline Tracking: Every entry is organized into one timeline for a clear day-by-day history—no relying on memory.
- Data Trends & Charts: Automatically generate trend charts and summaries to view your feeding and pumping patterns at a glance.
Flexible Management for Daily Reminders
- Custom Reminder Creation: Create your own alerts—from mom's hydration and prenatal checkups to baby's diaper changes and vaccination schedules.
- Timed Notifications: Get alerts at exactly the times you set, so nothing slips through.
Find Your Village, You're Not Alone
- Connect & Share: Swap real-life advice with moms who get it, and post your honest experiences—the beautiful and the hard.
- Support When You Need It: Find encouragement and support from parents who've been there—right when you need it most.
Questions or Feedback?
We value your feedback. If you run into any functional issues or have ideas for improvement, reach out anytime through:
- In-App: [Me → Help & Feedback]
- Email: support@momcozy.com
Thank you for supporting Momcozy!

bluejetty:00120033:ios.name: Der Die Das - German Grammar
bluejetty:00120033:ios.summary:
Humankind's last mystery resolved: the correct use of der, die, das articles in German grammar! A fun, hand-drawn app that makes you a pro in no time! Your favourite Der, Die, Das app - promised.
DIE APP (or das App - both are correct :))
bluejetty:00120033:ios.description:
Humankind's last mystery resolved: the correct use of der, die, das articles in German grammar! A fun, hand-drawn app that makes you a pro in no time! Your favourite Der, Die, Das app - promised.
DIE APP (or das App - both are correct :))
Learn 40 secret rules that even your German teacher doesn't know about. We created the 'Zoo of Rules' - where walking across the zoo, you will find hand-drawn images and rules. 
Tiger rule: Did you know that 70% of nouns ending in -er are masculine - meet the tiger rule! All colours are neuter and most fruits are feminine - and a lot more!
A FUN DER DIE DAS GAME - Deutsch lernen macht Spaß!
Play across beautiful hand-drawn scenery visiting the most iconic places across Germany, Austria and Switzerland:
- Brandenburg gate in Berlin
- The Baltic Sea (Ostee) in Germany
- The Belvedere Castle in Vienna
- Neuschwannstein Castle in Bavaria
- Swiss Alps (Matterhorn)
MY STORY
I am Norbert, and even as a half-German, I struggled with der, die, das. As my daughter was born and I started to talk in German with her, I wanted to make sure, she hears the right articles from early on.
Grammar books are not much help, and even if you find some rules, they are incomplete, dry and hard to remember so the idea of the best ever Der, Die, Das app was born."

bluejetty:00015242:ios.summary: 21 fun and educational games to help your child learn 4th Grade lessons! Teach Fourth Grade lessons like multiplication, division, grammar, geometry, vowels, science, STEM, spelling, fractions, reading, remainders, and more. Whether they ar
bluejetty:00015242:ios.description:
21 fun and educational games to help your child learn 4th Grade lessons! Teach Fourth Grade lessons like multiplication, division, grammar, geometry, vowels, science, STEM, spelling, fractions, reading, remainders, and more. Whether they are just starting fourth Grade, or need to review and master the subjects, this is a perfect learning tool for kids aged 8-11. Math, language, science, STEM, reading, and critical thinking skills are all tested and practiced in these games.
All lessons and activities are designed using real fourth grade curriculums, so you can be sure these games will help give your child a boost in the classroom. And with helpful voice narration and exciting games, your 4th grade student won't want to stop playing and learning! Improve your child's homework with these 4th grade teacher approved lessons, including science, STEM, language, and math.
These learning games include dozens of important lessons for fourth grade, including:
• Fractions - Compare, add, subtract, and multiply fractions
• Word Problems - Multi-step word problems using addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division
• Angles and Geometry - Use a protractor and learn about different types of angles
• Graphs and Grids - Read a variety of graphs and use coordinates to plot points
• Patterns - Fill in missing values, identify number growths, and time increments
• Remainders - Divide two numbers and then find the remainder
• Missing Vowels - Use missing vowels to complete words
• Timed Facts - Quickly answer fourth grade math facts to earn footballs to kick
• Spelling - Spell hundreds of different words
• Punctuation and Grammar - Fix sentences by dragging the correct punctuation
• Synonyms and Antonyms - Identify different words that mean the same or opposite
• Homophones - Learn about words that sound the same, but have different meanings
• Craft & Structure - Identify narration types, use context, and learn text structure
• Reading - Practice reading comprehension by reading an article and answering questions
• The Earth - Learn about the layers of the Earth, plate tectonics, and volcanoes
• Life Science - Label parts of plants and flowers, and discover animals life cycles
• Weather - Read weather forecasts, identify clouds, and learn about the weather and our climate
• Electricity - Complete circuits, light up bulbs, and understand electrons
• Magnets - Learn the basics of magnets, poles, and how they work
• Moon Phases - Understand the phases of the moon and how they can affect the Earth
• Forms of Energy - Identify different types of kinetic and potential energy
Perfect for 4th grade kids and students who need a fun and entertaining educational game to play. This bundle of games helps your child learn important math, grammar, geometry, multiplication, STEM, division, language, science, reading, and problem solving skills used in fourth grade all while having fun! 4th Grade teachers around the world use this app in their classroom to help reinforce math, language, and STEM subjects.
Ages: 8, 9, 10, and 11 year old children and students.

Thank you very much for using ANA.
Press your finger against the Home screen and the My Trips screen and then swipe downward to refresh your information. If you have reserved/changed a seat or changed a flight, please refresh the reservations information. 
【ANA App-Features】
■A Single App to Take You from Reservation to Boarding
With this one app, you can complete all the procedures up to boarding including flight ticket, tour and hotel reservations, flight status checks, and online check-in.
■Check the Latest Information on Your Flight and Check In
On the Home screen, you can check your reservation details and the status of your flight. 
Furthermore, this app offers a seamless experience up to boarding, enabling you to complete online check-in, issue your mobile boarding pass, and reserve or change your seats.
■Make the Most of Our In-Flight Internet Access and Entertainment Options
Connecting to our in-flight Wi-Fi not only allows you to surf the internet, but also gives you access to a fantastic range of in-flight Wi-Fi entertainment. 
With around 150 entertainment items to choose from, have your fill of television shows, audio programs, e-books and more.
■Use Apple Wallet to Transform Your App into a Boarding Pass
If you save your Boarding Pass to Wallet, you will be able to board your flight with the pass displayed via this app.
■Passenger Guide to support your smooth boarding
You'll get Assistance with your travel by "Passenger Guide" guiding timely according to the boarding scenes.
■Enjoy Reading Our In-Flight Magazine TSUBASA-GLOBAL WINGS-and Other Magazines and Newspapers
Regardless of whether you are flying with us, you can view TSUBASA -GLOBAL WINGS- at anytime, anywhere.
A greatly expanded lineup of other magazines and newspapers is also available to our passengers from before departure until after arrival.
■Manage your trip schedule from departure to arrival with the My Timeline feature
Find spots to your liking and add events to create your very own timeline. 
■Baggage Tracking (International)
You can track your checked baggage.
[ANA Apple Watch App – Main Features]
Link the ANA App with your Apple Watch for even greater convenience.
● Put your boarding pass on your Apple Watch to board your domestic or international flight effortlessly.
● Even if you do not have any reservations, you can check your mileage and ANA Sky Coin balance on your Apple Watch.

bluejetty:00016582:ios.summary: Love lottery games? You’ve gotta get Jackpocket, a quick, easy, and secure way to order official state lottery tickets for Powerball, Mega Millions, Pick 3 and more right from your phone. Join over 2 million winners who have used Jackpocket
bluejetty:00016582:ios.description:
Love lottery games? You’ve gotta get Jackpocket, a quick, easy, and secure way to order official state lottery tickets for Powerball, Mega Millions, Pick 3 and more right from your phone. Join over 2 million winners who have used Jackpocket to score more than $1 billion in lottery prizes to date!*
With the Jackpocket app you can:
• Order tickets for Mega Millions, Powerball, and more official lottery games in your state
• Receive alerts when you win and collect prizes right through the app^
• Dynasty Rewards Loyalty Program: Earn rewards and redeem for perks ranging from exclusive offers to promotions to once-in-a-lifetime experiences
• Check lottery results and track jackpots across the country
• Order tickets for up to 50 drawings in advance
• Order tickets ahead of time to never miss your favorite lotto games
• Order official state scratch games in AZ, CO, MA, MT, NE, OH, and OR. Scratch right in the app! Scratch tickets subject to availability and vary by state. 
PICK YOUR NUMBERS
Get a random Quick Pick or choose your own lucky numbers, then place your ticket order. The Jackpocket team then buys your lottery tickets for you from a licensed retailer in your state.
SEE YOUR TICKET
We send a scan of your lottery ticket right to the app. You’ll receive a confirmation email with the ticket serial number. We store your paper ticket in a fireproof safe.
WHAT HAPPENS IF YOU WIN^
Subject to the Jackpocket Terms of Use (http://jackpocket.com/tos), smaller lottery prizes (usually under $600) go straight to your Jackpocket account. Use your winnings to order more tickets or make a secure payout. For larger prizes, we transfer your paper ticket to you so you can claim your prize from the state lottery. (Pro tip: you can even claim most prizes without leaving the house by using your state’s “claim by mail” option.)
INVITE FRIENDS, EARN LOTTERY CREDITS
Refer friends to Jackpocket. Get Lottery Credits when they fund their account! Your friends get credits too. More details in the app or on blog.jackpocket.com.
RESPONSIBLE GAMING
Jackpocket is committed to creating a safe, secure and responsible lottery experience. If you or someone you know has a gambling problem and wants help call 1-800-GAMBLER, residents of NY call 877-8-HOPENY/text HOPENY (467369).
LOTTERY RULES
Must be 18+ and within state lines to order (21+ in AZ, 19+ in NE). Available in AZ, AR, CO, DC, ID, ME, MA, MN, MT, NE, NH, NJ, NY, OH, OR, PR, WV.
Jackpocket is a lottery courier and not affiliated with any State Lottery. Eligibility restrictions apply. Void where prohibited. Please visit jackpocket.com/tos for full terms and conditions.
*Based on the total dollar amount of lottery prizes won by Jackpocket customers as of 10/27/25
All promotions are subject to eligibility, deposit, and/or spend restrictions. Opt-in may be required. Awarded Lottery Credits are site credits that are single-use, have no cash value and are non-withdrawable, non-transferable, and non-refundable. Lottery Credits are only valid for ordering lottery tickets on Jackpocket.
^Winning tickets with prizes greater than the in-store redemption threshold require you to claim your prize directly from the state lottery. Jackpocket will arrange for you to receive your ticket, subject to your jurisdiction’s regulations, to facilitate the prize claim. See Section 8 of Jackpocket’s Terms of Service (http://jackpocket.com/tos) for Winning Tickets and Prize Claiming. JACKPOCKET IS NOT RESPONSIBLE OR LIABLE FOR THE PAYMENT OR NON-PAYMENT OF ANY WINNING TICKET WHERE THE PRIZE EXCEEDS THE IN-STORE REDEMPTION THRESHOLD. Actual prize amounts at time of drawing(s) may differ.

• Asthma

Privacy is extremely important to us, so JeffConnect ensures that your visit is secured and HIPPA compliant.
* This Service is not intended for emergencies. If you are experiencing an emergency, call 911 immediately.

bluejetty:00162661:ios.summary: Мобильное приложение «Семейный доктор - FDOCTOR.ru» – не просто доступ к медицинской карте пациента. Это настоящая «Поликлиника без регистратуры»! Установите мобильное приложение и пользуйтесь интеллектуальной записью на прием с удобным пои
bluejetty:00162661:ios.description:
Мобильное приложение «Семейный доктор - FDOCTOR.ru» – не просто доступ к медицинской карте пациента. Это настоящая «Поликлиника без регистратуры»! Установите мобильное приложение и пользуйтесь интеллектуальной записью на прием с удобным поиском врача и поликлиники, контролируйте прием лекарств и статистику полученных услуг, совершайте платежи прямо из приложения. Подключайте медицинские карты родных с помощью «Семейного доступа». Только все самое актуальное в карточках «Важное» и другие полезные сервисы. Мы меняем формат коммуникации, делая её более «умной», современной и доступной.
ЛЕГКО
Карточки «Важное» на главном экране – все самое актуальное для вас.
Быстрая персонализированная запись к врачу. Легкий выбор ближайшей поликлиники по геолокации с возможностью проложить маршрут прямо из приложения. Возможность срочной или нестандартной записи на прием. 
ФУНКЦИОНАЛЬНО
Электронная медицинская карта с назначениями врачей и историей посещений, моментальным отображением результатов анализов и информированием о готовности. Возможность отслеживать динамику показателей в наглядных графиках. Оплата услуг прямо из приложения через ApplePay, возможность привязки банковских карт. Подключение медицинских карт близких в «Семейном доступе».
УДОБНО
Теперь Вы не пропустите прием назначенного лечения: все назначения лекарств тут же автоматически попадают в приложение, а push-уведомление напомнит Вам о времени приема. Вы всегда сможете скорректировать время приема или проинформировать врача об отмене или завершении лечения. 
ВЫГОДНО
Целый месяц с момента установки в приложении действует скидка 10% при записи на прием к любому врачу. Доступна Программа привилегий для пациентов «Семейного доктора», c акционными предложениями, подарками и скидками.
НЕНАВЯЗЧИВО
Мы используем push-уведомления только для напоминания о приеме лекарств, записи к врачам, готовности анализов и направлений на исследования. В мобильном приложении нет никакой рекламы, все функции – исключительно нужные и полезные.
ИНТЕРЕСНО
Найдите своего врача, ориентируясь на историю посещений, рейтинги, описание. Также в приложении есть возможность оценить специалиста, которого Вы посетили.
ПРОЗРАЧНО
Контролируйте свои расходы, отслеживайте статистику полученных услуг, информацию о программе обслуживания (при покупке контракта), пополняйте 
баланс лицевого счета.
Здоровья Вам и Вашим близким!
