bluejetty:00137463:ios.name: Fight For Goodness
bluejetty:00137463:ios.summary: Welcome to "Fight For Goodness," a riveting strategy game of territorial defense where you combat hostile forces and liberate regions step by step. Experience a unique fusion of tactical strategies and dynamic combat scenarios, designed wit
bluejetty:00137463:ios.description:
Welcome to "Fight For Goodness," a riveting strategy game of territorial defense where you combat hostile forces and liberate regions step by step. Experience a unique fusion of tactical strategies and dynamic combat scenarios, designed with an abundance of gameplay variety that would make even the most seasoned tower defense strategy gamers excited. Get ready to fight for America as the invaders pose a global war with some serious ammo fever. Liberate one state after state io on the battlefield and enjoy angle fight 3d games!
Unleash the power of your army and use it to battle your way through enemy territories. Your duty is to seize control of the lands, free the prisoners from captivity, exploit mines for your economic advantage, and bolster your tower defense with varied towers including the Machine Gun Tower, Area Damage Mortar Tower, and the Slow-Down Radiation Tower. Begin from your humble state io of Arizona to mobilizing your brave soldiers and wage war, conquer, defend, and make tactical moves. You will require all kinds of tactics, bases, warfare, turrets, angles, and towers. If you don’t stop the invasion, global countries will enter into a global conflict that will see the end of the world with angle fight 3d games! 
Gather your allies in the fight for America to save soldiers against the attack of a shivering enemy army. The final war is set on a stage for one tower defense in this war of speed and gem warfare. Enjoy this fight for country game wherever you like thanks to the completely free and offline gameplay. Play without the internet, play freely! 
In "Fight For Goodness," every soldier matters. Your challenge will be met with diverse adversaries, each with their unique strengths and weaknesses. Don't let the enemy states dampen your spirit - fight with all your might and liberate each state by maximizing your primary assault and defensive structures. American commanders save the game in this amazing army deck battle and battle royale experience as players battle a war against a street war army in a war of liberation. The war city must be defended before it expands into a global war from your capital. Unleash an ammo fever upon the enemy forces as you witness a war that never ends. The war of centuries begins in this fight for America! 
Immerse yourself in the battlefield with your prisoner rescue missions - a unique feature of our game where you detonate prisons to free allies who then fight by your side. Diversify your battle approach with our wide range of enemy types, and bolster your defense strategies using our unique towers. Upgrade and prepare your army pack cards as you bring war to your enemies in this global war. American war has never seen so much ammo fever and ground attacks in the history of the final war games. 
At the crossroads of Arcade Idle, Tower Defence, and Top-Down Action genres, "Fight For Goodness" promises an unforgettable gaming experience, masterfully blending these elements into a single compelling narrative. Stand tall, soldier, the fight for goodness awaits!
FEATURES
● Amazing 3D visuals with lively animations
● Army mobilization and army upgrade systems
● Country conquest and defend mechanisms
● Realistic and engaging fight design
● State-by-state progression system and global conquest
● Thrilling sound effects that simulate tactical battles
● Can be played with one hand
● Can be played without the internet
● Completely offline and free gameplay
● No pay-to-win
● Constantly updated with new features
Commander, your courageous army awaits your orders. Shall we attack or defend? Time to mobilize your forces for goodness and fight for America!

bluejetty:00150730:ios.description:
Unlock QR payments in Vietnam, Thailand, China, the Philippines, Malaysia, Cambodia, Laos, South Korea, Mongolia, Brazil, Argentina, Peru, Colombia, Bolivia, Venezuela and South Africa with transparent fees.
Moreta lets international travelers, nomads, and expats pay local merchants across Asia, Latin America and Africa using QR codes, right from your phone, in your own currency.
No cash exchanges. No ATM runs. No hidden foreign transaction fees. Just fast, reliable payments wherever you go.
How it works:
1. Connect your USD bank account or top-up with European SEPA, UK Faster Payments, Canadian e-Transfer, Australian PayID or an international credit/debit card.
2. Top-up your wallet
3. Scan any supported QR code
4. Pay instantly
QR payments in these countries are quick, widely accepted, and cheaper than credit cards or handling cash. With Moreta, they’re accessible to everyone with zero hidden fees or surprises.
Your security comes first. We safeguard your data and funds with banking-grade infrastructure and trusted global partners.
Travel light. Pay smart. Across Asia, Latin America and Africa, only with Moreta.

bluejetty:00082859:ios.name: Ash of Gods: The Way
bluejetty:00082859:ios.summary: Build winning decks of warriors, equipment, and spells from four different factions in this story-driven tactical card combat game. Battle your way through a series of major tournaments, each with their own opponents, battlefields, and even
bluejetty:00082859:ios.description:
Build winning decks of warriors, equipment, and spells from four different factions in this story-driven tactical card combat game. Battle your way through a series of major tournaments, each with their own opponents, battlefields, and even rules. Earn new cards and upgrade your favorites, then combine them into any number of decks — you’re free to experiment as much as you like in constantly changing battles. Defend your commander, win duels, capture points, experiment with your strategy to defeat a superior enemy, and make decisions that affect your story.
BATTLES
Each battle in Ash of Gods: The Way is a carefully crafted test of your skills with different objectives and opponents. Whether you’re capturing checkpoints, defending your commander from a deadly enemy or fighting a series of one on one duels you’ll need all your wits about you to prevail. The outcome of every battle is significant!
Make sure to use every detail of the battlefield to your advantage. You’ll encounter traps which can be a danger or an opportunity depending on your strategy, and power runes which could change the course of a battle entirely!
STORY
You play as Finn, a young man whose only hope of preventing a neighboring nation from attacking his home is to master the card game they use to teach aristocrats the art of warfare: the Way. Infiltrate the tournaments they hold, and you can get close to their elite commanders.
The story is told through fully voice acted cutscenes and conversations and is non-linear, so you better choose your answers wisely as the consequences might be dire!

bluejetty:00091204:ios.summary:

Unique Gameplay, Brain - burning Challenges
Th
bluejetty:00091204:ios.description:
Pleasant Surprises
In the fast - paced life, do you long for a casual game that can both relax you and offer challenges? Today, I'm going to introduce you to a unique casual puzzle masterpiece.
Unique Gameplay, Brain - burning Challenges
The core gameplay of the game is highly creative. Players are faced with complex traffic jam scenarios, and the key to solving them lies in the arrows on the cars. Each car has its specific moving - direction indication. Players need to skillfully plan the moving order of the cars according to these arrow tips, allowing all vehicles to pass smoothly and successfully clear the traffic jam. This not only tests players' observation skills but also challenges their logical thinking and strategic planning abilities. Each level is a brand - new brainstorming session.
Fun Features, Endless Entertainment
The game features a wide variety of level designs, ranging from simple one - way roads to complex multi - junction intersections, with the difficulty increasing gradually, making it more and more addictive. Moreover, players can get rewards every time they complete a challenge. This instant sense of achievement constantly motivates players to continue exploring.

bluejetty:00039330:ios.description:
Less admin. More soccer.
Stop chasing who is coming. Mingle Sport runs your soccer team — availability, schedule, lineups and match day — in one place, so the group chat can go back to being a group chat.
Trusted by 15,000+ teams and 300,000+ players, parents and coaches from all over the world.
WHY MINGLE SPORT?
- Coaches plan matches and training, and know who's available before picking the team
- Team Managers track attendance and reach the whole roster in Team Chat without chasing anyone
- Players get their own stats, minutes played and match content
- Parents reply for their children and stay in control of their profiles
- Club admins reach every team from one place
- Fans and family follow the match live from home
All the essentials are free, with no ads. Team Boost levels your team up: Elevate adds minutes played, substitutions and cards, the match timer, advanced lineups, attendance stats, multiple admins and a team media library. Performance adds player development tools — coach notes and player docs.
WHAT CAN YOU DO WITH MINGLE SPORT
MATCH DAY, PROPERLY
- Live scorekeeping: goals, assists, substitutions, cards and minutes played
- Real-time match feed and share-ready final-score cards
- MVP voting after every game
- Photos and videos tied to the match, not lost in a camera roll
CREATE & SHARE LINEUPS
- Drag-and-drop any formation, any roster size
- Post lineups to Instagram, WhatsApp, X and more in one tap
SCHEDULE, AVAILABILITY & ATTENDANCE
- Schedule, training, locations and transport notes
- Players confirm availability or cancel, and parents reply for kids without phones
- Instant attendance lists for coaches before you pick the team
- Automatic reminders keep everyone on time
TEAM CHAT
- Team Chat and direct messages
- Share polls and upload documents
STATS, LEADERBOARDS & AWARDS
- Win ratio, goal difference, shot-quality AI and more
- Leaderboards for goals, assists, attendance and Player of the Match
- Monthly team awards and individual dashboards
FOR YOUR CLUB — CLUB MANAGER
- Free for clubs — get in touch at mingle.sport/club
- Announcements: send one message to several team chats at once, with scheduling, pinning and delivery tracking
- Club Contacts: message people across teams without joining every chat
- Club admins decide who administers what
SAFE & SECURE
- Private, invite-only soccer teams
- Parents control child profiles and RSVPs
- Youth players' visibility is team-scoped by default
Download Mingle Sport and get your season organized.

Get access to a premium AI
bluejetty:00019532:ios.description:
Welcome to VSCO — your complete photography platform solution for unmatched photo filters, AI photo editing, video editing, portfolio sites, client workflows, and community. VSCO is where photographers turn pro.
Get access to a premium AI photo editor that provides precision and quality. From editing with our photo presets that match your style to delivering stunning client photo galleries, the VSCO photo and video editing app is a seamless way to run your photography business in one place. Download the VSCO app today.
VSCO APP FEATURES:
200+ PHOTO PRESETS AND FILTERS
- Use professional-grade photo filters and editing tools such as Crop and Fade to effortlessly showcase your style.
- Try photo filters that reflect vintage film looks inspired by Kodak, Fuji, Agfa, and others with Film X presets.
- Save and recreate your favorite photo filters and edits with Recipes and join VSCO Membership to access VSCO’s complete library of 200+ photo presets. 
EDIT 100 PHOTOS AT ONCE
- Create the perfect edit and paste it on up to 100 photos. 
- Easily apply photo presets, film effects, and adjustments like exposure, contrast, and white balance to keep your aesthetic consistent. 
- See every change happen in real time, then export when you're done.
ADVANCED PHOTO EDITOR WITH AI LAB
- Experience intelligent AI photo editing designed to enhance without overpowering. 
- Use advanced photo editing tools: HSL, Dodge & Burn, Split Tone, and Grain. 
- Remove distractions, upscale, repair, and refine photos with AI prompts. Included with VSCO Pro membership with unlimited edits.
VIDEO EDITING WITHOUT COMPROMISE
- Featuring trim, crop, speed control, slo-mo, and color grading all in one place.
- Use the same premium VSCO photo presets and advanced photo editor tools for video.
- Easily create short video GIFs with VSCO.
REFINE MOMENTS WITH COLLAGE MAKER
- Make photo and video editing collages in seconds. 
- Create new compositions with photos, text, and customizable shapes using pre-set collage templates or start with a blank canvas. 
- Montage video editing. Easily edit and combine video scenes.
VSCO SPACES
- Spaces are collaborative environments that provide a safe space for creators to workshop ideas, share inspiration, and connect. 
- Create and join community galleries to build relationships to move your work forward.
PROFESSIONAL PROFILE
- Create a professional profile that showcases your unique skills. 
- Post photos and videos, organize your work into Albums, and tell stories with Blogs.
- Add your experience and let others know that you're open to collaborating and professional work.
INSPIRED BY COMMUNITY
- Join a community that opens the door to your creativity. 
- Start discussions on posts, repost inspiring photos, and make direct connections with messaging. 
- Curate a feed that captures your unique interests and showcases photographers you follow from around the world.
Explore even more features on desktop at http://vsco.co 
MEMBERSHIP TRIAL AND SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
Start your VSCO membership with a free 7-day trial. Once the trial is over, you’ll be charged an annual subscription fee. Your VSCO membership will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can go to your Settings > iTunes Account & App Store > Apple ID > Subscriptions to manage your membership and turn auto-renew off. Your iTunes Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed.
Read more about our terms and conditions here —
http://vsco.co/about/terms_of_use 
Read more about our privacy policy here —
http://vsco.co/about/privacy_policy

bluejetty:00127620:ios.description:
••• Edity - Professional and easy-to-use audio editor and recorder. You can work with files from the library or with the recorded audio •••
◆ Just edit 
Want to make a smooth entry or fading effect? Crop music or sound from videos? Copy or paste?
All the necessary tools for editing at your fingertips!
◆ Apply audio effects
How about adding something unusual, changing the key or place the sound in a large room, correcting voice tune?
Use creative audio effects: Pitch and Speed control, Delay, Reverb, EQ, Distortion.
◆ Record sound
Want to record voice or sounds?
The recording feature easily solves this problem!
◆ Popular audio formats for export
Various audio formats for saving your files: Flac, Wav, Mp3, M4a, M4r, Aiff. Also in Mp3 format you can choose additional bitrate settings.
◆ Speed up or slow down your audio
To do this, click on the FX button, choose Pitch icon and change the time stretching. 
◆ Increase the volume of your audio file
Just click on the FX button and select the Volume option
◆ Enjoy high quality sound
Tired of audio editors and dictaphones with low-quality sound and clipping audio signal?
Save audio files in Wav format without losing quality!
◆ Edit audio tracks from your video
Open your media library and choose video for editing to extract audio track.
◆ Add tags to your audio
Use these feature for lectures, interviews, audio notes - mark all the necessary places on your audio track.
◆ Share
Want to share your audio file with friends and the world?
Send it to anyone using share feature.
•••A clear, simple and user-friendly interface and animations will make the app more comfortable for you!•••

bluejetty:00092987:ios.description:
The Security Federal App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact Security Federal customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the Security Federal App, you must be enrolled as a Security Federal Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

* Video Alarm – Wake Up to Your Favorite Videos * 
Are you tired of the same old alarm sounds every morning? Whether you prefer waking up to your favorite music video, a funny clip, or a calming nature scene, this app makes getting out of bed something to look forward to.
With Video Alarm, you’re not just setting an alarm—you’re creating a personalized morning experience that helps you start the day on a positive note.
* Wake Up Your Way – Choose Videos from Multiple Sources *
Video Alarm gives you complete control over how you wake up. Gone are the days of generic ringtones and annoying beeps. Now, you can select any video that inspires, motivates, or entertains you to start your morning with a smile.
- Set alarms using any video from YouTube, TikTok, or your personal video library.
- Create a playlist of your favorite wake-up videos for variety each morning.
- Save your alarms for quick and easy reuse.
- Imagine waking up to a funny TikTok clip that makes you laugh or a soothing nature video that gently eases you into the day. With - - Video Alarm, the choice is yours.
* Track Your Sleep and Improve Your Routine *
Video Alarm does more than just wake you up. It also tracks your sleep patterns and helps you optimize your wake-up routine. The app keeps nightly statistics so you can monitor your sleep times and improve your schedule over time.
- View detailed stats on your nightly sleep habits.
- Reuse your favorite alarms with a single tap.
- Customize alarms based on your routine and preferences.
- Whether you’re someone who hits snooze too often or you need a more engaging way to wake up, Video Alarm helps you build healthier habits that stick.
* Never Miss an Alarm – Even Without Internet *
Worried about internet issues disrupting your wake-up routine? Video Alarm has you covered with reliable backup methods to ensure you never miss an alarm, even if your connection goes down.
- Choose local videos from your device that don’t require internet access.
- Use backup sound alarms for extra security.
- Set multiple alarms to stay on schedule, no matter what.
- With Video Alarm, you can trust that you’ll always wake up on time—no excuses!
* Nighttime Clock Display for Easy Time Checks *
Video Alarm also features a customizable night mode, allowing you to check the time at a glance without harsh lighting that disrupts your sleep.
- Use the built-in night clock to track how much time is left until your alarm rings.
- Adjust the brightness and style of the clock to suit your preferences.
- Keep your phone on your bedside table and know the time with a simple glance.
- This feature makes it easy to track your rest and avoid late-night anxiety about how much sleep you’re getting.
* Why Choose Video Alarm? *
Video Alarm is more than just an alarm clock app. It’s a tool that brings joy, energy, and personality to your mornings. Instead of waking up annoyed or groggy, you’ll rise to something that makes you smile, laugh, or feel inspired.
Here’s why users love Video Alarm:
- It’s fully customizable—wake up to videos that match your mood.
- It’s easy to use—set, save, and reuse alarms with a few taps.
- It’s reliable—backup alarms ensure you never miss a wake-up time.
- Get Video Alarm Now – Make Mornings Enjoyable
Transform your wake-up routine today with Video Alarm. Say goodbye to boring alarms and start waking up to something that makes you excited to get out of bed. Whether it’s your favorite YouTube clip, a motivational TikTok video, or a relaxing scene from your personal library, Video Alarm is the most entertaining way to start your day.

bluejetty:00118761:ios.description:
Life is precious and so is your time. And keeping that in mind, ATracker is here to help you achieve more of your goals, build a sustainable habit, and boost your productivity to a new height.
ATracker is a simple yet very powerful time tracking app and productivity tool that allows you to use it with minimal setup. Having a track of your precious time has never been easier with our one-tap to start/stop time tracking. As the leading time tracking app, ATracker also offers bar or pie charts showcasing where your time went.
Lots of features for self-development 
The fully customizable user interface allows you to turn this habit tracker into your own. The tracking app also comes with the option of categorizing tasks with tags; data export; sync data between multiple devices for the shortest path towards self-improvement and the perfect boost of productivity.
It's a fresh way to organize your day and make the most out of it … with just a few taps.
SCOPE
ATracker is a clean and minimalistic approach to,
• Track time of different tasks and projects at work
• Track time of School studies and projects
• Track time of Exercises
• Track time of Socializing
• Track time of Homemaking tasks
• Track time of Baby or child daily activities
• Hobby projects
• Or any activity people want to track and control
We believe that time tracking should be effortless. 
Here are some of the key features ATracker offers
• Start and stop tracking a task with just one tap.
• Overview of today's time spending on the Today tab.
• Interactive goal system for self-improvement.
• Complete activity log. Show activities on any given date. Add missed or modify existing activity.
• Customization of activities with hundreds of unique icons to choose from. You can also color code the activities for a personalized time tracking experience. 
• Ability to keep notes for each task entry.
• Statistics showed in bar charts and pie charts.
• Group tasks by tags and allow users to filter tasks by tag on the Today tab, as well as aggregate the data by tag in reporting.
• The activity timer does not stop even when the application is not running, or your mobile is in sleep mode.
• Set alarm for activities. The alarm will sound even when the app is not running.
• Widget to see your data on-screen at all times.
• Gesture support
• Full customization of UI with more skins and allow the user to use their own image as background.
PRO FEATURES 
With an only one-time investment, you will get to enjoy,
- No Ads.
- Unlimited tasks
- Data export with PDF and CSV file.
- Able to keep notes for each task entry. 
- Full customization of UI with more skins and allow user to use own image as background.
WEB SUBSCRIPTION
With web subscription, ATracker supports sync across multiple devices. It also provides web access to ATracker services besides the app. This add-on is optional.
• ATracker subscriptions purchased in-app renew monthly or yearly depending on your plan. Plan pricing may vary by country.
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
SUPPORT
Visit https://support.wonderapps.se or contact us at support@wonderapps.se
Terms of Service: https://atracker.pro/atracker_TOS.html
Privacy Policy: https://atracker.pro/atracker_policy.html

Having trouble sleeping? It’s time to say goodbye to sleepless nights and stop missing out on sweet dreams! Sleep will be your favorite lullaby and will help you fall asleep thanks to soothing stories, meditations, white noise, tons of sounds from different environments and much more. 
You are not the only one to face issues at night. It is not uncommon to find it hard to fall asleep or to wake up various times during the night: Sleep feels you and we're here to help! Learn how to manage stress and anxiety so they don’t ruin your doze anymore, and bring peacefulness into your life. This app provides you with many features that answer to your own needs, from the fight against insomnia to making the morning wake up easier, from improving sleep quality to the management of tinnitus.
*FEATURES*
- Bedtime stories: listen to narrated bedtime stories designed to lull you to sleep that will help you turn off your mind. Let these peaceful, soft narrations calm your nerves. We found out the best narrators for you: choose among 10 soothing voices the ones you prefer.
- Sleep meditations: improve your mindfulness and relieve stress and anxiety in just a few minutes a day. Disconnect your mind, take deep breaths and dive into slumberland.
- Sleep sounds: discover a broad library of carefully selected sounds, choose your favorite mix or create your own combination. Fireplace, cat purring, hairdryer, gong, thunder, airplane, urban rain: more than 80 sounds are waiting for you.
- Fade out timer: decide the time you want sounds gently dissolve to avoid disturbing your blissful dream. This way you can relax without thinking about switching off your phone.
- Bedtime reminder: having a consistent bedtime is key to better sleep, so set up a reminder to go to bed and be sure to awake refreshed.
Go on a dreamy adventure into “The Valley of a Hundred Waterfalls” or lose yourself in the “City of many canals". Establish a relaxing bedtime schedule to get your mind and body ready for slumber with Sleep!

bluejetty:00170357:ios.name: Strange Horticulture
bluejetty:00170357:ios.summary: Strange Horticulture is an occult puzzle game in which you play as the proprietor of a local plant store. Find and identify new plants, pet your cat, speak to a coven, or join a cult. Use your collection of powerful plants to influence the
bluejetty:00170357:ios.description:
Strange Horticulture is an occult puzzle game in which you play as the proprietor of a local plant store. Find and identify new plants, pet your cat, speak to a coven, or join a cult. Use your collection of powerful plants to influence the story and unravel Undermere’s dark mysteries.
WELCOME TO UNDERMERE
Welcome to Undermere, a quaint town surrounded by hag-infested forests and rugged mountains. You are the Horticulturist, owner of local plant store Strange Horticulture. As a cast of colorful customers come by your shop, you are quickly thrust into an occult mystery stretching back hundreds of years.
EXPLORE THE LANDS BEYOND
Explore the lands beyond your store to find new plants, but be careful! The dark woods and lakes are not always friendly to a simple herbalist. You might discover powers beyond your wildest dreams - or lose your mind completely. Use context clues to determine which places to visit, and which to avoid!
AN EVER-GROWING COLLECTION
Using your trusty encyclopedia and clues found on your explorations, you learn more about the strange plants you come across. By identifying each plant, you will be able to use their effects to influence the story -- from hypnotic hallucinogens to powerful poisons.

KEY FEATURES:
• Brand New Look & Feel with several Dashboard Choices an
bluejetty:00065371:ios.description:
With the Mixx Tanzania App you can now access your Mixx by Yas wallet conveniently and securely perform all your transactions much faster and easier than ever before. 
KEY FEATURES:
• Brand New Look & Feel with several Dashboard Choices and Themes
• Linking Multiple accounts - user can link up 5 accounts belonging to them and can switch between the accounts.
• Send Money - user can select up to 5 accounts to send money to from any network with same amount or different amount per recipient.
• Mini Apps - users can access several apps within Mixx Tanzania without the need of downloading more apps to save on space and give wide range of usage.
• Gift-Money - a unique feature where users of Mixx Tanzania App can send money to other Mixx Tanzania app users with a Card dedication for various themes like Valentines, Anniversary, Ramadan, Christmas etc
• Agents & Shops - users can see locations for service within their close range.
• Postpaid Bundles - users can buy Yas packages for Postpaid users for self or other postpaid customers.
• Corporate Solutions - for Companies to process Expenses and Retire by their teams, Salary advances and many more.
• TIPS (TANQR): Pay and get paid through TIPS (TANQR) by scanning with Mixx Tanzania App to pay and get paid from all MNOs and Banks in Tanzania and other EMV capable apps.
Data Privacy and Security: HTMSL (trading as Mixx by Yas, formely Tigo Pesa Tanzania) is a certified data processor and controller, registered by The Personal Data Protection Commission of Tanzania and certified by global standards of GSMA Mobile Money certification.
Support: For any questions or assistance, contact Mixx by Yas Tanzania support through customercare@yas.co.tz or calling 100.
Office Address: 29th Floor, PSSSF Commercial Complex, Sam Nujoma Road, Dar es Salaam, Tanzania.

bluejetty:00168724:ios.name: Criminal Archives 3: Pages F2P
bluejetty:00168724:ios.summary:
EMBARK ON A GRIPPING JOURNEY into the heart of mystery detective games with "Criminal Archives," where dark secrets and intriguing puzzles await at every corner!
A PERFECT BLEND OF CRIME INVESTIGATION games elements and hidden object games
bluejetty:00168724:ios.description:
EMBARK ON A GRIPPING JOURNEY into the heart of mystery detective games with "Criminal Archives," where dark secrets and intriguing puzzles await at every corner!
A PERFECT BLEND OF CRIME INVESTIGATION games elements and hidden object games challenges, "Criminal Archives" offers an unparalleled adventure that's both engaging and accessible to all.
DISCOVER the sinister meaning behind the owl symbol and unravel the secrets of San Francisco's underground societies! Explore crime scenes, find hidden objects, and piece together puzzles to stop the killer before they strike again!
You are a crime reporter, striving to capture in your book the most unusual cases you have encountered. You help the San Francisco police solve murders and catch criminals to make life in the city a little better. If people doubted it, now, they just have to look no further than your articles - monsters do exist, and they are among us! Meanwhile, Secret societies are not slumbering, and the owl-masked killer continues to lead the police by the nose! A prominent writer Damian Crow comes to you for help since all the mayhem seems to have slipped through to the city streets right from the pages of his crime novels. Can you solve all the murders and stop the villains? Or maybe the master of the pen himself masterminded this bloody nightmare? It all falls to you to find out the truth! Don't let this city swallow another innocent soul!
Special features:
DIALOGUE OPTIONS that shape the outcome of the story. Your choices matter!
A MULTITUDE OF ACHIEVEMENTS, showcasing your detective prowess!
OVER 100 TRICKY PUZZLES and brain teasers scattered throughout the game!
MOST BIZARRE MURDERS San Francisco has ever seen: use your keen eye to find hidden objects and collect evidence!
INTRICATE LOCATIONS and crime scenes that you must meticulously search for clues!
AN UNFORGETTABLE chilling atmosphere!
F2P ADVENTURE LIKE NO OTHER: "Criminal Archives" is accessible to all as a free-to-play adventure, offering hours of content without the need for in-game purchases!
JOIN THE RANKS OF HEROES and craft your own story of justice and intrigue. Don't let another innocent soul fall victim to the city's dark secrets!
-----
Questions? Email us at support@dominigames.com
Find other games on our official website: https://dominigames.com/
Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames
Check out our Instagram and stay tuned: https://www.instagram.com/dominigames

bluejetty:00120713:ios.name: Visual Attention Therapy Lite
bluejetty:00120713:ios.summary: Visual Attention Therapy helps brain injury and stroke survivors, as well as struggling students, to improve scanning abilities. It also helps rehab professionals to assess for neglect and provide more efficient and effective therapy for at
bluejetty:00120713:ios.description:
Visual Attention Therapy helps brain injury and stroke survivors, as well as struggling students, to improve scanning abilities. It also helps rehab professionals to assess for neglect and provide more efficient and effective therapy for attention deficits.
Visual Attention Therapy Lite gives you a free taste of the customization and utility of the full app: Visual Attention Therapy. This lite version lets you try Test and Practice modes with one level and layout, but is otherwise a fully functional app, allowing you to try 1 or 2 targets, all the signal and target colors and styles, and send e-mail reports.
Practicing scanning from left to right across a page helps retrain the brain to move the eyes correctly. Strengthening this essential skill can improve reading, concentration, memory, attention to detail, and speed of processing. Using two targets at once can help users with working memory and alternating attention. 
1) Use the Test mode to help determine if a scanning or attention deficit exists.
2) Use the Practice mode to train scanning to find targets in order.
_______________________
CANCELLATION TASKS JUST GOT BETTER
This professional cognitive training app takes traditional cancellation exercises, the evidence-based standard for testing and treating visuospatial neglect, and enhances them with benefits that are only available through technology:
* Targets must be tapped from left to right, top to bottom in Practice mode, training users to slow down and scan the entire screen before they can move forward.
* Sidebar signal can flash in a variety of colors to draw attention to the left or right.
* Auditory and a variety of visual cues give instant feedback and keep users engaged.
* Timed exercises increase motivation to work quickly and accurately.
* No need to spend time counting errors. Automated scoring includes data for accuracy by quadrant, time for completion, and mistakes in professional e-mailed reports.
* Adjustable layouts and 10 levels of difficulty allow you to customize the experience to meet changing needs or multiple users.
* An endless variety of combinations eliminates the need to photocopy exercises and saves paper.
Visual Attention Therapy was developed by a certified Speech-Language Pathologist and is used worldwide by SLPs, occupational therapists, vision specialists, and neuropsychologists to help adults and children with dyslexia, dementia, and attentional deficits. 
People of all ages enjoy racing against the clock to challenge themselves to improve on their scores while improving their cognitive and reading skills. Levels featuring letters can support literacy goals, while symbol-based levels challenge visual memory skills.
_______________________
WHAT PEOPLE ARE SAYING
“This app takes a simple, familiar format and turns it into a dynamic, interactive tool with the ability to be age appropriate for anyone from preschoolers to elderly adults.” —SLP
“Visual Attention Therapy is guaranteed to be one of those beautiful apps that, when you see it and try it out, will make you exclaim 'Finally!' We were this close to hugging it, to be honest. Thanks for yet another amazing release, Tactus Therapy.” —SLP
“I was not sure if children would be motivated to use this app, but the 'no nonsense' approach really seemed to help the children with their attention & task persistence. They especially enjoyed the immediate feedback they got regarding their speed & accuracy. I recommend this app for school-aged children having difficulty with visual scanning/tracking, reading, working memory, & copying skills.”—OT
_______________________
This app contains no outside ads or in-app purchases, does not collect or transmit personal data, and links can be deactivated. Supporting evidence for the design of this app can be found at www.tactustherapy.com.

bluejetty:00010724:ios:1.description:
ROBLOX – MILLIONS OF GAMES ACROSS EVERY GENRE. PLAY FREE.
Roblox is home to every kind of game, for every kind of player. Compete in high-octane racing games, battle it out in hardcore tactical shooters, or put your survival skills to the test in unpredictable environments. Embark on an epic adventure in immersive RPGs, build massive empires in tycoons, or dive into horror, anime, and sports games with friends worldwide.
Roblox is constantly evolving, with unique experiences and ambitious, high-fidelity games built by a global community including professional studios, indie teams, and solo creators. There’s always something new to discover every day.
Start playing some of the most popular games on Roblox today, including Dress to Impress, RIVALS, Steal a Brainrot, Brookhaven RP, Adopt Me! and more.
WHAT YOU CAN DO ON ROBLOX
PLAY ONLINE MULTIPLAYER GAMES
- Discover deep role-playing games, immersive simulators, action-packed adventures, and more
- Explore trending experiences and new games daily
- Compete in massive multiplayer battles, run your own digital business, or embark on epic quests
- Games may contain optional in-game purchases, including lootboxes and other items
CREATE YOUR OWN AVATAR
- Customize your avatar with detailed clothing, accessories, and dynamic hairstyles
- Discover thousands of user-created 3D avatar items in the Marketplace
- Express yourself with unique emotes, and fashion
CHAT, COMPETE, AND EXPLORE TOGETHER—ANYTIME, ANYWHERE
- Hang out and play with friends in cross-platform multiplayer games on mobile, tablet, PC, console, and VR headsets
- Join a Party and jump into competitive or social experiences together
- Age-verified users can communicate in real-time via voice chat or text
CREATE, PLAY, AND SHARE ON ROBLOX
- Design high-fidelity games and virtual spaces using the Roblox Studio engine on Windows or Mac
- Publish your experiences and empower yourself as a creator in a massive global community
- Dive into immersive 3D multiplayer games and safe, inclusive environments designed for users of all ages
- Enjoy endless new content added daily and share your creations with millions of players
ELEVATE YOUR EXPERIENCE WITH ROBLOX PLUS
- Get up to 20% discounts on in-game items, enjoy fee-free Robux transfers, and receive a distinct profile badge
- Host free, unlimited private servers for your friends 
- Publish, trade, and resell your own custom avatar creations on the Marketplace
INDUSTRY-LEADING SAFETY, PRIVACY, AND CIVILITY
- Advanced content filtering and age-appropriate moderation
- Access age-verified spaces and manage your privacy with Roblox Kids and Select Accounts
- Clear community guidelines promoting respectful interactions
- Dedicated trust & safety teams working around the clock
CREATE YOUR OWN GAMES: https://www.roblox.com/develop
SUPPORT: https://en.help.roblox.com/hc/en-us
CONTACT: https://corp.roblox.com/contact/
PRIVACY POLICY: https://www.roblox.com/info/privacy
PARENT’S GUIDE: https://corp.roblox.com/parents/
TERMS OF USE: https://en.help.roblox.com/hc/en-us/articles/115004647846
PLEASE NOTE: A network connection is required. Roblox works best over Wi-Fi.
※ Information on App Permissions: Roblox requires the following permissions for your seamless use of the Roblox app.
[Optional Permissions]
Notification: For sending notifications (related to the services, experiences, etc.)
Microphone: For in-game voice chat features
Camera: For animating your avatar with your movement
Contacts: For contact importer features (find other users you may know and make recommendations for friends)
* You can use the app regardless of whether or not you consent to optional permissions
* Certain app features may not work properly if you refuse optional permissions

bluejetty:00188150:ios.description:
“It’s really great!”
—Kenneth Branagh, actor and director
“I can't remember a time it wasn't on my iPhone. So feature rich!"
—Stephen Fry, actor and writer
“‘The app’s the thing.’ Hamlet was almost right. Great to see Shakespeare Pro superplaying with Shakespeare’s plays.”
—David Crystal, linguist and author of Shakespeare's Words
“The Shakespeare Pro app is simply terrific and filled with loads of wonderful information!”
—Ken Ludwig, Tony and Olivier Award Winning Playwright
Shakespeare Pro® includes the complete works of Shakespeare (41 plays, 154 sonnets and 6 poems, including apocrypha) and search the concordance to find the exact word or phrase you’re looking for (with “relaxed” searching to find words close to your search term).
Shakespeare Pro is packed with these impressive features:

bluejetty:00171119:ios.description:
Introducing Fittest Core: Feel Confident in Your Motherhood Fitness Journey
Embark on a transformative fitness journey tailored for women at every stage of motherhood with Fittest Core. A comprehensive app, curated by Macy, a seasoned mother of two and a certified pre/postnatal trainer with over a decade of experience, is designed to guide you safely and confidently through the unique challenges of pregnancy, labor, and postpartum recovery.
What You’ll Get with Fittest Core:
Tailored Workouts for Every Stage: From carefully crafted workouts for all trimesters to specialized exercises targeting pelvic floor strength and relaxation, birth preparation, and early postpartum core rehab, Fittest Core ensures a realistic approach to your fitness during motherhood.
Diverse Postpartum Programs: Heal diastasis recti, recover from delivery (both vaginal and cesarean!), and reconnect with your body through postpartum workouts designed to rebuild strength progressively. Macy’s app simplifies the training process, allowing you to focus on your well-being without the added stress.
Progressive Overload Programs: Learn how to build muscle with structured progressive overload programs that empower you to achieve your strength and fitness goals after pregnancy.
Dynamic Content Updates: Stay motivated and engaged with new workouts added to the gallery weekly. Fittest Core evolves with you, providing fresh challenges and routines to keep your fitness journey exciting and effective!
Empowering Community: Connect with a supportive community of like-minded women who share not only your fitness journey, but are going through the peaks and valleys of motherhood, as well. Exchange experiences, seek advice, and celebrate victories together on the path to empowerment.
Monthly Challenges: Stay motivated with exciting monthly challenges that inspire you to push boundaries and achieve new milestones in your fitness journey.
Macy's Passion, Your Empowerment:
Macy, a dedicated mother herself, understands the overwhelming nature of fitness during pregnancy and postpartum. Fittest Core is her brainchild, created to alleviate the stress and uncertainty that often accompanies motherhood fitness. Macy's expertise shines through, having guided thousands of women to feel confident, strong, and empowered in their motherhood journey.
Subscription Options: Access the full spectrum of Fittest Core's features by subscribing on a monthly or annual basis. Take control of your fitness journey with a user-friendly app designed to empower women through the incredible phases of motherhood.
Fittest Core is more than an app; it's your trusted companion in the pursuit of a healthier, stronger, and more empowered you. Download now to embark on a fitness journey tailored for every stage of motherhood.
▷ Already a Member? Sign-In to access your subscription.
▷ New? Try it for free! Subscribe in the app to get instant access.
Fittest Core offers auto-renewing subscriptions.
You'll receive unlimited access to content on all your devices. Payment is charged to your Account at confirmation of purchase. Pricing varies by location and is confirmed prior to purchase. Subscription automatically renews each month unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period, or the trial period (when offered). Cancel anytime in Account Settings.
For more information see our:
-Terms of Service: https://videos.fittestcore.com/pages/terms-of-service
-Privacy Policy: https://videos.fittestcore.com/pages/privacy-policy

A comprehensive app, curated by Macy, a seasoned mother of two and a certified pre/postnatal trainer with over a decade of experience, is designed to guide you safely and confidently through the unique challenges of pregnancy, labor, and postpartum recovery.

What You’ll Get with Fittest Core:

Tailored Workouts for Every Stage: From carefully crafted workouts for all trimesters to specialized exercises targeting pelvic floor strength and relaxation, birth preparation, and early postpartum core rehab, Fittest Core ensures a realistic approach to your fitness during motherhood.

Diverse Postpartum Programs: Heal diastasis recti, recover from delivery (both vaginal and cesarean!), and reconnect with your body through postpartum workouts designed to rebuild strength progressively. Macy’s app simplifies the training process, allowing you to focus on your well-being without the added stress.

Progressive Overload Programs: Learn how to build muscle with structured progressive overload programs that empower you to achieve your strength and fitness goals after pregnancy.

Dynamic Content Updates: Stay motivated and engaged with new workouts added to the gallery weekly. Fittest Core evolves with you, providing fresh challenges and routines to keep your fitness journey exciting and effective!

Empowering Community: Connect with a supportive community of like-minded women who share not only your fitness journey, but are going through the peaks and valleys of motherhood, as well. Exchange experiences, seek advice, and celebrate victories together on the path to empowerment.

Monthly Challenges: Stay motivated with exciting monthly challenges that inspire you to push boundaries and achieve new milestones in your fitness journey.

Macy, a dedicated mother herself, understands the overwhelming nature of fitness during pregnancy and postpartum. Macy's expertise shines through, having guided thousands of women to feel confident, strong, and empowered in their motherhood journey.

bluejetty:00175837:ios.description:
(⌐⊙_⊙) “How To Loot”: Pull The Pin Puzzle is the most challenging among pull the pin puzzle games for adults made by independent game devs. You always wanted to play pull the pin game from those well known ads? ツ Well, we finally made the game! Forget other puzzle games for adults with pins - they’re mere clones of each other, better play our unique and challenging “How To Loot” now! We put our soul into the game and made one of the most authentic problem solving games in pull the pin games category.
＼(＾O＾)／More than 75.000 players already enjoyed our challenging puzzle on the App Store!!!
※ How to play: ※ 
※ Explore various logic puzzle levels of the tower and predict the path for your hero to collect all the loot and survive traps, monsters, lava etc
※ Control pins by dragging and turning them with your finger - they are real physics objects with weight & friction!
※ Make a section of the hero's path safe, let him/her pass it, prepare the next section and so on, until the hero reaches the exit door.
※ If you collect all the loot during the level - you get 5 stars. if not - try again, you didn't solve the riddle correctly! Puzzles for adults are not that easy to crack!
※ Read heroes' dialogues to follow the story of their adventure and get game hints. Brain games for adults tend to lack the story but this is not the case!
※ Find secret doors on some levels and play secret puzzles. Or watch our hints for every secret level to reveal its location.
※ Unlock game chapters with a new piece of story when you earn enough stars. As with all free games, no purchase required! The tower, the dungeon and other locations are waiting to get looted!
Logic puzzles are finally implemented right in our pin rescue game. If you find other pull the pin games not hard enough for your sharp brain - try our “How To Loot” logic puzzles. Exercise your brain, solve tricky pull pin puzzles, pull the pin, rescue princess, loot shiny treasure, defeat vile monsters (a goblin, a ghost or a slime) on a variety of handcrafted levels in a fantasy realm. Funny characters and original story line will make your experience even better in one of the best problem solving games for adults. Be the hero rescue the princess!
※ “How To Loot”: Pull The Pin & Rescue Princess unique features: ※
※ Well known and satisfying pull the pin truly physics based game mechanics. Physics games have never been so fun!
※ Pour water into lava, disarm traps, pull the pin, push it back or even turn around its axis, search for treasure, save the princess and many more funny mechanics! Plan & think in advance like never before in logic games!
※ Story driven adventure in a fantasy realm unlike other pull the pin games! Mysterious and amusing story of a princess rescue and her companions you won’t find in any problem solving games!
※ Be a hero or a heroine! Play as an old mage and pull him out of troubles. Or act as a princess and help her escape the tower when she’s in charge!
※ Brain games combined with epic boss fights! If you know any other pull the pin games having boss battles - please send us a message ツ Challenge your mind and defeat the goblin, trick a slime or avoid a ghost!
※ Hand crafted and challenging logic puzzles you won't find in any puzzle games for adults. Every logic puzzle is a real brain trainer! Especially if you aim to earn 5 stars on every level ツ
※ Secret logic puzzle levels! Only the smartest hero would be able to locate the secret door and solve the secret puzzle game! You gotta play a detective to reveal all mysteries of the castle!
We guarantee our “How To Loot”: Pull The Pin brain games is the most challenging among pull the pin puzzle games for adults available on the market! If you've been looking for pull the pin games you saw in spoofy ads and dreamed to be the hero who rescues the princess (or the princess who rescues herself) you can finally calm down and play this addictive logic puzzle free game.

bluejetty:00184502:ios.name: Will It Fly?
bluejetty:00184502:ios.summary: As a freshly graduated pilot of a small aircraft you must take off with as much cargo and as many passengers as you safely can, while avoiding terrain and obstacles. Earn points by pushing your airplane to it's limit, but beware: The more
bluejetty:00184502:ios.description:
As a freshly graduated pilot of a small aircraft you must take off with as much cargo and as many passengers as you safely can, while avoiding terrain and obstacles. Earn points by pushing your airplane to it's limit, but beware: The more you carry, the worse your aircraft will perform!
How many passengers and how much cargo can you successfully take off with, and still out climb obstacles and terrain? This game applies the real-world laws of aviation to a variety of challenging scenarios. 
As in the real world of flying, a headwind can be your ally. Wind reduces the speed at which you travel over ground, but it does not affect climb speed, so a strong headwind can provide pilots with a steep climb angle.
Hot, High, and Heavy. Any combination of these can produce disastrous results. Hot or high atmospheric conditions indicate thin air, which reduces aircraft performance by lengthening the takeoff roll and reducing your climb angle. Too much weight will have the same effect on aircraft performance.
Earn money, upgrade your plane. Complete achievements, earn gems, unlock new maps. 
Be sure to check out Airport Madness Mobile and Airport Madness Challenge!

bluejetty:00085092:ios.description:
Noteflow AI – The Smart Way to Capture Every Detail. AI Notes is here to simplify your life. Packed schedules filled with meetings, ideas, and conversations mean details often slip away. Noteflow changes that. With AI-driven voice-to-text technology, you can effortlessly capture, transcribe, and organize everything—from lectures and meetings to brainstorming sessions. No more endless typing or scattered memos.
Imagine turning every voice memo, meeting, or recorded conversation into clear, searchable notes instantly. Noteflow organizes, highlights, and summarizes key points, saving you up to 4 hours a week. Perfect for professionals, students, CEOs, and anyone who values their time, Noteflow is your go-to for fast, accurate dictation, capturing every detail and making it accessible across all devices.
Why Choose Noteflow?
*AI-Powered Transcription: Instantly capture and transcribe speech, meeting notes, and conversations.
*Real-Time Summaries: Turn long recordings into concise, easy-to-read summaries with key highlights.
*Voice-to-Text Accuracy: High-precision transcription so you can capture thoughts and conversations seamlessly.
*Effortless Organization: Noteflow structures every note automatically, making it searchable and ready when you need it.
*Effortless Audio Uploads: Upload audio files, and let Noteflow transcribe and create perfectly organized notes.
*Flashcards & Quizzes: Automatically generate flashcards and quizzes from your notes for quick study sessions or training.

bluejetty:00023025:ios.description:
Humankind is on the verge of extinction after being overrun by monsters.
STORY:
Your village was destroyed by monsters, and you lost all your friends. Aim for the abyss in the sage's labyrinth and unravel all the mysteries and your destiny.
Recommended for people like this:
- I want to level up more and more and enjoy RPG easily
- I want to collect many monsters and items and enjoy the RPG for a long time.
- I want friends and various people to see the characters I raised
- I want to avoid waiting for a long time to download additional data.
DUNGEON:
- It's very deep. Monsters wander around and you can pick up items. When you find the stairs, go to the next floor.
- If you tap the map on the upper right of the screen, you can see the whole map of that floor. Auto mapping convenient for traversing.
- Beware of floors with various traps.
MONSTER:
- 129 monsters with beautiful graphics. (as of Ver.1.7) New monsters will be added in the future.
- You can enjoy various strategies for each monster with various abilities. (you can also easily capture with auto)
- Several types of boss class enemies are available. There is also a metal type enemy with a huge amount of experience points.
QUEST:
- Take quests to earn rewards, increase fame and solve mysteries.
- Most quests have no time limit. Let's keep receiving.
- You can also leave quests that are not essential for capture.
JOB:
- You can freely change jobs at any time after opening the shrine.
- As you progress through the strategy, advanced classes will be unlocked.
- Each profession has its own characteristics and needs.
- It is also possible to complete in the first job to the end.
EQUIPMENT:
- 147 equipment as of Ver.1.7. More will be added in the future.
- In addition to raising stats, there are also equipment with various abilities.
- There are also equipment for each job, so choose based on compatibility with skills and attributes.
SKILL:
- More than 200 skills as of Ver.1.0.
- In addition to magic, there are various types such as weapon skills and those that automatically activate or increase abilities.
- Let's think about which skills to take for each job.
HOW TO CATCH MONSTERS:
1. Once you have an item, use it on the monster you want
2. If you defeat that monster, you can get it after the battle
3. Since the next battle, the monster you got will act as an ally
FRIEND INVITE
1. Please press the register button at the bar to register your character (if not registered)
2. Press the register button again to display the registered characters, and press "Friends".
3. Press Invite and let the other person know your own invitation page URL.
4. If the other party launches the app from your invitation page and returns to town, a friend is established.
* Please find friends by sorting at the bar Friend priority.
* Friend's LV may be adjusted when employ (LV up to truth LV can be raised at the bar)
* You can unfriend from the friend's status screen.
* Friends can be hired for free only for the first time (the friend will receive the hiring fee as usual)
* There is no invitation reward (because you can earn infinitely by creating and deleting characters)
OTHERS:
- Make parties with other player's characters, and have your characters join them to get rewards and fame.
- It is also possible to proceed quickly with the auto and full tank functions. Enemy level can be changed in 5 stages at any time.
- if you play carefully, you can enjoy hundreds of hours.
- New quests, monsters, and weapons will be added in the future, so please look forward to it.
- Can be played offline. *Some functions, such as hiring other players, cannot be used.
- I will continue to fix bugs and make improvements. Please feel free to give me your opinion.
SPECIAL THANKS:

 https://www.usui.club/

 http://sozairosa.blog.fc2.com/
 https://maou.audio/

firefox-addons:3131000.summary: Protects your organisation's Workspace and protected resources in this browser.
firefox-addons:3131000.description:
Inlinea Browser Security connects this browser to your organisation's Inlinea deployment. Your organisation decides where it applies: the Workspace and the applications it protects.
On those sites it:
 enrolls the browser with a device key that stays in the browser, and keeps a signed session your organisation's gateway checks before it lets you in;
 applies your organisation's browser security policies, such as limits on copying, pasting, printing, downloading and uploading, a watermark, and a notice when an action is not allowed;
 shows you, in its popup, whether this browser is connected and protected.
It sends nothing from other websites, reads no page content, form values or file names, and sends what it handles only to your organisation's own Inlinea tenant. Before you connect, it shows what your organisation will receive.
You need an Inlinea account from your organisation. Your organisation may install the extension for you; otherwise your Workspace shows when to install it and connects it in one step.

apple-macos:6798311169.name: MindMap: AI Diagrams, Mind Map
apple-macos:6798311169.description:
Turn scattered thoughts into clear, editable maps—then grow them with AI.
MindMap is a native workspace for brainstorming, studying, planning, and presenting. Start with a blank canvas or a ready-made structure, shape every branch, and keep your ideas available as local drafts or synchronized cloud documents after sign-in.
CREATE AND ORGANIZE
• Build mind maps, logic charts, tree diagrams, organization charts, timelines, fishbone diagrams, matrices, grids, and tree tables.
• Start quickly with built-in templates and layout presets.
• Add topics, notes, relationships, boundaries, labels, and images.
WORK WITH AI
• Generate a starting map from a topic.
• Expand branches, rewrite text, summarize ideas, and turn goals into actionable tasks.
• Keep editing every generated topic on the native canvas.
EDIT WITH CONTROL
• Undo and redo changes with local operation history.
• Adjust typography, shapes, colors, branch styles, and canvas themes.
• Use light or dark appearance on iPhone and iPad.
IMPORT AND SHARE
• Import and export .xmind, Markdown, and MindDocument JSON files.
• Export a high-quality PNG for reports, lessons, and presentations.
AI features require an internet connection. Cloud synchronization requires an account.
